https://leadership.ng/nidcom-raises-the-.title: NiDCOM Raises The Alarm As Gambian Central Bank’s Directive Threatens Jobs Of 57 Nigerians
https://leadership.ng/nidcom-raises-the-.summary: This is as the commission said the directive would directly affect 57 Nigerian professionals who hold valid residency and work permits and are currently employed by four banks with Nigeria origin. The Central Bank of Gambia had in early September issued a directive to all banks in the country instructing them to embark on a phased approach to replacing existing non-Gambian staff with suitably qualified Gambian nationals with appropriate arrangements of skill transfer and continuity of operations.
https://leadership.ng/nidcom-raises-the-.summary_zh: 与此同时，该委员会表示，这项指令将直接影响57名持有有效居留许可和工作许可、目前受雇于4家总部位于尼日利亚的银行的尼日利亚专业人士。冈比亚中央银行早在9月初便向该国所有银行发布指令，要求各银行分阶段以具备适当资格的冈比亚公民取代现有的非冈比亚籍员工，并采取适当安排完成技能转移并确保业务连续性。
https://leadership.ng/nidcom-raises-the-.body: This is as the commission said the directive would directly affect 57 Nigerian professionals who hold valid residency and work permits and are currently employed by four banks with Nigeria origin. Currently four banks headquartered in Nigeria operate in Gambia alongside Ecobank Transnational. The four banks are First Bank, Access Bank, Zenith Bank and Guaranty Trust Bank. The Central Bank of Gambia had in early September issued a directive to all banks in the country instructing them to embark on a phased approach to replacing existing non-Gambian staff with suitably qualified Gambian nationals with appropriate arrangements of skill transfer and continuity of operations. The banks are expected to have, complied with the transition directive by December 31, 2026. “Information available indicates that 57 Nigerian professionals employed by four Nigerian-origin banks operating in Gambia which could be affected by the directive. These professionals reportedly hold valid residency and work permits and have contributed significantly to the Gambian banking sector. “The economic contributions of these four banks are equally significant. Collectively, they account for approximately 37.2 per cent of total banking industry deposits (GMD35.3 billion), 32.6 per cent of loans (GMD7.67 billion) and 37 per cent of industry assets (GMD44,78 billion). A Gambian, Essa, who spoke with LEADERSHIP noted that while the directive was not targeted at Nigerians, a situation where more than 50 per cent of the banking staff were foreigners in a country where unemployment among the nationals is rising was quite concerning. Essa, while noting that the banking sector is critical to national security added that “when you go to so many banks in Zambia, you have so many foreign nationals. We don’t have a problem with, but I believe the government is doing so because they want to they want to trim down the unemployment rate when it comes to Gambians.” “The unemployment rate keeps getting higher, and so many Gambians are getting frustrated about it, and they were more or less forcing the government to make steps like that. Most businesses are being controlled by foreign nationals. Gambians are really open to people coming here and investing, but banks are very key sector in every economy. So that is the gap the government is trying is trying to bridge,” he said We’ve got the edge. Get real-time reports, breaking scoops, and exclusive angles delivered straight to your phone. https://leadership.ng/nidcom-raises-the-.title_zh: 尼日利亚通信委员会发出警报，冈比亚中央银行的指令威胁57名尼日利亚人的就业
https://leadership.ng/nidcom-raises-the-.body_zh: 据该委员会所说，这项指令将直接影响57名尼日利亚专业人员。他们持有有效的居留许可和工作许可，目前受雇于4家在尼日利亚注册的银行。目前，除Ecobank Transnational外，还有4家总部设在尼日利亚的银行在冈比亚开展业务。这4家银行分别是First Bank、Access Bank、Zenith Bank和Guaranty Trust Bank。冈比亚中央银行早在9月初便向该国所有银行下达指令，要求它们分阶段以具备适当资质的冈比亚公民取代现有非冈比亚籍员工，并妥善安排技能转移和业务连续性。预计这些银行须在2026年12月31日前遵守这项过渡指令。“现有资料显示，这项指令可能影响在冈比亚运营的4家尼日利亚银行所雇用的57名尼日利亚专业人员。据报道，这些专业人员持有有效的居留许可和工作许可，并为冈比亚银行业作出了重大贡献。“这4家银行的经济贡献同样举足轻重。合计来看，它们约占银行业存款总额的37.2%（GMD35.3 billion）、贷款总额的32.6%（GMD7.67 billion）以及行业总资产的37%（GMD44,78 billion）。一位名叫Essa的冈比亚人对LEADERSHIP表示，尽管该指令并非针对尼日利亚人，但在本国国民失业率不断上升的情况下，银行从业人员中外国人占比超过50%，这一问题相当令人担忧。Essa指出，银行业对国家安全至关重要，并补充说：“你去赞比亚的许多银行看看，会发现那里也有许多外国公民。我们没有这方面的问题，但我认为政府这样做，是因为他们想降低冈比亚人的失业率。”“失业率持续攀升，许多冈比亚人对此感到沮丧，他们或多或少是在迫使政府采取这样的措施。大多数企业都由外国人掌控。冈比亚人确实愿意接纳外来投资者，但银行业是每 economies 中非常关键的部分。因此，这就是政府正试图弥合的差距。”他说。我们掌握独家优势。获取即时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，通过WhatsApp获取全天候更新 →

https://leadership.ng/bandits-demand-n10.title: Bandits Demand N100M As Niger School Lists Names Of Abducted Schoolgirls
https://leadership.ng/bandits-demand-n10.summary: Malam Bako has also released the names of the abducted children and called for urgent military action to secure their release. Malam Bako said the latest information gathered through the vigilantes’ intelligence indicated that the children were still within Niger State, being held in an isolated building guarded by heavily armed bandits.
https://leadership.ng/bandits-demand-n10.summary_zh: 马兰·巴科还公布了遭绑架儿童的名字，并呼吁采取紧急军事行动，确保他们获释。马兰·巴科说，民兵通过情报收集到的最新信息显示，这些儿童仍在尼日尔州境内，被关押在一栋孤立建筑中，外有武装充分的_bandits守卫。
https://leadership.ng/bandits-demand-n10.body: Malam Bako has also released the names of the abducted children and called for urgent military action to secure their release. He, however, lamented that the school and families of victims had yet to receive any practical support for the rescue of the 15 students since the incident occurred, apart from the efforts of local vigilantes. Malam.Bako disclosed to LEADERSHIP that the acting chairman of Rafi Local Government Area and the Divisional Police Officer were the only government officials who had visited since the incident. According to him, following the visit by the two officials, the locals were left to rely on vigilantes, who were trying to track down the abductors. Malam Bako said the latest information gathered through the vigilantes’ intelligence indicated that the children were still within Niger State, being held in an isolated building guarded by heavily armed bandits. He maintained that only military action could secure their release. “We heard that they were still within Niger State, locked in a building, probably without food. We are worried; we want the authorities to come to our aid to rescue them,” he said. The Islamiya teacher further disclosed that he had been under intense pressure from the parents since the abduction, as they were naturally worried about the safety of their children. “We are also worried that nobody has visited us from the state government, at least to give us hope that something is being done to ensure their release,” he added. He told LEADERSHIP that the bandits contacted village leaders on the previous evening, demanding more than N100 million as ransom. A parent, Malam Adamu, also confirmed to LEADERSHIP that the bandits had made the demand because they initially believed the abducted students were from government schools rather than an Islamiya school. Malam Adamu appealed to the Niger State Government to intervene and provide security support. “ This is not the time to leave us to only the vigilantes,” he said. On the government’s efforts to secure the release of the abducted students, the Commissioner for Homeland Security, Justin Maurice Magaji, could not be reached as he and other officials were attending a State Executive Council meeting. The police public relations officer (PPRO), SP Wasiu Abiodun, confirmed to LEADERSHIP that suspected bandits had invaded Tungan-Bako village in Rafi Local Government Area and abducted some people working on a farm. He said the police report indicated that about 14 of the abducted victims were students of an Islamiya school who were assisting their instructor in harvesting maize on the farm. He assured that joint security operations to rescue the victims were ongoing, although villagers maintained that only local vigilantes were on the ground. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/bandits-demand-n10.title_zh: 土匪索要1亿奈拉，尼日尔学校公布被绑架女童名单
https://leadership.ng/bandits-demand-n10.body_zh: 马兰·巴科还公布了被绑架儿童的名字，并呼吁采取紧急军事行动，确保他们获释。然而，他感叹，自事件发生以来，除了地方治安组织的努力外，学校和受害者家属尚未获得任何有关营救这15名学生的实际支持。马兰·巴科向LEADERSHIP透露，事件发生后，唯一的政府官员是拉菲地方政府代理主席和分局警察局长。据他所述，这两名官员到访后，当地居民只能依靠治安组织，而他们正在设法追查绑匪。马兰·巴科说，治安组织搜集到的最新情报显示，这些儿童仍在尼日尔州内，被关押在一栋孤立建筑中，由装备精良的武装匪徒看守。他坚持认为，只有采取军事行动才能确保他们获释。他说：“我们听说他们仍在尼日尔州内，被关在一栋建筑里，可能连食物都没有。我们很担心；我们希望当局前来援助，营救他们。”这位伊斯兰学校教师还透露，自绑架事件发生以来，他一直承受着来自学生家长的巨大压力，因为他们自然担心自己孩子的安全。他补充说：“我们也担心，州政府至今没有人来探望我们，哪怕只是给我们一点希望，让我们知道当局正在采取行动确保他们获释。”他告诉LEADERSHIP，匪徒在前一晚联系了村长，索要超过1亿奈拉作为赎金。一名家长马兰·阿达穆也向LEADERSHIP证实，匪徒之所以提出这一要求，是因为他们最初以为被绑架的学生来自政府学校，而不是伊斯兰学校。马兰·阿达穆呼吁尼日尔州政府介入并提供安全支援。他说：“现在不是把我们丢给治安组织、自行处理的时候。”关于政府为确保被绑架学生获释而采取的行动，由于本土安全事务专员贾斯廷·莫里斯·马加吉和其他官员正在参加州执行委员会会议，因此无法联系到。警方公共关系官（PPRO）SP瓦西乌·阿比奥邓向LEADERSHIP证实，疑似匪徒闯入拉菲地方政府的通甘—巴科村，绑架了一些在农场工作的人员。他说，警方报告显示，被绑架的受害者中约有14人是一所伊斯兰学校的学生，他们当时正在农场协助老师收获玉米。他保证，营救受害者的联合安全行动正在进行，但村民坚持认为，现场只有地方治安组织。我们占据优势。获取直达手机的实时报道、突发独家消息和新闻。订阅LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，畅享全天候最新消息→

The vote will decide how much power President Donald Trump has for the rest of his term. All 435 seats in the House of Representatives, 35 of the 100 Senate seats, and governorships in 36 States are up for election, with about 210 million people registered to vote. Democrats notched a string of early victories in U.S. midterm elections Tuesday, flipping a Republican-held Senate seat and making inroads in conservative House districts as President Donald Trump faced the prospect of a bruising election setback. Democrats gain ground in U.S. midterms as Trump battles bruising setbacks and Georgia’s governor race reshapes the political landscape. Democrat Rebecca Bennett defeated U.S. Representative Tom Kean of New Jersey, according to media, flipping a Republican-held seat. Mr. Kean was the most vulnerable Republican in New Jersey’s congressional delegation. He flipped the Democratic-held seat in 2022 but disappeared from the public for months in an election year before disclosing this summer his battle with depression. The mood inside the White House is “defiant” despite Democrats notching early victories in a blow to President Donald Trump, a White House official told AFP . “The White House mood is defiant,” the official said on condition of anonymity, saying that Mr. Trump would stop the “radical left” no matter what the results were and warning: “Buckle up.” Indian American Pia Dandiya won the election to the U.S. House of Representatives from Florida’s 22nd congressional district, defeating Casey Askar, a Marine veteran. Ms. Dandiya, a former high school principal, bagged 51.9% of the votes to become the newest Indian-American U.S. congresswoman, as per the results declared. Her opponent Mr. Askar, polled 49.1% of the votes. Pia Dandiya, first-generation Indian-American, wins U.S. House of Representatives from Florida Pia Dandiya wins Florida’s 22nd, becoming a 1st-gen Indian-American congresswoman with 51.9% of votes. Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms, a former mayor of Atlanta, was elected governor of the state of Georgia, becoming the first Black woman elected to that office in the United States, media projections showed. Bottoms defeated billionaire health care executive Rick Jackson, who ran as a Republican. Current Governor Brian Kemp is term-limited and could not run again. Suhas Subramanyam, who served as an advisor to President Barack Obama, has been re-elected as a member of the U.S. House of Representatives. Mr. Subramanyam, 40, won from Virginia’s 10th congressional district, polling over 61.5% of the vote against Republican Dave Beckwith, who managed to win 36.4% of the ballots cast. Born in Houston to Indian parents, took lessons of service while attending college at Tulane University in New Orleans, where he helped organise volunteers to rebuild the communities affected by Hurricane Katrina. Suhas Subramanyam re-elected as U.S. Congressman from Virginia Democrat Suhas Subramanyam wins re-election to the US House from Virginia's 10th district, highlighting his bipartisan service and Obama-era policy roles. Mr. Pappas’ victory denied Republicans a pickup in the cold-weather state, where high energy prices had become a major issue amid President Donald Trump’s war with Iran. He will succeed Democrat Jeanne Shaheen, who is retiring after 18 years. While the 39-year-old Jon Ossoff has said that he has “zero interest in running for President,” his victory in Georgia bolsters his status in the Democratic Party two years before the next presidential vote. Americans voted in the most consequential midterm elections, which early surveys predicted as a rebuke to President Donald Trump, signalling a mood for change. Over 210 million Americans were eligible to vote in the elections, which began at 6.00 am eastern time on Tuesday (November 3, 2026) for 435 seats of the U.S. House of Representatives, 37 seats of the U.S. Senate, 36 posts of state governors and a slew of local public offices. Polling was over in Indiana and Kentucky at 6.00 p.m. eastern time on Tuesday (4.30 a.m. India time Wednesday) and would close in a staggered manner till past midnight across different time zones in the U.S.. The first polling stations closed Tuesday in the U.S. midterm elections, with Democrats hoping to secure control of Congress and the future of President Donald Trump’s agenda in the balance. Parts of Indiana and Kentucky were the first to shut polling places at 6:00 pm (2300 GMT). At stake in the midterms are all 435 seats in the House, one-third of the Senate, and a slew of state and local positions. Wall Street stocks finished mostly higher as oil prices continued to pull back while markets awaited results from U.S. midterm elections that could reshape President Donald Trump’s final two years in office. Crude prices, which fell sharply on Monday on revived talk of U.S.-Iran peace prospects, fell modestly hours after Trump insisted that a deal with Tehran “could happen,” with traders also citing unconfirmed West Asia media reports saying progress on Iran’s nuclear program and frozen funds had been made. The prospect of easing energy costs helped Wall Street steady after several sessions of losses, in particular on the tech-heavy Nasdaq, which enjoyed a positive session after three straight declines. Linda Jones has set up a folding chair near a polling station in Atlanta, Georgia, to watch out for anything that might keep people from casting their ballots in the U.S. midterms. “I want to help people navigate the voting, which has gotten more and more complicated,” said the septuagenarian, who is serving as an election observer for the first time. She and two other volunteers will keep a close watch on activity around this polling station, set up in a public library, and report any issues that arise. “In a climate like we are in the country, there’s misinformation, there are actions that are taken that discourage some people from voting, certain parts of the population,” she said. In the hours before polls opened for the U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday, federal judges issued a series of rulings restricting the Trump administration’s unprecedented efforts to pressure state election officials over alleged noncitizen voting. Over the past several months, as President Donald Trump’s fellow Republicans geared up to defend their majorities in both houses of Congress, the administration ramped up a crackdown on noncitizen voting, which Mr. Trump allies say is a major problem even though evidence suggests it is exceedingly rare. That push has repeatedly encountered resistance in the courts. Federal judges have found that the Trump administration was overstepping its authority by wading into election administration, a responsibility that the U.S. Constitution assigns to the states, and that lists it had generated of alleged noncitizens registered to vote were inaccurate and risked disenfranchising naturalised U.S. citizens. Ballot machines malfunctioned in a hotly contested House race in New York state Tuesday, prompting right-wing influencers to fling unfounded allegations of U.S. midterms voter fraud even as local election officials insisted all ballots would be counted. President Donald Trump and his allies have previously spread unproven claims about voting machines, alleging that they are faulty or unreliable. The Westchester County Board of Elections said it was aware of an issue involving paper ballots that is preventing voting machines from accepting ballots at polling locations throughout the county. The board “wants to reassure every voter that your vote matters, your ballot will be secure and your vote will be counted,” with ballots instead placed in emergency bags, it said in a statement. On polling day, Donald Trump sprung a surprise by announcing that the U.S. will stop providing Israel USD four billion in aid from next year, which Democrat Ro Khanna described as a desperate attempt to stave off a “Blue tsunami”. On the eve of the elections, the U.S. launched limited strikes on Iran’s Qesham island in the Hormuz Strait. Officials said that the strikes were in response to Iran firing at a U.S. aircraft. U.S. rock legend Bruce Springsteen, a staunch Democrat, urged election officials Tuesday to resist any government voting interference amid fears President Donald Trump’s administration may intervene in the midterms. “I’m speaking to election officials and representatives of our government on election day. You have sworn an oath to preserve, protect and defend our Constitution,” the 77-year-old said in a video on Instagram. “That means you have a solemn duty to ensure that our votes are securely counted,” he said. “You who represent us must never consent to any directives that undermine our constitutional right to a free and fair election.” “Our vote is our voice, and it’s up to you to ensure that our voice is heard,” added Springsteen, wearing a brown flannel shirt. Europe’s benchmark equities index slipped on Tuesday, as doubts over a potential West Asia peace deal kept markets on edge ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, while investors also assessed a slew of earnings. The pan-European STOXX 600 index closed 0.58% lower at 645.66 points, with mining shares leading declines on weaker copper prices. Iran and the United States are still far from a deal to end their war, a senior Iranian official told Reuters. Overnight, the United States carried out what it called defensive strikes on Iran’s Qeshm island. State officials who run U.S. elections are braced for possible intervention by President Donald Trump’s administration in Tuesday’s midterms -- fearing federal authorities could disrupt voting, challenge ballot counts or try to block unfavourable results. Mr. Trump, whose Republicans face an uphill battle to keep control of Congress, has repeatedly questioned the integrity of US elections and urged his party to “nationalise” voting in at least 15 places. The White House says it is protecting election security, and many of the feared scenarios remain hypothetical. The U.S. Constitution gives the president no direct role in running elections, and courts have so far rebuffed the administration’s main legal challenges. https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body_zh: 订阅可享受《高端故事》《社论》《观点》等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。民主党人翻转了美国首个参议院席位。在早期中期选举结果中，民主党人取得优势，推动其争夺国会控制权，这将是对唐纳德·特朗普总统的一次尖锐否定。据媒体预测，广受关注的民主党籍前州长罗伊·库珀在北卡罗来纳州击败了特朗普总统亲自挑选的参议员候选人，而冉冉升起的民主党新星乔恩·奥索夫在佐治亚州赢得参议院连任选举。美国中期选举的投票于周二（2026年11月3日）开始，首先开放投票的是佛蒙特州以及纽约州、新泽西州、弗吉尼亚州和肯塔基州等其他东海岸州。此次投票将决定唐纳德·特朗普总统在剩余任期内拥有多大权力。众议院全部435个席位、参议院100个席位中的35个，以及36个州的州长职位均将改选，约有2.1亿人登记投票。媒体预测显示，民主党将从共和党手中夺取美国众议院控制权。这一剧变意味着特朗普总统任期后半段将面临对抗。民主党周二在美国中期选举中连获早期胜利，翻转一个共和党控制的参议院席位，并在保守派控制的众议院选区取得进展；与此同时，特朗普总统面临选举惨败的可能。随着特朗普遭遇严重挫折，民主党在美国中期选举中扩大优势，佐治亚州州长选举也重塑政治格局。据媒体报道，民主党人丽贝卡·贝内特击败新泽西州联邦众议员汤姆·基恩，翻转一个共和党控制的席位。基恩先生是新泽西州国会代表团中最脆弱的共和党人。他在2022年翻转了一个民主党控制的席位，但在选举年有数月时间未公开露面，直到今年夏天才披露自己与抑郁症抗争的消息。尽管民主党取得早期胜利并给特朗普总统造成打击，白宫内部气氛仍“坚定不屈”。一名白宫官员告诉法新社：“白宫的气氛是坚定不屈的。”该官员在要求匿名的情况下说，无论结果如何，特朗普先生都将阻止“激进左翼”掌权，并警告说：“大家做好准备。”印度裔美国人皮娅·丹迪亚在佛罗里达州第22选区赢得美国众议院选举，击败海军陆战队退伍军人凯西·阿斯卡。据公布的结果，曾任高中校长的丹迪亚女士获得51.9%的选票，成为最新的印度裔美国国会议员。她的对手阿斯卡先生获得49.1%的选票。皮娅·丹迪亚以51.9%的得票率胜选，成为来自佛罗里达州的首位第一代印度裔美国国会议员，并赢得佛罗里达州第22选区。媒体预测显示，民主党人、前亚特兰大市市长基沙·兰斯·博托姆斯当选佐治亚州州长，成为美国首位当选该职位的黑人女性。博托姆斯击败了以共和党人身份参选的医疗保健行业亿万富翁里克·杰克逊。现任州长布赖恩·肯普受到任期限制，无法再次参选。曾担任巴拉克·奥巴马总统顾问的苏哈斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆再次当选美国众议员。苏布拉马尼亚姆先生现年40岁，在弗吉尼亚州第10选区以超过61.5%的得票率击败共和党人戴夫·贝克威思；贝克威思获得36.4%的选票。他出生于休斯敦，父母是印度人，在新奥尔良杜兰大学就读期间接受服务意识教育，并帮助组织志愿者重建受卡特里娜飓风影响的社区。苏哈斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆在弗吉尼亚州第10选区赢得连任，成为美国众议员。这位民主党人苏哈斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆在弗吉尼亚州第10选区赢得连任，其两党服务经历以及在奥巴马政府时期担任政策职务的经历受到关注。随着食品和能源价格上涨成为竞选议题，而特朗普总统的认可率下降，罗伊·库珀这位知名的前两届任期州长击败了特朗普总统亲自挑选的候选人。美国中期选举：民主党人罗伊·库珀翻转北卡罗来纳州共和党控制的参议院席位。在食品和能源成本高昂引发争论、特朗普时代紧张局势持续的背景下，民主党人罗伊·库珀赢得北卡罗来纳州参议员选举， flipping了一个共和党席位。据媒体预测，民主党人克里斯·帕帕斯赢得新罕布什尔州空缺的美国参议院席位，击败共和党人约翰·苏努努，并在该党争夺参议院控制权之际保住了这一关键民主党席位。帕帕斯先生的胜利使共和党无法在这个寒冷地区州夺取席位；特朗普总统与伊朗的战争期间，高昂能源价格成为当地的主要议题。他将接替任期届满退休的民主党人珍妮·沙欣。39岁的乔恩·奥索夫曾说，自己对竞选总统“毫无兴趣”，但他在佐治亚州的胜利增强了他在民主党内的地位；距离下次总统选举还有两年。美国选民参加了影响最深远的美国中期选举。早期调查曾预测，这次选举将否定唐纳德·特朗普总统的执政，并显示社会情绪正在发生变化。超过2.1亿美国人有资格参加此次选举。投票于周二（2026年11月3日）美国东部时间上午6:00开始，涉及美国众议院435个席位、美国参议院37个席位、36个州州长职位以及大量地方公共职位。印第安纳州和肯塔基州的投票于周二美国东部时间下午6:00（周三印度时间凌晨4:30）结束，而美国不同时区的其他投票站将错峰开放，持续至午夜过后。美国中期选举的首批投票站已经关闭。民主党希望确保国会控制权，而特朗普总统的未来议程也悬而未决。印第安纳州和肯塔基州部分地区率先于下午6:00（格林尼治标准时间2300）关闭投票站。中期选举将决定众议院全部435个席位、参议院三分之一席位以及大量州和地方职位。华尔街股市多数收高；随着油价继续回落，市场等待美国中期选举结果，这次选举可能重塑唐纳德·特朗普总统任期的最后两年。原油价格周一因美伊和平前景重现讨论而大幅下跌；数小时后，特朗普坚持称与德黑兰达成协议“可能实现”，油价小幅下挫。交易员还援引未经证实的西亚媒体报道，称伊朗在核计划和冻结资金方面取得进展。能源成本有望缓解，这帮助华尔街在连续数个交易日的下跌后企稳，尤其是科技股占比较高的纳斯达克指数，在连续三日下跌后迎来上涨。琳达·琼斯在佐治亚州亚特兰大一处投票站附近架起折叠椅，警惕任何可能阻碍人们在美国中期选举中投票的因素。这位七旬老人首次担任选举观察员。他说：“我想帮助人们应对投票；投票过程变得越来越复杂。”他和另外两名志愿者将密切关注这处设在公共图书馆内的投票站周边活动，并报告任何问题。她说：“在如今这个国家的情况下，存在错误信息，也有人采取行动阻止部分人投票，包括人口中的某些群体。”美国中期选举投票开放前数小时，联邦法官连续作出裁决，限制特朗普政府以前所未有的力度向州选举官员施压，要求其处理所谓非公民投票问题。过去数月，特朗普总统的共和党同僚准备捍卫其在国会两院的多数席位，政府则加大了打击非公民投票的力度。特朗普的盟友称这是一个重大问题，尽管证据显示这种情况极其罕见。这项行动屡次在法院遭到抵制。联邦法官认定，特朗普政府介入选举管理超出了权限。美国宪法将选举管理职责赋予各州。政府生成的所谓非公民登记投票者名单并不准确，可能导致归化美国公民失去投票权。周二，纽约州一场竞争激烈的众议院选举中，投票机发生故障。右翼网络影响者随即抛出毫无根据的美国中期选举舞弊指控，地方选举官员则坚称所有选票都会得到统计。唐纳德·特朗普总统及其盟友此前多次传播未经证实的投票机说法，声称投票机存在故障或不可靠。Westchester县选举委员会表示，已知悉一项涉及纸质选票的问题，该问题导致全县投票站的投票机无法接收选票。委员会在声明中表示，选票将改放进应急袋，并“希望让每一位选民放心：您的选票很重要，选票将得到妥善保管，您的投票将被统计”。投票日当天，唐纳德·特朗普突然宣布，美国从明年起将停止向以色列提供40亿美元援助。民主党人罗·卡纳将此形容为阻挡“蓝色海啸”的绝望努力。选举前夕，美国对伊朗霍尔木兹海峡的Qesham岛发动有限规模的打击。官员表示，此举是对伊朗向美国飞机开火的回应。美国摇滚传奇人物、坚定民主党人布鲁斯·斯普林斯廷周二敦促选举官员抵制政府干预投票，因为外界担忧唐纳德·特朗普政府可能介入中期选举。77岁的斯普林斯廷在Instagram发布的视频中说：“我是在选举日对选举官员和政府代表讲话。你们已经宣誓维护、保护和捍卫我们的宪法。这意味着你们肩负着确保我们的选票得到安全统计的庄严职责。”他说：“你们作为我们的代表，绝不能同意任何破坏我们享有自由公正选举这一宪法权利的指令。”身穿棕色法兰绒衬衫的斯普林斯廷补充道：“我们的选票就是我们的声音，你们有责任确保我们的声音被听见。”周二，欧洲基准股指下跌。市场对西亚可能达成和平协议的疑虑令投资者在美国中期选举前保持谨慎，同时也在评估一系列企业财报。泛欧洲STOXX 600指数收低0.58%，报645.66点，铜价走弱导致矿业股领跌。一名伊朗高级官员告诉路透社，伊朗与美国距离达成结束战争的协议仍很远。夜间，美国对其所称的伊朗Qeshm岛实施了“防御性打击”。负责美国选举事务的州官员已为唐纳德·特朗普政府可能干预周二中期选举做好准备。他们担心联邦当局可能扰乱投票、质疑选票统计结果，或试图阻止对其不利的结果。特朗普先生的共和党人正艰难争取维持国会控制权。他多次质疑美国选举的完整性，并敦促本党至少在15个地方将投票“全国化”。白宫表示，政府正在维护选举安全，人们担忧的许多情形仍属假设。美国宪法没有赋予总统直接管理选举的角色，法院迄今也已驳回政府的主要法律挑战。三名NASA宇航员周二在距地球400多公里轨道上运行的国际空间站参加美国中期选举投票，其中包括Anil Menon先生。

https://leadership.ng/35-states-spend-n1.summary_zh: 根据BudgIT题为《从分配到影响：重新思考州政府支出重点》的《2026年各州状况报告》，接受评估的35个州在2025年的偿债付款总额为1.99万亿奈拉，而2024年为2.12万亿奈拉。然而，总支出数据掩盖了多个州偿债支出的显著增长，其中一些州在此期间的增幅超过200%。
https://leadership.ng/35-states-spend-n1.body: According to BudgIT’s 2026 State of States report with the title, “From Allocation to Impact: Rethinking State Spending Priorities”, 35 states covered by the assessment recorded total debt servicing payments of N1.99 trillion in 2025, compared with N2.12 trillion in 2024. The amount represents a decline of about N125.08 billion, or 5.91 per cent, year on year. However, the aggregate expenditure masks significant increases in debt servicing by several states, with some recording more than a 200 per cent rise during the period. Lagos accounted for the largest share of the 2025 debt servicing payments, spending N479.13 billion, representing about 24.1 per cent of the aggregate for the 35 states. The figure was an increase from N416.12 billion in 2024. Oyo State followed with N182.96 billion, compared with N45.02 billion in the preceding year, representing a 306.38 per cent increase. Plateau spent N107.65 billion, up from N52.44 billion, while Benue recorded N104.57 billion and Osun N100.17 billion. Other states with substantial debt servicing payments included Ogun, which spent N87.41 billion; Kaduna, N73.40 billion; Cross River, N69.77 billion; Bauchi, N59.59 billion; and Bayelsa, N59.50 billion. The report also showed that debt servicing increased by 263.35 per cent in Osun, 260.57 per cent in Ebonyi, 240.03 per cent in Anambra and 216.50 per cent in Taraba. Ebonyi’s debt servicing rose from N11.79 billion in 2024 to N42.51 billion in 2025. Beyond debt servicing, the report highlighted the burden of unpaid obligations to contractors, pensioners and retirees, which represent additional claims on state resources outside conventional debt figures. The report’s 2025 payables and liabilities table showed that Delta had the highest reported contractor obligations at N121.69 billion, followed by Ogun with N97.91 billion, Kaduna with N72.95 billion and Enugu with N64.97 billion. Other significant contractor arrears included N43.94 billion in Lagos, N43.52 billion in Imo, N43.32 billion in Ebonyi and N20.23 billion in Benue. The pension and gratuity figures also revealed substantial outstanding obligations. Kaduna recorded the highest reported amount at N100.29 billion, followed by Benue with N71.02 billion, Ogun with N69.95 billion and Edo with N51.37 billion. Bauchi reported pension and gratuity arrears of N41.41 billion, while Niger recorded N41.75 billion. Enugu had N37.79 billion, Abia N37.51 billion and Plateau N35.19 billion. The report further showed that Kwara had N23.87 billion in pension and gratuity arrears, while Adamawa recorded N24.05 billion. Other states include Bayelsa with N12.15 billion, Ondo with N13.46 billion, Kogi with N9.19 billion and Ekiti with N8.07 billion. The pressure from these obligations is reflected in the share of revenue absorbed by debt servicing in some states. Plateau’s debt servicing amounted to 35.28 per cent of its total revenue, while Ogun spent 17.11 per cent and Kaduna 16.03 per cent. Ebonyi’s debt service payments represented 15.99 per cent of its revenue. Although the combined debt servicing expenditure of the 35 states declined in 2025, the increases recorded by several states, alongside substantial unpaid liabilities, highlight the need to assess state fiscal sustainability beyond reported debt stocks alone. The report stressed the need for sustainable debt strategy to extend beyond statutory borrowing limits, saying “states need credible medium-term debt strategies, transparent reporting of guarantees and arrears, conservative exchange-rate risk management and a stronger connection between borrowing and productive capital formation. “The key consideration should be whether debt-financed spending expands the future capacity of the state to provide services and generate revenue. Without that discipline, higher revenue inflows can coexist with growing fiscal vulnerabilities,” it said. BudgIT, therefore, urged state governments and legislatures to treat debt transparency, project appraisal, arrears clearance and oversight of loan-funded programmes as central responsibilities of public financial management, rather than as peripheral compliance exercises. https://leadership.ng/35-states-spend-n1.title_zh: 随着养老金和承包商欠款增加，35个州支出1.99万亿奈拉用于偿债
https://leadership.ng/35-states-spend-n1.body_zh: 根据BudgIT的《2026年各州状况报告——〈从资金分配到影响：重新思考州支出优先事项〉》，纳入评估的35个州在2025年的债务偿付支出合计为N1.99万亿，低于2024年的N2.12万亿。这一数字同比减少约N125.08万亿?? sorry N1250.8亿，降幅为5.91%。然而，总支出数字掩盖了若干州债务偿付支出的显著增长，其中一些州在此期间的增幅超过200%。拉各斯州占2025年债务偿付支出的最大份额，支出N479.13亿，占35个州总额的约24.1%，高于2024年的N416.12亿。奥约州以N182.96亿紧随其后，而上一年为N45.02亿，增幅达306.38%。高原州支出N107.65亿，高于上年的N52.44亿；贝努埃州为N104.57亿，奥逊州为N100.17亿。其他债务偿付支出较大的州包括奥贡州，支出N87.41亿；卡杜纳州N73.40亿；十字河州N69.77亿；包奇州N59.59亿；巴耶尔萨州N59.50亿。报告还显示，奥逊州的债务偿付增幅为263.35%，埃博尼州为260.57%，阿南布拉州为240.03%，塔拉巴州为216.50%。埃博尼州的债务偿付支出从2024年的N117.9亿增至2025年的N425.1亿。除债务偿付外，报告还强调了拖欠承包商、养老金领取者和退休人员款项所带来的负担，这些款项是传统债务数字之外对州财政资源的额外要求。报告中的2025年应付款和债务表显示，克莱塔州报告的承包商欠款最高，为N121.69亿，其次是奥贡州的N97.91亿、卡杜纳州的N72.95亿和恩古州的N64.97亿。其他数额较大的承包商欠款包括拉各斯州的N43.94亿、伊莫州的N43.52亿、埃博尼州的N43.32亿和贝努埃州的N20.23亿。养老金和酬金数据也显示出大量未偿义务。卡杜纳州的报告金额最高，为N100.29亿，其次是贝努埃州的N71.02亿、奥贡州的N69.95亿和埃多州的N51.37亿。包奇州报告的养老金和酬金欠款为N41.41亿，尼日尔州为N41.75亿。恩古州为N37.79亿，阿比亚州为N37.51亿，高原州为N35.19亿。报告进一步显示夸拉州的养老金和酬金欠款为N23.87亿，阿达瓦州为N24.05亿。其他州包括巴耶尔萨州N121.5亿? sorry N12.15亿、奥尔多州N13.46亿、科吉州N9.19亿和埃基蒂州N8.07亿。这些债务带来的压力反映在部分州用于债务偿付的财政收入占比上。高原州的债务偿付支出占其总收入的35.28%，奥贡州占17.11%，卡杜纳州占16.03%。埃博尼州的债务偿付支出占其收入的15.99%。尽管35个州的债务偿付总支出在2025年有所下降，但多个州的债务偿付支出增加，叠加大量未偿债务，表明评估州财政可持续性时，不能只看报告的债务存量。报告强调，可持续的债务战略必须超越法定借款上限，并指出：“各州需要可信的中期债务战略、透明报告担保和欠款情况、采取保守的汇率风险管理措施，并加强借款与生产性资本形成之间的联系。关键考量在于，以债务融资的支出能否扩大该州未来提供公共服务和创造收入的能力。缺乏这种纪律，即使财政收入流入增加，财政脆弱性也可能随之增长。”BudgIT因此敦促州政府和州议会把债务透明度、项目评估、清理欠款以及监督贷款资助项目，作为公共财政管理的核心职责，而不是边缘性的合规工作。我们掌握前沿信息。获取实时报道、独家新闻和独到视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: Senior N. Korean party official visiting China: KCNA
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: A senior North Korean ruling party official has arrived in China, the North's state media confirmed Wednesday, a visit that underscores deepening cooperation between Pyongyang and Beijing. Kim Song-nam, a member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and a party secretary, embarked on a trip to China on Tuesday, leading a party delegation, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜国家媒体周三证实，朝鲜执政党一名高级官员已抵达中国，此访凸显平壤与北京之间日益加深合作。据朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道，朝鲜劳动党政治局委员、党中央书记Kim Song-nam于周二率党代表团开启访华行程。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A senior North Korean ruling party official has arrived in China, the North's state media confirmed Wednesday, a visit that underscores deepening cooperation between Pyongyang and Beijing. Kim Song-nam, a member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and a party secretary, embarked on a trip to China on Tuesday, leading a party delegation, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). His visit came at the invitation of China's Communist Party's Central Committee. The delegation's arrival came just 10 days after North Korean leader Kim Jong-un made a surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong — an indication that the two countries are stepping up efforts to reinforce high-level exchanges and traditional ties. North Korea and China have been deepening their cooperation after bilateral relations had chilled amid Pyongyang's closer ties with Russia over the Ukraine war. Upon arrival at a Chinese airport, Kim and his delegation were greeted by Deputy Head Sun Haiyan and other officials of the International Liaison Department of the Chinese party and North Korean Ambassador to China Ri Ryong-nam, the KCNA said. In a separate dispatch, the KCNA reported that Xie Chuntao, executive vice president of the Party School of the Chinese party's central committee, and his delegation arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Xie's delegation met Ju Chang-il, a party secretary of the North, and visited the Central Cadres Training School
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜党高级官员访问中国：朝中社
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜最高人民会议常任委员会? 朝鲜执政党一名高级官员已于周三抵达中国，朝鲜官方媒体证实了此行，此次访问凸显平壤与北京之间的合作日益加深。据朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道，朝鲜劳动党中央政治局委员、党中央事务委员金松男周二率党代表团赴中国访问。此次访问应中国共产党的中央委员会邀请。代表团抵达时距朝鲜领导人金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东仅10天，这表明两国正加大力度推动高层交往并巩固传统联系。在乌克兰战争背景下，平壤因加强与俄罗斯的关系而与中国的双边关系降温，此后朝鲜和中国一直深化合作。KCNA称，金松男及其代表团抵达中国机场时，受到中共中央对外联络部副部长孙海燕、中国党务部门其他官员以及朝鲜驻华大使李龙nam的欢迎。KCNA在另一篇报道中称，中共中央党校常务副校长谢春涛及其代表团于周一抵达平壤。谢春涛一行会见了朝鲜党中央事务委员朱昌一，并参观了中央干部 trainingschool

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korea says dialogue with US option but not must for national interest
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korea said Wednesday that dialogue with the United States remains an option for peace, but that it would not be necessary for its own interest while again stressing the U.S.' accusation of its involvement in a major cryptocurrency theft as a sign of Washington's hostility toward Pyongyang.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜周三表示，与美国对话仍是实现和平的一个选项，但出于自身利益，目前并无必要；与此同时再次强调，美方指控其参与一起重大加密货币盗窃案，体现了华盛顿对平壤的敌意。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea said Wednesday that dialogue with the United States remains an option for peace, but that it would not be necessary for its own interest while again stressing the U.S.' accusation of its involvement in a major cryptocurrency theft as a sign of Washington's hostility toward Pyongyang. Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, made the remarks, saying the continued "hostile signal" by Washington was compelling the regime to reconsider the "true nature" of the U.S. "The choice for peace includes dialogue of course, but this is not surely equated with national interests for us," Kim said in a statement carried by the North's official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). The remarks came a day after she rejected the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's (FBI) findings that the regime was behind the theft of more than US$6 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. She earlier called the accusation a "grave political provocation" against the North. "The so-called 'cryptocurrency hacking case by the DPRK' is no more than a tip of iceberg that shows the essence of the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK," Kim reiterated Wednesday, referring to the North's official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Kim pointed to a recent trilateral meeting between the top diplomats of South Korea, the U.S. and Japan, where they reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea, along with various joint military drills, as other examples of U.S. hostility. "The U.S. abandonment of its hostile policy" toward Pyongyang "is a major premise and key to solving all problems," she said, adding that North Korea has no reason to engage in talks with the U.S. unless that happens. "It is our clear stand that we have no need to sit face to face with such unreliable and hostile persons who refuse to abandon their policy of confrontation," she said. She further warned that Pyongyang would respond to what it views as continued U.S. hostility. "In the present reality when new records are being set in the implementation of the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, it is natural that new records should be created in our reflective counteraction." She did not specify what counteractions Pyongyang would take
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜称，与美国对话是选项，但国家利益并非必须选择对话
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜周三表示，与美国进行对话仍是实现和平的一个选项，但这对朝鲜自身利益而言并无必要；朝鲜再次强调，美国指控其参与一起重大加密货币盗窃案，体现了华盛顿对平壤的敌意。朝鲜领导人金正恩权势强大的妹妹金与正发表上述言论。她说，华盛顿持续发出“敌对信号”，迫使该政权重新审视美国政策的“真正本质”。金与正在朝鲜官方朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）播发的声明中说：“实现和平的选择当然包括对话，但这肯定不等同于我们的国家利益。”此前一天，她否认了美国联邦调查局（FBI）认定该政权策划从全球最大加密货币交易平台币安窃取超过60亿美元加密货币的结论。她早些时候称，这项指控是对朝鲜的“严重政治挑衅”。周三，金与正再次表示，所谓“朝鲜加密货币黑客案件”不过是冰山一角，揭示了美国对朝鲜敌对政策的实质。她以朝鲜正式国名朝鲜民主主义人民共和国指代朝鲜。金与正指出，韩国、美国和日本三国外交部长最近举行了三边会议，会上重申推动朝鲜半岛完全无核化的承诺，并举行各种联合军事演习；这些也是美国敌意的其他例证。她说，美国放弃对平壤的“敌对政策”是解决所有问题的重要前提和关键；除非这种情况发生，否则朝鲜没有理由与美国谈判。她说：“我们立场鲜明，无需与那些拒绝放弃对抗政策、既不可靠又充满敌意的人坐下来谈判。”她还警告，平壤将回应其所认定的美国持续敌意。她说：“在落实美国对朝鲜敌对政策不断刷新纪录的当下，我们作出反思性反制并刷新纪录也是理所当然的。”她没有说明平壤将采取何种反制措施

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: SK hynix's New York chip plans hit snag over US restrictions on China, sources say
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: U.S. officials have held up approval for American chipmaking equipment needed by SK Hynix to expand production in China, complicating the South Korean chipmaker's plans for new memory-chip plants in New York, according to people familiar with the matter. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，美国官员暂缓批准SK海力士在中国扩大生产所需的美国芯片制造设备，令这家韩国芯片制造商在纽约新建存储芯片工厂的计划面临变数。两名人士表示，SK海力士旗下Solidigm部门计划投资约$45 billion，在纽约州马西建造两座NAND工厂，投资额未来可能增至约$100 billion。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: U.S. officials have held up approval for American chipmaking equipment needed by SK Hynix to expand production in China, complicating the South Korean chipmaker's plans for new memory-chip plants in New York, according to people familiar with the matter. SK Hynix is seeking U.S. export licenses to equip its Dalian plant, arguing that increased production there would help fund its planned U.S. expansion. But the Commerce Department has yet to approve the new licenses, the people said. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time. NAND is memory that retains data even when power is turned off and is used for storage in data centers. The negotiations raise questions about how far the Trump administration is willing to bend national security guardrails established to keep U.S. technology from aiding China's military, in order to bring foreign investment and chipmaking onshore. "Ultimately, none of this is going to go forward without a green light from the White House," said Leland Miller, a member of the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, a bipartisan panel created by the U.S. Congress. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Negotiations are continuing, the people said, with approval for the Dalian expansion central to SK Hynix's plans in New York. Executives from SK Hynix's U.S. subsidiary, Solidigm, have met nearly 10 times with officials from the Commerce Department since late August, one of the people said. The company needs to ramp up production and develop more sophisticated NAND chipmaking in China to generate revenue to build a U.S. facility and to stay competitive, the people said. In a meeting last week, Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler held to his position that the U.S. would not allow more American chipmaking tools to upgrade or expand capacity, the person said, though the department has not formally denied a license to export American equipment to fill empty clean space in Dalian. The two sides are also negotiating a separate license for 2027 for equipment to keep up the Dalian facility, the person said. A spokesperson for the Department of Commerce did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a statement last week, Solidigm said: "As a U.S.-founded and headquartered company, Solidigm regularly evaluates strategic alternatives to best serve its customers and enhance its long-term competitiveness. The company is currently exploring options for building a NAND memory fab at potential locations around the world. No decision regarding any specific course of action has been made." Solidigm stuck to its statement from last week. SK Hynix did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside business hours
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 消息人士称，SK海力士的纽约芯片计划因美国对华限制而受阻
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 据知情人士透露，美国官员暂缓批准 SK Hynix 扩大在华生产所需的美国芯片制造设备，使这家韩国芯片制造商在纽约新建存储芯片工厂的计划复杂化。SK Hynix 正寻求美国出口许可，为其大连工厂配备设备，并主张增加当地产量将有助于为其计划中的美国扩张提供资金。不过，知情人士表示，美国商务部尚未批准这些新许可。两名知情人士称，其旗下 Solidigm 部门计划投资约 $45 billion，在纽约州马西建造两座 NAND 工厂，日后投资额可能达到约 $100 billion。NAND 是一种即使断电也能保留数据的存储器，用于数据中心的数据存储。相关谈判引出了一个问题：特朗普政府究竟愿意在多大程度上突破为防止美国技术协助中国军事而设立的国家安全底线，从而吸引外国投资并将芯片制造转移到美国。美国国会设立的两党联合机构美中经济与安全审查委员会成员 Leland Miller 表示：“归根结底，没有白宫点头，这一切都不会推进。”白宫没有立即回应置评请求。知情人士表示，谈判仍在继续，大连扩产能否获批是 SK Hynix 纽约计划的关键。知情人士之一称，自 8 月底以来，SK Hynix 美国子公司 Solidigm 的高管已与商务部官员会面近 10 次。知情人士表示，公司需要提高产量并在中国开发更先进的 NAND 芯片制造技术，以创造收入建设美国设施并维持竞争力。该人士称，在上周的一次会议上，商务部副部长 Jeffrey Kessler 坚持原有立场，即美国不会允许更多美国芯片制造工具用于升级或扩大产能，尽管商务部尚未正式拒绝向大连出口美国设备的许可，以为当地尚未启用的洁净生产空间补充设备。该人士称，双方还在谈判一项单独的 2027 年许可，用于维持大连工厂运营的设备。商务部发言人也未立即回应置评请求。Solidigm 上周在一份声明中表示：“Solidigm 是一家在美国创立并设于美国总部的公司，经常评估各种战略方案，以更好地服务客户并增强其长期竞争力。公司目前正在探索于全球各地潜在地点建设 NAND 存储芯片晶圆厂的方案。公司尚未就任何具体行动方案作出决定。”Solidigm 上周重申了这份声明。非营业时间外，SK Hynix 未立即回应置评请求

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: IES Global eyes expansion of study abroad, internship programs in Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: In an interview with The Korea Times in September, IES Global President and CEO Gregory Hess emphasized that Korea is rapidly gaining ground as a study abroad destination for American students, attracting growing interest not only for its cultural appeal but also for its technological prowess and world-class universities.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: IES Global总裁兼首席执行官Gregory Hess在9月接受《韩国时报》采访时强调，韩国正迅速成为美国学生的海外留学目的地，其文化吸引力、技术实力和世界一流大学吸引了日益增长的关注。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: In an interview with The Korea Times in September, IES Global President and CEO Gregory Hess emphasized that Korea is rapidly gaining ground as a study abroad destination for American students, attracting growing interest not only for its cultural appeal but also for its technological prowess and world-class universities. "Korea is one of the hot countries," he said. "Students are attracted not only to its culture, its entrepreneurial culture, the prominence of its products, but also the great universities that are here." While K-pop and Korean dramas often serve as an entry point for international students, Hess said Korea's appeal extends well beyond popular culture to its strengths in advanced technology and higher education. "I think the gateway is kind of Korean culture, but they also see that Korea is on the cutting edge," he said, noting the country's leadership in technologies including artificial intelligence, semiconductors, computer science and data science. Hess also highlighted Korea's highly educated population and modern urban environment, describing the country as a place where students can experience firsthand how technology is shaping the future. "There's a kind of futuristic element to Korea that I think people like," he said. IES Global operates study abroad and internship programs in more than 20 countries and 30 cities through IES Abroad, which primarily serves American students, and the Study Abroad Foundation (SAF), which helps students from Korea, Japan and China pursue educational opportunities overseas. By connecting the two programs, the organization aims to expand two-way student exchanges and provide more opportunities for students to gain international work experience. As part of its expansion in Korea, IES Global is developing a new internship program that would give American students opportunities to gain hands-on experience in Korean workplaces, extending its offerings beyond traditional academic exchanges. Hess said the organization is working with a local partner to launch the program, although an agreement has yet to be finalized. "We think this is a great way for U.S. students to not only get a great cultural experience in Korea but also to learn and develop their professional skill set," he said. Similar opportunities are already available to Korean students through SAF, including semester-long internships for Yonsei University students at IES Global centers overseas. Hess said such experiences help students develop professional skills while learning to navigate unfamiliar workplace cultures, giving them an advantage in an increasingly competitive job market. According to IES Global's student feedback, 80 to 90 percent of study abroad participants said their overseas experiences helped them land their first jobs and improve their career prospects. Hess said internships could offer even greater benefits by allowing students to demonstrate their adaptability and ability to work across cultures — qualities that employers increasingly seek alongside academic credentials. "When a company is looking to hire a young person, they can look at how talented they are and all the wonderful grades they got," he said. "But they also want to make sure that they can adapt to the culture within the company." Unlike traditional university-to-university exchange programs, IES Global offers students access to a wider network of institutions and study abroad opportunities without requiring separate partnerships between individual universities. He said the model allows universities to offer students more destinations and programs while reducing administrative complexity and costs. Hess believes studying and interning in Korea could also serve as a stepping stone for international students seeking longer-term career opportunities in the country. However, he stressed that building a career in Korea requires sustained efforts to overcome language and cultural barriers, which cannot be addressed through short-term exchanges alone. "I think even just one year won't be enough," he said, noting that adapting to Korean workplaces and society often requires a multiyear commitment. Beyond academic and career opportunities, Hess emphasized the role of international exchanges in fostering cross-cultural understanding amid growing geopolitical uncertainty. In Korea, IES Global connects visiting American students with Korean alumni of SAF programs, helping them build relationships and gain a deeper understanding of each other's cultures. Looking ahead, Hess expects Seoul to remain a major destination for international students, while the organization plans to expand opportunities for Korean students to study and work abroad. He stressed that the value of international education extends beyond academic achievement and career development, helping students broaden their perspectives and better understand the world. "We want study abroad to change their lives," Hess said. "But we want those changed lives to change the world."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: IES Global计划扩大韩国留学和实习项目
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 在9月接受《韩国时报》采访时，IES Global总裁兼首席执行官格雷戈里·赫斯强调，韩国正迅速成为美国学生热门留学目的地，吸引他们的兴趣不仅源于韩国文化的吸引力，也源于其 technological prowess和世界级大学。他说：“韩国是热门国家之一。”“学生被吸引的不仅是韩国文化、创业文化以及产品享有的盛誉，还有这里的一流大学。”虽然K-pop和韩剧经常是国际学生接触韩国的起点，但赫斯表示，韩国的吸引力远不止流行文化，还体现在先进技术和高等教育领域的优势上。他说：“我认为，某种意义上的入门因素是韩国文化，但学生也会看到韩国正处于前沿。”他指出，韩国在人工智能、半导体、计算机科学和数据科学等技术领域处于领先地位。赫斯还强调，韩国人口受教育程度高，城市环境现代化；他将该国描述为一个让学生能够亲身体验科技如何塑造未来的地方。他说：“韩国具有某种未来感，我认为人们喜欢这一点。”IES Global通过主要服务美国学生的IES Abroad，以及帮助韩国、日本和中国学生赴海外寻求教育机会的Study Abroad Foundation（SAF），在20多个国家和30个城市运营海外学习与实习项目。通过连接这两个项目，该组织旨在扩大双向学生交流，为学生获得国际工作经验提供更多机会。作为在韩国扩张的一部分，IES Global正在开发一项新的实习项目，让美国学生有机会在韩国职场获得实践经验，将其项目范围从传统学术交流进一步延伸。赫斯表示，该组织正与当地合作伙伴合作启动这一项目，但协议尚未最终敲定。他说：“我们认为，这是美国学生在韩国获得丰富文化体验的同时学习并提升职业技能的绝佳方式。”韩国学生目前已经可以通过SAF获得类似机会，包括延世大学学生赴IES Global海外中心开展为期一学期的实习。赫斯表示，此类经历有助于学生培养职业技能，同时学习适应陌生的职场文化，从而在竞争日益激烈的就业市场中占据优势。根据IES Global收集的学生反馈，80%至90%的海外学习参与者表示，海外经历帮助他们找到第一份工作，并改善了职业前景。赫斯表示，实习可能带来更大益处，因为它能让学生展示适应能力和跨文化工作能力，而雇主在看重学历的同时，也越来越看重这些素质。他说：“企业招聘年轻人时，可以考察他们的才能以及取得的优异成绩。但企业也希望确认，他们能否适应公司内部的文化。”与传统高校之间的交换项目不同，IES Global无需各大学单独建立合作关系，即可让学生接触更广泛的院校网络和海外学习机会。他说，这种模式让大学能够为学生提供更多目的地和项目，同时降低行政复杂度和成本。赫斯认为，在韩国学习和实习，也可成为国际学生寻求在该国获得长期职业发展机会的垫脚石。不过，他强调，在韩国建立职业生涯需要持续努力，以克服语言和文化障碍，这些障碍无法仅靠短期交流解决。他说：“我认为，即便只有一年也不够。”他指出，适应韩国职场和社会通常需要多年的投入。除学术和职业机会外，赫斯强调，在地缘政治不确定性加剧之际，国际交流在促进跨文化理解方面发挥着重要作用。在韩国，IES Global将来访的美国学生与SAF项目的韩国校友联系起来，帮助他们建立联系并更深入地了解彼此的文化。展望未来，赫斯预计首尔仍将是国际学生的热门目的地，同时该组织计划扩大韩国学生赴海外学习和工作的机会。他强调，国际教育的价值超越了学业成就和职业发展，能够帮助学生拓宽视野，更好地理解世界。赫斯说：“我们希望海外学习能够改变他们的人生，也希望这些被改变的人生能够改变世界。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: I came to Korea to learn Korean. I ended up learning about the world
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: When I moved to Seoul to study Korean, I expected my education to be about Korea. I imagined improving my Korean, learning more about Korean society and gaining a deeper understanding of a country in which I hoped to build a future. What I did not expect was that studying Korean would teach me so much about the rest of the world.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 我搬到首尔学习韩语时，以为自己的学习内容会围绕韩国展开。我设想自己提高韩语水平，更多了解韩国社会，并加深对这个我希望在其中开创未来的国家的理解。我没有想到的是，学习韩语也让我对世界其他地方有了如此多的认识。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: When I moved to Seoul to study Korean, I expected my education to be about Korea. I imagined improving my Korean, learning more about Korean society and gaining a deeper understanding of a country in which I hoped to build a future. What I did not expect was that studying Korean would teach me so much about the rest of the world. At times, my classroom at Korea University’s Korean Language Center has felt like a miniature United Nations. Over the past year, I have studied alongside people from countries including Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Russia and Turkey. I grew up in Australia and New Zealand, but these were places I had relatively little exposure to. But I realized multiculturalism has a geography. Migration patterns, geography and history inevitably shape which cultures we encounter in our everyday lives. Korea's geographic proximity to Central and Northeast Asia and its growing cultural influence and educational opportunities bring together students who might otherwise have had little reason to cross paths. Our common goal is to learn Korean, but we also became each other's teachers. Some of what I have learned has been simple. Before coming here, for example, I did not realise how widely Russian is spoken in Kazakhstan and other parts of the former Soviet Union. Other conversations have introduced me to histories and identities that I previously knew almost nothing about. One of the most fascinating examples has been learning about the Koryo-in, ethnic Koreans from the former Soviet Union. Through them and in their communities, I began to learn about their complex history of migration, displacement and identity. Their experiences also made me think about my own. As an ethnic Chinese person who grew up in a multicultural environment in Australia and New Zealand, I found something familiar in conversations about an ancestral identity connected to one country while being culturally shaped by another. Our histories are very different, yet those conversations reminded me that questions such as "Where are you from?" and "Where do you belong?" rarely have simple answers. As our Korean has become more advanced, our textbooks have moved beyond to discussing politics, law, social issues, education, cultural traditions and social values. A lesson about Korea's political system, for example, can quickly become a discussion about how governments work in our own countries. I was reminded of this when I interviewed one of my Korean teachers. When I asked what she enjoyed most about teaching at the center, one of her answers stayed with me. Teaching gave her the opportunity to listen to students and learn about cultures and countries around the world. I had always assumed that we were the ones coming to Korea to learn. I had not thought as much about the exchange happening in the other direction. Her answer made me realise that an international classroom does not really have a single teacher or a single direction in which knowledge flows. Perhaps that is the greatest value of learning in an international classroom. You begin by noticing obvious differences in food, languages, holidays and customs. Eventually, however, you encounter deeper ones in how people think about family, education, identity, success and the way a life should be lived. International education is often described as an exchange between a student and a host country. I came to Korea and certainly learned about Korea. But I have also learned about Kazakhstan from Kazakhs, Mongolia from Mongolians and other countries from classmates who grew up there. They, in turn, have heard about Australia, New Zealand and China through people like me. Korean, strangely enough, has often been the language through which these conversations have taken place. I came to Seoul expecting Korean to open a door into Korea. I did not expect so many doors to the rest of the world would also open. Geoffrey Chen (gywchen@gmail.com) is a former corporate lawyer from Australia currently studying Korean at Korea University in Seoul
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 我来到韩国学习韩语，最终却了解了这个世界
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 我搬到首尔学习韩语时，以为自己的学业会围绕韩国展开。我设想自己提高韩语水平，更多了解韩国社会，并加深对一个我希望在其中开创未来的国家的理解。我没想到的是，学习韩语竟能让我如此深入地了解世界其他地方。有时，在Korea University的Korean Language Center上课时，我仿佛置身于一个缩小版的United Nations。过去一年里，我一直与来自哈萨克斯坦、蒙古、俄罗斯和土耳其等国的人一起学习。我在澳大利亚和新西兰长大，但此前对这两个地方接触相对较少。然而我意识到，多元文化是有地理基础的。人口迁移格局、地理环境和历史 inevitably 塑造着我们在日常生活中接触哪些文化。韩国地理位置接近中亚和东北亚，其日益增强的文化影响力和教育机会，把原本可能几乎没有理由相遇的学生汇聚到了一起。我们的共同目标是学习韩语，但我们也成了彼此的老师。我学到的一些东西很简单。例如，来到这里之前，我没意识到俄语在哈萨克斯坦及前苏联其他地区也被广泛使用。其他交谈则让我接触了此前几乎一无所知的历史和身份认同。最引人入胜的例子之一，是我了解了Koryo-in，即来自前苏联的朝鲜族人。通过他们以及他们所在的社群，我开始了解他们迁徙、流离失所和身份认同的复杂历史。他们的经历也让我开始思考自己的经历。作为一名在澳大利亚和新西兰多元文化环境中长大的华人，我在谈及与一个国家相连的祖籍身份、同时在文化上受到另一个国家塑造时，找到了一种熟悉感。我们的历史虽然大相径庭，但这些交谈提醒我，诸如“你来自哪里？”和“你属于哪里？”这样的问题很少有简单答案。随着我们的韩语水平不断提高，教材内容也逐步深入，开始讨论政治、法律、社会议题、教育、文化传统和社会价值观。例如，一堂关于韩国政治制度的课，很快就会变成一场讨论我们自己国家政府如何运作的谈话。我采访自己的一位韩国籍教师时，想起了这一点。当我问最喜欢该中心教学工作的哪一点时，她的回答始终萦绕在我心头。教学让她有机会倾听学生，了解世界各地的文化和国家。我一直以为，是我们这些来到韩国学习的人在单向获取知识，却没有充分思考另一个方向同样也在发生交流。她的回答让我意识到，国际课堂其实并没有唯一的教师，也没有知识流动的单一方向。也许，这正是国际课堂中学习最大的价值。起初，你注意到饮食、语言、节日和习俗之间显而易见的差异。然而最终，你会遇到更深层的影响，例如人们如何看待家庭、教育、身份认同、成功，以及人生应当如何度过。国际教育常被描述为学生与东道国之间的交流。我来到韩国，确实了解了韩国。但我还从哈萨克斯坦人那里了解了哈萨克斯坦，从蒙古人那里了解了蒙古国，并从在那里长大的同学那里了解了其他国家。反过来，他们又通过像我这样的人了解了澳大利亚、新西兰和中国。说来奇怪，这些交谈往往都以韩语进行。我来到首尔时，以为韩语会为我打开一扇通往韩国的门。我没料到，通往世界其他地方的许多门也会随之打开。Geoffrey Chen（gywchen@gmail.com）来自澳大利亚，曾任企业律师，目前在首尔的Korea University学习韩语。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) on Wednesday formally proposed that the government postpone the implementation of taxation on cryptocurrencies, set to take effect next year. The party's supreme council decided to make such a proposal in a meeting, considering the need to give businesses and investors time to adjust to the new taxation scheme, according to DPK leader Kim Min-seok.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 朝鲜民主劳动党（DPK）于周三正式提议政府推迟实施原定于明年生效的加密货币税收。据该党领导人金民锡介绍，党的最高委员会在一次会议上决定提出这一建议，以考虑企业和投资者需要时间适应新税收制度。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) on Wednesday formally proposed that the government postpone the implementation of taxation on cryptocurrencies, set to take effect next year. The party's supreme council decided to make such a proposal in a meeting, considering the need to give businesses and investors time to adjust to the new taxation scheme, according to DPK leader Kim Min-seok. "We agreed that it would be better to first enact the Digital Asset Basic Act to build an overall framework and allow time for companies and investors to adapt after a comprehensive review of taxation principles, domestic industry conditions and fairness among users," Rep. Kim said. Korea first introduced a taxation scheme on cryptocurrencies in 2020, but its implementation has been repeatedly postponed, with the taxation now set to take effect Jan. 1. If the latest proposal is accepted, it would mark the fourth delay. Under the scheme, annual cryptocurrency gains exceeding 2.5 million won ($1,880) will be subject to a 22 percent tax, including the local income tax
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 执政党提议推迟政府原定对加密货币征税计划
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 朝鲜执政党民主党（DPK）于周三正式提议政府推迟原定于明年实施的加密货币征税。 据该党领导人金旼锡介绍，党的最高委员会在会议上决定提出这一建议，以考虑企业投资者需要时间适应新税收制度。 金议员表示：“我们一致认为，最好先制定《数字资产基本法》，建立总体框架，并在全面审查税收原则、国内行业状况和用户之间的公平性后，为企业和投资者留出适应时间。” 朝鲜于2020年首次推出加密货币征税方案，但其实施已多次推迟，目前定于1月1日生效。 如果最新提议获接受，这将是第四次推迟。 根据该方案，年度加密货币收益超过250万韩元（1,880美元）的部分将按22%的税率征税，其中包括地方所得税

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: SKT's operating profit up over 1,000%, turns to black in Q3
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: SK Telecom (SKT), Korea's top mobile service carrier, said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit surged 1,041.3 percent from a year earlier, while its net profit shifted to the black during the same period. Operating income for the July-September period was 552.3 billion won ($411.4 million), while sales rose 13.1 percent on-year to 4.49 trillion won. Net profit was 411.8 billion won, shifting from a loss of 166.7 billion won the previous year.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国最大的移动通信运营商SK Telecom（SKT）周三表示，其第三季度营业利润同比增长1,041.3%，同期净利润也由亏转盈。7月至9月期间的营业利润为552.3亿韩元（4.114亿美元），营收同比增长13.1%，达到4.49万亿韩元。净利润为411.8亿韩元，而上年同期为亏损1,667亿韩元。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: SK Telecom (SKT), Korea's top mobile service carrier, said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit surged 1,041.3 percent from a year earlier, while its net profit shifted to the black during the same period. Operating income for the July-September period was 552.3 billion won ($411.4 million), while sales rose 13.1 percent on-year to 4.49 trillion won. Net profit was 411.8 billion won, shifting from a loss of 166.7 billion won the previous year. SK Telecom said the steady growth of its main mobile service business, as well as the rise of new ventures involving artificial intelligence (AI), helped improve its performance during the three-month period. Sales from its AI data centers rose 6.2 percent on-year, while those from other AI-related businesses were up 27.3 percent from a year earlier, the company said. The wireless carrier founded two new wholly owned subsidiaries — SK Hyper and SK Horizon — in July and August, respectively, to oversee its AI data center business. SK Hyper is constructing AI data centers in the southern region of Ulsan and Seoul, of which combined capacity will reach 180 megawatts. The company also plans to apply its indigenous AI foundation model to its enterprise AI services, while expanding its AI service ecosystem through its participation in the government-led AI service development project, SKT added. "We plan to connect mobile services and AI businesses into a single growth strategy and amplify the synergy between the two areas," an executive from SK Telecom said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: SKT第三季度营业利润增长逾1,000%，实现扭亏为盈
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国最大移动通信运营商SK电讯（SKT）周三表示，其第三季度营业利润同比增长1,041.3%，同期净利润也由亏转盈。7月至9月的营业利润为552.3亿韩元（4.114亿美元），营收同比增长13.1%，达到4.49万亿韩元。净利润为411.8亿韩元，而上年同期净亏损166.7亿韩元。SK电讯表示，核心移动通信服务业务的稳定增长，以及涉及人工智能（AI）的新兴业务扩张，推动公司在这三个月内的业绩提升。公司称，其人工智能数据中心的销售额同比增长6.2%，其他人工智能相关业务的销售额同比增长27.3%。这家无线运营商于7月和8月分别成立了两家全资子公司——SK Hyper和SK Horizon，负责管理其人工智能数据中心业务。SK Hyper正在蔚山南部地区和首尔建设人工智能数据中心，总容量将达到180兆瓦。公司还计划将其自主研发的人工智能基础模型应用于企业人工智能服务，并通过参与政府主导的人工智能服务开发项目，扩大其人工智能服务生态。SK电讯一名高管表示：“我们计划将移动通信服务和人工智能业务连接成统一的增长战略，并放大两个领域之间的协同效应。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 前韩国超模Kim Ja-yeon宣布45岁与Samsung高级主管Young Sohn结婚，并分享了两人的关系如何从一次学术联系逐渐发展为爱情故事。她的丈夫Young Sohn是Samsung Electronics顾问，也是Samsung旗下汽车技术与音频公司Harman International董事会主席。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Former Korean supermodel Kim Ja-yeon has announced her marriage at 45 to senior Samsung executive Young Sohn, sharing the story of how their relationship blossomed from an academic connection into romance. Kim announced the news on social media on Sunday, posting wedding photos alongside a message to her followers. Her husband is Young Sohn, a Samsung Electronics adviser and chairman of the board of Harman International, the automotive technology and audio company owned by Samsung. The couple held an intimate wedding ceremony in Switzerland. In the photos, Kim wears a wedding gown while Sohn appears in a tuxedo, with the newlyweds smiling affectionately at each other. Kim also introduced her husband's professional background, saying he previously served as president and chief strategy officer of Samsung Electronics and currently chairs Samsung's Semiconductor Advisory Board and Harman International's board of directors. He is also the founder of a Silicon Valley venture capital firm. Despite his prominent career, Kim emphasized that their relationship was built on personal connection rather than professional achievements. "We first met two years ago as fellow MIT alumni who had followed different paths in our respective fields," she said. "At first, we naturally got to know each other as alumni, but as we spent more time together, we gradually grew closer." Kim said their relationship turned romantic earlier this year. "After confirming our feelings for each other early this year, we traveled between the United States, Korea and Europe, learning to understand and respect each other's worlds," she said. She also expressed affection for her husband, describing his personality as more meaningful to her than his professional success. "More than all his achievements, my husband is a warmhearted person who genuinely cherishes and loves me and always treats me with consideration and respect," she said. "And he finds me, despite my tall height, incredibly cute." Following an outpouring of congratulations, Kim shared another message reflecting on finding love later in life. "Thank you so much for all the blessings and congratulations," she said. "I guess everyone has their own timing in life. Most people find their special someone much earlier, but for me, it happened well after I turned 40." Kim began her modeling career through the 12th Supermodel Contest in 2003 and went on to work internationally before becoming a fashion trend analyst. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 前韩国超模金佳妍宣布，45岁时与三星电子高管宋永结婚，并分享了两人的感情如何从学术交集发展成爱情的故事。金佳妍于周日在社交媒体上宣布这一消息，发布婚礼照片并向关注者留言。她的丈夫宋永是三星电子顾问，也是三星旗下汽车技术及音频公司Harman International董事长。两人在瑞士举行了温馨的婚礼。照片中，金佳妍身穿婚纱，宋永身着燕尾服，这对新婚夫妇面带深情笑容相互凝视。金佳妍还介绍了丈夫的职业经历，称他曾任三星电子总裁兼首席战略官，目前担任三星半导体顾问委员会主席及Harman International董事会主席。他还是一家硅谷风险投资机构的创始人。尽管事业成就显著，金佳妍强调，两人的感情建立在个人契合而非职业成就之上。她说：“我们两年前初次相遇时，都是麻省理工学院的校友，只是在各自领域走上了不同的道路。起初，我们作为校友自然地相互了解；随着相处时间增多，我们渐渐亲近起来。”金佳妍说，两人的关系在今年早些时候发展成爱情。她说：“今年早些时候确认彼此的心意后，我们在美国、韩国和欧洲之间旅行，学习理解和尊重彼此的世界。”她还表达了对丈夫的爱，称相比他的职业成功，他的人格对自己的意义更为重大。她说：“比起他取得的所有成就，我丈夫更是一个温暖体贴的人，他真心珍惜和爱护我，始终体贴我、尊重我。而且，尽管我个子很高，他仍觉得我非常可爱。”在收获大量祝贺后，金佳妍又分享了一段感悟人生较晚时找到真爱的消息。她说：“非常感谢大家的祝福和祝贺。我想，每个人都有自己的时间节奏。大多数人很早就找到了自己的另一半，而我则是在40岁过很久以后才遇到他。”金佳妍于2003年通过第12届超模大赛开启模特生涯，随后在国际舞台工作，后来成为时尚趋势分析师。她曾就读于纽约时装理工学院，学习时尚商业管理，之后获得麻省理工学院工商管理硕士学位，其研究重点是技术创新对时尚行业的影响。本文由Xportsnews提供，经生成式AI系统改编，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Investigators raided the National Election Commission (NEC) headquarters Wednesday over allegations of preferential treatment in choosing a ballot printer maker, a special counsel team said. Thirty-two personnel, including two prosecutors, were mobilized to search a division of the NEC at its headquarters in Gwacheon, just south of Seoul, and the office and factory of the company in question, according to the team led by special counsel Lee Tae-han. The team said it found evidence suggesting the election watchdog gave preferential treatment to the unnamed company by providing advance information on a bid to select a maker of early voting ballot issuing machines. The NEC is also suspected of revising its internal guidelines to require all local election commissions to purchase ink and other supplies from the chosen company. As a result, the company supplied around 17,000 ballot issuing machines to the commissions in a 32.1 billion-won ($24 million) project, the biggest commissioned by the NEC in the past five years, according to the independent counsel team. The company also supplied 13.8 billion won worth of ink and other supplies to the commissions between December 2023 and July 2026, it said. Lee's team has been investigating various suspected irregularities involving the NEC after it was launched in early September to look mainly into what led to the unprecedented ballot shortages in June's nationwide local elections. On Monday and Tuesday, the team searched the NEC over suspicions the election watchdog illegally paid commissioners monthly allowances

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un has visited the Nampho Shipyard and called for a rapid buildup of naval combat power to counter "hostile acts of the enemies," state media said Wednesday. Kim made the remarks during an on-site inspection at the shipyard Monday, where he was briefed on the shipyard's ongoing upgrades and inspected a new warship under construction, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported. "It is vital and important requirement of the times to rapidly bolster up the surface and underwater combat power for defending the national sovereignty in the sea under various threats," Kim said. "The recent geopolitical environment and hostile acts of the enemies in the region" prove the need for "the most developed and powerful warship," he added. On efforts to modernize the shipyard, Kim called for automating the production process, constructing a second ground dock so ships can be built and repaired at the same time, and fixing the "irrational" layout of its buildings. "The advanced and hi-tech shipbuilding base is essential for building a powerful naval force which no one can provoke," he said. North Korea has been accelerating its push to deploy naval assets with nuclear capabilities on both coasts, with the Choe Hyon in the West Sea and the Kang Kon in the East Sea. In September, the North commissioned the 5,000-ton Kang Kon destroyer, which it called part of a "nuclear counteraction system." It said, at that time, the ship would defend the country's maritime sovereignty as a "nuclear war deterrent." Three months earlier, the Choe Hyon was commissioned into active service. Earlier this year, Pyongyang unveiled plans to build two large warships of over 5,000 tons over the next five years

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Korea has called for stronger cooperation among Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) members to build stable energy supply chains amid the region's vulnerability to crises in the Middle East, the foreign ministry said Wednesday. Second Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jina made the call during the 37th APEC Ministerial Meeting held via videoconference the previous day, according to the ministry. Co-chaired by Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Commerce Minister Wang Wentao, the meeting brought together foreign and trade ministers from the 21 APEC member economies to discuss ways to foster cooperation for an Asia-Pacific community and advance regional economic integration. Kim stressed the need for closer cooperation among APEC members to strengthen regional energy resilience and diversify energy supplies. On artificial intelligence (AI), Kim called for stronger cooperation based on the APEC AI Initiative, launched under Korea's leadership at last year's APEC summit in Gyeongju. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Korea and Poland have discussed ways to strengthen cooperation in defense, energy, batteries and infrastructure, as the two countries seek to build on agreements reached at their leaders' summit in April, Seoul's foreign ministry said Wednesday. The seventh round of their joint economic committee took place in Warsaw on Tuesday (local time), co-chaired by Park Jong-han, deputy minister for economic affairs, and Michal Baranowski, Poland's deputy minister of economic development and technology, according to the ministry. During the meeting, the two sides reviewed progress in implementing agreements reached at the summit between President Lee Jae Myung and Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk in April and discussed ways to expand cooperation across key sectors. Park and Baranowski agreed to explore ways to expand defense cooperation, building on Poland's purchases of Korean K2 tanks, K9 howitzers and Chunmoo rocket launchers. They also discussed cooperation in battery and energy supply chains, infrastructure projects, including a new airport link, and such advanced technologies as space and digital technology. The two sides also agreed to establish a high-level government channel to promote stable trade, investment and supply chains, the ministry said. Separately, Park met with Ignacy Niemczycki, Poland's deputy foreign minister for European Union and economic affairs, and called for Warsaw's support to ensure that Korea is not excluded from local-content requirements under the bloc's proposed Industrial Accelerator Act (IAA), which seeks to boost the bloc's industrial competitiveness
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国和波兰讨论扩大防务、能源及基础设施合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
韩国和波兰已讨论加强防务、能源、电池及基础设施领域合作的方法，以推进两国在4月领导人峰会达成的协议。韩国外交部周三表示，两国经济委员会第七次会议于当地时间周二在华沙举行，由经济事务副部长朴钟汉和波兰经济发展与技术部副部长米哈乌·巴拉诺夫斯基共同主持。

据该部介绍，会议期间，双方审议了4月韩国总统李在明与波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克举行首脑会谈时达成协议的落实情况，并讨论了扩大关键领域合作的方案。

朴钟汉和巴拉诺夫斯基同意在波兰采购韩国K2坦克、K9自行榴弹炮和“天橆”火箭发射器的基础上，研究扩大防务合作的方法。双方还讨论了电池和能源供应链、包括新机场连接线在内的基础设施项目，以及航天和数字技术等先进技术领域的合作。

该部表示，双方还同意建立政府间高级别沟通渠道，以促进贸易、投资和供应链稳定。

此外，朴钟汉会见了波兰负责欧盟及经济事务的副外长伊格纳齐·涅姆奇茨基，呼吁华沙支持韩国，确保韩国不会被排除在该集团拟议中的《工业加速法案》（IAA）本地含量要求之外。该法案旨在提升该集团的产业竞争力。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: An appeals court was set to rule Wednesday on former President Yoon Suk Yeol's election law violation case in a ruling that could force the main opposition party to cough up nearly $30 million in election expenses, if finalized. The Seoul High Court was scheduled to hold the hearing at 2 p.m., which will be televised live, over allegations that Yoon made false statements during his presidential campaign as a candidate for the PPP before his March 2022 election. A district court sentenced Yoon to an 18-month prison term, suspended for three years, in July after finding him guilty of the charges. If the sentence is finalized through appeals, Yoon's election will be nullified and the People Power Party will be forced to return its reimbursed election expenses of 39.7 billion won ($29.5 million). Under the election law, the state fully reimburses political parties for campaign spending if their candidate wins at least 15 percent of the vote. Parties, however, must return all reimbursed funds if the candidate receives a finalized prison sentence or a fine of at least 1 million won for election law violations — a penalty that also voids their election. Yoon was charged with falsely claiming during a December 2021 press event that he had not introduced a lawyer to a former tax official — a brother of Yoon's close associate when he was a prosecutor. He also faces charges of lying in a January 2022 interview by claiming that a party official had introduced him to shaman Jeon Seong-bae while denying that he and his wife, Kim Keon Hee, had met Jeon together. The jailed former president has been standing multiple criminal trials since his failed bid to impose martial law in December 2024 and his subsequent ouster from office. A district court sentenced him to life in prison in February for leading an insurrection through his martial law bid. That trial is currently under review by an appellate court
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 上诉法院将就前总统尹锡悦涉及选举法的重大案件作出裁决
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 上诉法院定于周三就韩国前总统尹锡悦违反选举法一案作出裁决；如果裁决最终成立，可能迫使主要反对党返还近3000万美元的选举费用。首尔高等法院定于下午2时开庭审理此案，届时将进行现场直播。案件涉及一项指控：尹锡悦在参加2022年3月选举、以人民.power党候选人身份竞选总统期间，曾作出虚假陈述。地区法院于7月裁定尹锡悦有罪，判处其18个月监禁，缓刑3年。如果上诉后维持判决，尹锡悦的当选结果将被取消，人民.power党将被迫返还已报销的397亿韩元（2950万美元）选举费用。根据选举法，如果政党候选人获得至少15%的选票，国家将全额报销该党的竞选支出。然而，如果候选人因违反选举法而最终获判监禁或处以至少100万韩元罚款，该党必须返还所有已报销款项，这一处罚也将使其选举结果作废。尹锡悦被指控在2021年12月的一次新闻发布会上虚假声称，他未曾让律师引荐一名前税务官员；此人是一名与其担任检察官时关系密切人士的兄弟。他还面临另一项指控：他在2022年1月接受采访时撒谎，称由一名党内官员引荐他认识巫师全圣培，同时否认他与妻子金建希曾共同会见全圣培。自2024年12月试图实施戒严、随后被免职以来，这名遭羁押的前总统一直在应对多项刑事审判。地区法院于2月判处其无期徒刑，认定他通过戒严行动领导了一场叛乱。目前，该案正在上诉法院审查中
