https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 如果情况确实如此，推迟移交接战时作战指挥权实际上可能加剧韩国的安全结构性脆弱。自韩国和美国于2007年正式同意移交接战时作战指挥权以来，已近20年。移交接战时作战指挥权不仅出于原则和恢复军事主权的需要，也是大韩民国自身安全所必需的。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: The long-standing debate over the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) is once again emerging as a contentious issue in the ROK-U.S. alliance. The Lee Jae Myung administration has repeatedly expressed its determination to accelerate the transfer, while the Trump administration remains reluctant, emphasizing the need to meet the agreed conditions. The fact that the Security Consultative Meeting (SCM), at which the two sides were expected to discuss and finalize a roadmap for the transfer, has been postponed until next year suggests that their differences remain unresolved. There is a real possibility that the OPCON issue could become a source of friction in the alliance. The sensitivity and importance of this issue stem from its direct connection to two fundamental values: sovereignty and security. From the perspective of national sovereignty, the commander-in-chief should be able to exercise full command authority over the country's own armed forces. President Lee has also stressed that South Korea cannot continue to leave its military sovereignty in the hands of another country. From a security perspective, however, there are concerns that changing the command structure without adequate preparation could weaken deterrence. This is why meeting the conditions for the transfer has been given such strong emphasis. The tension between sovereignty and security has led to repeated delays over the years. However, given the profound changes in the international order and the increasingly transactional nature of U.S. alliance policy, it is time to move beyond the conventional thinking that treats sovereignty and security as competing values. Excessive dependence on American support can no longer be regarded as an entirely reliable foundation for South Korea's security. The Trump administration has made it clear that its security commitment to the Korean Peninsula will take the form of support that is "decisive but more limited." For many years, analysts have pointed out that a large-scale deployment of additional U.S. ground forces in the event of a crisis on the Korean Peninsula is unlikely, and that support centered on air and naval forces is a more realistic scenario. If this is the case, delaying the transfer of OPCON could actually increase structural vulnerabilities in South Korea's security. As U.S. security commitments to the Korean Peninsula evolve, maintaining a U.S.-led command structure could widen the gap between the actual level of American involvement and the current framework of the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command. Developing the South Korean military's own capabilities to plan and conduct military operations must therefore be treated as an urgent security priority, not something that can be postponed indefinitely. The transfer of OPCON is about much more than operational command. A military that does not plan its own wars will find it difficult to develop independent strategic thinking, no matter how large or powerful it becomes. Establishing a South Korean-led operational command structure is essential for the country to take the initiative in developing military strategies, determining the direction of force modernization, and designing its future military structure. You cannot improve your driving skills by remaining in the passenger seat; you have to take the wheel yourself. Greater strategic autonomy resulting from the transfer would also have a positive impact on how North Korea and neighboring countries, including China, perceive and deal with South Korea. The ROK-U.S. alliance, in turn, could evolve into a healthier and more mutually beneficial partnership. Rather than viewing changes in the Trump administration's alliance policy solely as a weakening of American commitments, South Korea should seize this opportunity to make the alliance more sustainable by expanding its own capabilities and shouldering greater responsibility. A sober look at our history reveals that since the establishment of the Republic of Korea there have been very few periods during which South Korea has exercised full military command authority over its own armed forces. This was largely due to the unavoidable security realities and historical circumstances. However, after living with these constraints on military sovereignty for so long, we have arguably become accustomed to what should be recognized as an abnormal situation that needs to be corrected. Nearly two decades have passed since South Korea and the United States formally agreed in 2007 to transfer wartime OPCON. During this period, South Korea's national power and military capabilities have grown dramatically. However, the requirements have become increasingly demanding. New tasks and expectations continue to be added by the U.S. side. It is much like a high-jump competition in which the bar keeps being raised higher and higher. It is time, therefore, to move beyond the recurring concerns about insufficient preparation and arguments that the transfer is premature, which have persisted for decades. South Korea's military capabilities have grown considerably, and the evolving nature of the ROK-U.S. alliance, as well as the changing division of responsibilities between the two countries, makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the status quo. The transfer of wartime OPCON is necessary not only as a matter of principle and the restoration of military sovereignty, but also for the security of the Republic of Korea itself. Moreover, this should not be approached simply as an attempt to reclaim something the United States is reluctant to give up in the name of sovereignty. Instead, South Korea should engage Washington from the perspective of redesigning the alliance for the future and building a genuine partnership based on shared responsibilities and mutual respect
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 超越主权问题：为何将战时作战指挥权移交给韩国对韩国安全至关重要
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 围绕战时作战指挥权移交的长期争论，再次成为韩国与美国同盟关系中的争议焦点。李在明政府多次表示决心加快移交进程，而特朗普政府仍持谨慎态度，强调需要满足双方商定的条件。原本预计双方将在安全咨询会议上讨论并敲定移交路线图，但会议已推迟至明年，这表明双方分歧仍未解决。战时作战指挥权移交问题确实有可能成为同盟关系中的摩擦源。这一问题既敏感又重要，直接关联主权与安全两项根本价值。从国家主权角度看，最高指挥官应能对本国武装部队行使完整的指挥权。李总统还强调，韩国不能继续把军事主权交由他国掌握。然而，从安全角度看，人们担心在准备不足的情况下改变指挥体系可能削弱威慑能力。因此，移交条件受到了极大重视。主权与安全之间的紧张关系多年来反复导致移交延期。但鉴于国际秩序发生深刻变化，美国同盟政策日益呈现交易化特征，是时候摆脱将主权与安全视为相互竞争价值的传统思维。过度依赖美国支持，已不能再被视为保障韩国安全的完全可靠基础。特朗普政府已明确表示，其对朝鲜半岛的安全承诺将采取“果断但更为有限”的支持形式。多年来，分析人士一直指出，朝鲜半岛发生危机时，美国大规模增派地面部队的可能性不大，以空中和海上力量为核心的支持才是更现实的方案。若情况果真如此，推迟战时作战指挥权移交反而可能加剧韩国安全的结构性脆弱性。随着美国对朝鲜半岛安全承诺的变化，维持由美国主导的指挥体系，可能扩大美国实际参与程度与韩美联合司令部现行框架之间的落差。因此，发展韩国军方自行规划和实施军事行动的能力，必须被视为紧迫的安全优先事项，不能无限期拖延。战时作战指挥权移交的意义远不止于作战指挥本身。一支不规划自身战争的军队，无论规模多大、实力多强，都难以形成独立的战略思维。建立由韩国主导的作战指挥体系，对于韩国主动制定军事战略、确定部队现代化方向以及设计未来军队结构至关重要。不能指望坐在副驾驶座上提高驾驶技术，必须亲自握住方向盘。移交带来的更高战略自主权，也将积极影响朝鲜以及包括中国在内的邻国如何看待和处理韩国。韩国与美国同盟关系也由此可能发展成更健康、更互惠的伙伴关系。韩国不应仅把特朗普政府同盟政策的变化视为美国承诺削弱，而应抓住机遇，通过扩大自身能力、承担更大责任，使同盟关系更具可持续性。冷静回顾历史可知，大韩民国成立以来，韩国能够对本国武装部队行使完整军事指挥权的时期极少。这在很大程度上是受制于难以回避的安全现实和历史条件。然而，在长期受这种军事主权限制的情况下，我们或许已经习惯了一种本应被视为不正常、需要加以纠正的局面。自韩国与美国在2007年正式同意移交战时作战指挥权以来，已近二十年。在此期间，韩国的综合国力和军事能力显著增强，但移交条件也变得越来越苛刻，美方不断提出新的任务和期望。这就像一场跳高比赛，横杆一次又一次被升高。因此，是时候摆脱数十年来反复出现的准备不足担忧和“移交为时过早”的论争。韩国军事能力已有大幅提升，而韩美同盟关系的演变以及两国责任分工的变化，也使维持现状变得日益困难。移交战时作战指挥权，不仅是出于原则和恢复军事主权的需要，也是保障大韩民国自身安全的必要之举。此外，不应仅仅把此举视为以主权名义收回美国不愿交出的东西。韩国应从面向未来重新设计同盟、基于共同责任和相互尊重建立真正伙伴关系的角度，与华盛顿展开对话

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: Senior officials of S. Korea, Switzerland discuss N. Korea situation after Swiss FM's Pyongyang trip
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Korea and Switzerland have discussed bilateral cooperation and the situation on the Korean Peninsula following the Swiss foreign minister's recent visit to North Korea, Seoul's foreign ministry said Wednesday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国和瑞士已就双边合作以及朝鲜半岛局势进行磋商。首尔外交部周三表示， discussions 源于瑞士外长近期访问朝鲜。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Senior officials of South Korea and Switzerland have discussed bilateral cooperation and the situation on the Korean Peninsula following the Swiss foreign minister's recent visit to North Korea, Seoul's foreign ministry said Wednesday. Deputy Foreign Minister for Political Affairs Chung Eui-hae held the seventh round of bilateral policy consultations with Markus Leitner, Switzerland's assistant state secretary, in Seoul on Tuesday and exchanged views on major regional issues, including the situation on the Korean Peninsula and in Northeast Asia, according to the ministry. Chung called for Switzerland's continued interest and cooperation on Korean Peninsula issues, while praising the country's contributions to peace and stability on the peninsula over the past seven decades through its role in the Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission (NNSC). The NNSC is an independent body tasked with monitoring the implementation of the Armistice Agreement that halted the 1950-53 Korean War. Switzerland has maintained diplomatic relations with North Korea since 1974. Chung also called for expanding exchanges and cooperation through high-level visits and policy consultations. The consultations came after Swiss Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis visited North Korea on Oct. 29-30, where he met with North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui. Cassis then traveled to South Korea on Friday and briefed National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac and Jeong Yeon-doo, vice foreign minister responsible for North Korea affairs, on the outcome of his trip. Cassis' visit was the first by a Swiss foreign minister to North Korea since 2003. During his meetings with North Korean officials, the two sides discussed promoting dialogue and cooperation between their diplomatic services, as well as international issues of mutual concern, according to North Korea's state media. Leitner noted the progress in economic cooperation between South Korea and Switzerland, as this year marks the 20th anniversary of the free trade agreement between South Korea and the European Free Trade Association (EFTA). The two sides also agreed to strengthen cooperation in emerging technology fields, including artificial intelligence (AI), digital technology and biotechnology, the ministry said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 瑞士外长访问平壤后，韩国和瑞士高级官员讨论朝鲜局势
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国和瑞士高级官员就双边合作以及朝鲜半岛局势进行了讨论。韩国首尔外交部周三表示，继瑞士外交部长最近访问朝鲜后，双方进行了上述磋商。政治事务副外长郑义夏周二在首尔与瑞士助理国务秘书马克斯·莱特纳举行第七轮双边政策磋商，并就朝鲜半岛和东北亚局势等重大地区问题交换意见。该部表示，郑义夏呼吁瑞士继续关注朝鲜半岛问题并开展合作，同时赞扬瑞士过去70年来通过参与中立国监督委员会（NNSC），为半岛和平与稳定作出的贡献。中立国监督委员会是一个独立机构，负责监督《停战协定》的执行情况；该协定结束了1950年至1953年的朝鲜战争。瑞士自1974年起与朝鲜保持外交关系。郑义夏还呼吁通过高层访问和政策磋商扩大双方交流与合作。此次磋商是在瑞士外交部长Ignazio Cassis于10月29日至30日访问朝鲜后举行的。Cassis在朝鲜会见了朝鲜外相崔善 Hui。随后，Cassis于周五前往韩国，向韩国国家安全顾问 Wi Sung-lac 和负责朝鲜事务的副外长 Jeong Yeon-doo 通报其访问成果。这是自2003年以来首位访问朝鲜的瑞士外交部长。据朝鲜官方媒体报道，Cassis与朝鲜官员会面期间，双方讨论了促进两国外交部门对话与合作，以及共同关心的国际问题。莱特纳指出，韩国与瑞士之间的经济合作取得进展，今年是韩国与欧洲自由贸易联盟（EFTA）自由贸易协定签署20周年。该部表示，双方还同意加强在人工智能（AI）、数字技术和生物技术等新兴技术领域的合作。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: “Korea's current strength in the AI supply chain is largely because high bandwidth memory (HBM) has fortunately become a critical component of AI accelerators,” Kim said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 金表示：“韩国目前之所以能在人工智能供应链中占据较强优势，很大程度上是因为高带宽存储器（HBM）恰好已成为人工智能加速器的关键部件。”因此，韩国需要在人工智能供应链中确保不可或缺的地位。他说，这种相互依赖不仅可能让韩国作为技术供应商对美国更加不可或缺，也可能让韩国成为人工智能时代的战略伙伴。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: They suggested that Korea could secure a unique position in the global AI landscape by leveraging its manufacturing capabilities, industrial know-how and advanced semiconductor supply chain, as well as building AI infrastructure that would deepen its strategic importance to the U.S. and its allies. Lee Do-kyung, founder and CEO of Bone AI, proposed developing Korea into a “forward-deployed industrial base” for the U.S. and its allies, combining American technologies with Korea's manufacturing capabilities to produce, deploy and maintain AI-powered systems in the Indo-Pacific region. “Even if a single motor breaks down, a drone cannot operate, and sourcing new parts from the U.S. mainland can take three to four months by sea,” Lee said. “The U.S. and its allies need partners that can manufacture and repair equipment locally, deploy and operate it in the field and help build the industrial capabilities needed to sustain attritable systems, drones and other robotic systems in operational environments.” An attritable military system is designed to be cheap enough to lose in combat without significantly affecting overall operational capabilities. Drones, a prime example, are playing an increasingly critical role in modern conflicts. Lee said Gen. Xavier Brunson, commander of U.S. Forces Korea, has also expressed the need for partners to help the U.S. military in Korea expand such capabilities. The capability Lee was referring to has a broader meaning than simply manufacturing drones or developing AI models. It involves operational knowledge that only companies working in the field can accumulate, such as understanding why a system fails in real-world conditions and how to repair and operate them effectively. Lim Jong-in, former presidential cybersecurity adviser and Soongsil University AI committee chair, also stressed that Korea should not abandon competition in frontier AI models, but should simultaneously explore how to apply the tacit knowledge accumulated through decades of manufacturing experience to physical AI. Tacit knowledge refers to practical expertise and know-how gained through experience that is difficult to record in traditional documentation. “One example is Korea’s shipbuilding sector,” Lim said. “Welding ships requires skills and know-how that workers acquire through years of experience. Korea is already struggling to find enough skilled workers for these jobs. What we need to do — and what the industry is already working on — is turn the tacit knowledge accumulated by these experienced craftsmen into a structured set of data that can be used to train humanoid robots.” Reform Party of Korea Rep. Lee Jun-seok also agreed, saying that China's dominance in humanoid robots does not mean Korea is shut out of opportunities in physical AI. “What we need to question is whether humanoid robots are optimal for industrial use,” he said. “In Star Wars, we can see both R2-D2 and C-3PO. The question is whether factories would be better served by specialized robots like R2-D2 or humanoid robots like C-3PO. “If we think about what kind of physical AI robots Korea should develop, the answer could be specialized machines such as welding robots. At a robotics exhibition in China, dancing humanoids attracted the most attention, but the booths that drew the most buyers were those showcasing robots specialized in cleaning toilets.” Kim Sung-han, former national security adviser and professor emeritus of international relations at Korea University, said such efforts should be accompanied by a broader strategy to make Korea indispensable across the AI supply chain. “Korea's current strength in the AI supply chain is largely because high bandwidth memory (HBM) has fortunately become a critical component of AI accelerators,” Kim said. “But there are lingering concerns about when this cycle will end. Korea therefore needs to secure an indispensable position in the AI supply chain. To do so, we must build our own ecosystem, including advanced packaging technologies.” Rep. Lee also proposed turning Korea into a global AI infrastructure hub by combining its strengths in semiconductors, energy and telecommunications to host large-scale data centers and undersea cable networks. “A friend of mine in the data center industry once joked that Korea is an ideal location for U.S. data centers because of its roughly 12-hour time difference, which could help operators optimize their operations by distributing computing workloads across different time zones,” Lee said. “I believe it is extremely important to build an infrastructure ecosystem centered on Korea. Even if companies do business with China, they would not want to locate their data centers or management operations in a country where data sovereignty could be at risk.” Rep. Lee argued that hosting critical U.S. AI infrastructure could also strengthen Korea's strategic importance to Washington by creating a “tripwire” effect, in which any threat to Korean data centers or communications networks would directly affect American interests. Such interdependence, he said, could make Korea more indispensable to the U.S. not only as a technology supplier, but also as a strategic partner in the AI era
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 【圆桌会议】韩国蓝图：成为人工智能领域不可或缺的重要力量
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 他们认为，韩国可以利用其制造能力、专有工业知识和先进的半导体供应链，并建设人工智能基础设施，从而在全球人工智能格局中确立独特地位；这也将深化韩国对美国及其盟友的战略重要性。Bone AI创始人兼首席执行官Lee Do-kyung提议，将韩国建设成美国及其盟友的“前沿部署工业基地”，把美国技术与韩国的制造能力结合起来，在印太地区生产、部署和维护人工智能驱动的系统。Lee说：“即便只有一台电机出了故障，无人机也无法运作，而从美国本土海运新零件需要三到四个月。美国及其盟友需要能够在当地制造和维修设备、在现场部署和运行设备，并帮助建设维持可消耗武器系统、无人机和其他机器人系统在作战环境中持续运作所需工业能力的伙伴。”可消耗军事系统的设计成本足够低，即使在战斗中损失，也不会对整体作战能力造成显著影响。无人机就是其中的典型例子，正在现代冲突中发挥日益关键的作用。Lee说，驻韩美军司令Xavier Brunson将军也提出，需要合作伙伴帮助美国在韩国的军队扩大此类能力。Lee所指的能力，其含义比单纯制造无人机或开发人工智能模型更为广泛。它涉及只有在现场工作的公司才能积累的实战知识，例如了解系统为何会在现实条件下发生故障，以及如何有效维修和操作这些系统。前总统网络安全顾问、延世大学人工智能委员会主席Lim Jong-in也强调，韩国不应放弃在前沿人工智能模型领域的竞争，同时应探索如何把数十年制造经验积累的隐性知识应用于实体人工智能。隐性知识是指通过经验获得、难以记录在传统文件中的实践技能和专门知识。Lim说：“一个例子就是韩国的造船业。焊接船舶需要工人通过多年经验掌握的技能和诀窍。韩国目前已经难以找到足够多的技术工人从事这些工作。我们需要做的，也是该行业正在推进的，就是把这些经验丰富的工匠所积累的隐性知识转化为结构化的数据集，用于训练人形机器人。”韩国改革党议员Lee Jun-seok也表示认同，称中国在人形机器人领域占据主导地位，并不意味着韩国在实体人工智能领域被排除在机会之外。他说：“我们需要质疑的是，人形机器人是否最适合工业用途。在《星球大战》中，我们既能看到R2-D2，也能看到C-3PO。问题在于，与R2-D2这类专用机器人相比，还是与C-3PO这类人形机器人相比，工厂能够获得更好的服务。如果我们思考韩国应开发何种实体人工智能机器人，答案可能是焊接机器人之类的专用机器。在中国的一次机器人展览上，会跳舞的人形机器人吸引了最多关注，但吸引最多买家的是那些展示清洁厕所专用机器人的展台。”前国家安全顾问、高等大学国际关系名誉教授Kim Sung-han表示，此类努力还应配合一项更广泛的战略，使韩国在整个人工智能供应链中变得不可或缺。Kim说：“韩国目前之所以在人工智能供应链中拥有较强实力，主要是因为高带宽内存（HBM）幸运地成为人工智能加速器的关键部件。但这一周期何时结束，仍令人担忧。因此，韩国需要在人工智能供应链中确立不可或缺的地位。要做到这一点，我们必须建立自己的生态系统，其中包括先进封装技术。”Lee议员还提议，把韩国的半导体、能源和电信优势结合起来，承载大规模数据中心和海底电缆网络，将韩国打造为全球人工智能基础设施中心。Lee说：“我有一位从事数据中心行业的朋友曾开玩笑说，由于韩国与美国大约存在12小时的时差，韩国是美国数据中心的理想地点，这有助于运营方通过在不同时间区之间分配计算工作负荷来优化运营。我相信，打造一个以韩国为中心的基础设施生态极为重要。即便企业与中国开展业务，也不会愿意把数据中心或管理运营机构设在数据主权可能面临风险的国家。”Lee议员认为，承载关键美国人工智能基础设施，还能通过形成“绊线效应”加强韩国对华盛顿的战略重要性，即任何针对韩国数据中心或通信网络的威胁，都会直接影响美国利益。他说，这种相互依赖不仅能让韩国作为技术供应商对美国更加不可或缺，也能使其成为人工智能时代的战略伙伴

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 正统犹太联盟驻首尔机构推广犹太洁食标签。美国历史最悠久的正统犹太组织的一名助理表示，希望拓展北美和欧洲等全球市场的企业，应考虑申请正统犹太联盟认证；这是正统犹太联盟批准的一种犹太洁食标签。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Orthodox Union's Seoul operation promotes kosher label Companies seeking to expand into global markets like North America and Europe should consider applying for OU certification, a kosher label approved by the Orthodox Union, according to an associate of the oldest Orthodox Jewish organization in the United States. Steve Hong, certification sales agent for the New York City-based group operating OU Kosher worldwide, said that to get mainstream distribution in the U.S., Canada and Europe, Korean food firms should seek to certify their products with OU, the most widespread kosher certification label in those regions. He said over 1.3 million kosher products manufactured at 15,000 plants in 105 countries have been certified with OU. That is over 70 percent of all kosher products being distributed worldwide. Hong said the majority of kosher food products at Costco and Walmart stores in the U.S. are OU-labeled. According to OU Kosher, 71 percent of kosher products at 190 Ralph’s Supermarkets stores in California and 66 percent of kosher products at Stop & Shop stores in the northeastern U.S. have been certified by OU Kosher, while the remainders are labeled with other kosher certifications like OK, Kof-K or Star-K. OU’s presence goes beyond consumers who need to adhere to traditional Jewish dietary laws. According to a WAC Survey and Strategic Consulting’s report from 2016, nearly 80 percent of all kosher food sales worldwide were to non-kosher shoppers. “Kosher products draw over 12 million shoppers in the U.S. each year and their sales are over $150 billion per year. Major distributors in the U.S. are recognizing OU as the de facto quality standard. That’s why OU-labelled products are directly connected to the American customers with strong consumption,” Hong said in his interview with The Korea Times. The problem is that the majority of small- and medium-size firms (SMEs) in Korea, which constitute the bulk of the Korean food industry, do not know about OU, according to Hong. While large firms like Daesang, Nongshim, CJ, Pulmuone, Samyang Foods, Dongsuh Foods and Dongwon Systems have already had their manufacturing plants pass certification standards for the label, SMEs without enough production capacity for global markets have not yet prepared for it. As of this year, 87 companies in Korea passed standards for OU Kosher. That accounts for just 0.27 percent of the Korean food manufacturing industry. “Many Korean firms misunderstand OU or other kosher labels as a Jewish requirement and don’t realize the labels’ market power. They also don’t know how critical the labels are to the local distributors like Costco or Walmart. Korean SMEs, unlike the large firms, mostly operate domestically. Lastly, OU Kosher hasn’t invested enough in reaching out to Korean firms,” Hong said. Hong compared kosher labels to those for halal foods, breaking down the global markets for both certifications. He concluded products with halal labels have access to a worldwide market estimated between $1.6 trillion to $2.5 trillion, which overshadows kosher’s $22 billion market, but have higher hurdles to reach local consumer bases than kosher. “We must understand that even K-food products with halal labels can only reach a portion of local consumers. They are the top-percentile consumer groups who can afford premium imports. Furthermore, not many Muslim nations have advanced retail chain systems like major cities in the U.S.,” Hong said. “Many Korean firms began learning about halal certifications in 2016, but started with wrong information. They found their halal products exported to major economies around the world didn’t rack up as much as they anticipated in sales. They in turn learned about kosher certifications from local consultants and started gearing toward the kosher labels instead in 2020.” OU Kosher, established by the Orthodox Union in 1923, dispatches a rabbinical field inspector to facilities of companies interested in OU certification. What each inspection focuses on is assessing sources of ingredients used, checking whether meat and dairy are properly separated and how long each pipeline has been in operation. The six-step assessment procedure, whether the facilities’ export target countries are in North America or Europe, is the same. This is different from halal labels, which are issued by different authorities across more than 50 countries and have varying standards. The field inspector sends reports to the Orthodox Union’s headquarters which later issues a self-printable OU label online. “The field inspector for Korea also covers India and Southeast Asian nations. Companies here, meanwhile, get subsidized by the government and pay just 30 percent of the administration fee for the certification,” Hong said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 为何更多韩国食品品牌需要获得“OU”认证才能进入全球市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh:
正统犹太工会驻首尔机构推广犹太洁食认证标签

美国历史最悠久的正统犹太组织的一名顾问表示，希望拓展北美和欧洲等全球市场的企业，应考虑申请正统犹太工会认证。这是正统犹太工会批准的犹太洁食标签。

负责在 全球开展 OU Kosher 业务的纽约市组织，其认证销售代理人 Steve Hong 表示，企业若要在美国、加拿大和欧洲获得主流渠道销售，食品企业应寻求用 OU 对产品进行认证。OU 是上述地区应用最广泛的犹太洁食认证标签。

他说，全球105个国家的1.5万家工厂生产的逾130万件犹太洁食产品已获得 OU 认证，占全球流通的全部犹太洁食产品的70%以上。

Hong 表示，美国 Costco 和 Walmart 门店销售的大多数犹太洁食食品均带有 OU 标签。

据 OU Kosher 介绍，加利福尼亚州190家 Ralph’s Supermarkets 门店中71%的犹太洁食产品、美国东北部 Stop & Shop 门店中66%的犹太洁食产品均获得 OU Kosher 认证，其余产品则标有 OK、Kof-K 或 Star-K 等其他犹太洁食认证。

OU 的影响力并不限于需要遵守传统犹太饮食法规的消费者。根据 WAC Survey and Strategic Consulting 2016年的报告，全球近80%的犹太洁食食品销售额来自并非购买犹太洁食食品的消费者。

Hong 在接受《韩国时报》采访时表示：“犹太洁食产品每年在美国吸引逾1200万名消费者，销售额超过1500亿美元。美国的大型经销商正将 OU 视为事实上的质量标准。因此，带有 OU 标签的产品能够直接触达消费能力强劲的美国消费者。”

Hong 表示，问题在于，构成韩国食品工业主体的多数中小型企业在韩国并不了解 OU。Daesang、Nongshim、CJ、Pulmuone、Samyang Foods、Dongsuh Foods 和 Dongwon Systems 等大型企业的生产基地已经通过该标签的认证标准，但缺乏足够全球市场生产能力的中小企业尚未为此做好准备。

截至今年，韩国共有87家公司通过 OU Kosher 标准，仅占韩国食品制造业的0.27%。

Hong 表示：“许多韩国企业误以为 OU 或其他犹太洁食标签是犹太人的必备要求，没有认识到这些标签的市场潜力。他们也不了解这些标签对 Costco 或 Walmart 等当地经销商有多关键。与大企业不同，韩国中小企业大多只在国内经营。最后，OU Kosher 在接触和拓展韩国企业方面投入不足。”

Hong 将犹太洁食标签与清真食品标签进行比较，分解了两种认证各自对应的全球市场。他总结称，带有清真标签的产品可进入规模估计在1.6万亿至2.5万亿美元之间的全球市场，这一规模远超规模为220亿美元的犹太洁食市场，但清真产品触达当地消费者群体的门槛也高于犹太洁食产品。

他说：“我们必须认识到，即使是带有清真标签的 K-food 产品，也只能触达一部分当地消费者。他们属于负担得起高端进口产品的顶尖消费群体。此外，并非有许多穆斯林国家拥有美国主要城市那样成熟的零售连锁体系。”

他说：“许多韩国企业从2016年开始了解清真认证，但最初掌握的信息并不准确。他们发现出口到全球主要经济体的清真产品，销售额未达到预期，于是转而通过当地咨询机构了解犹太洁食认证，并从2020年开始转向申请犹太洁食标签。”

OU Kosher 由正统犹太工会于1923年设立。负责 OU 认证的现场检查员会派往有意申请认证的企业设施，逐一检查每家工厂，重点评估原料来源、肉类与乳制品是否妥善隔离，以及各条生产线运行了多长时间。无论这些设施的出口目标国是北美还是欧洲，六步评估程序都完全相同。这与清真标签不同，后者的标准不一，且由50多个国家的不同机构签发。

现场检查员会向正统犹太工会总部提交报告，随后由总部在线签发可自行打印的 OU 标签。

Hong 表示：“负责韩国的现场检查员同时负责印度和东南亚国家。与此同时，这里企业可以得到政府补贴，只需承担认证管理费的30%。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Every space has a story: Urbanplay connects people with local culture
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: For Urbanplay CEO Hong Joo-seok, every space has a story of its own. Founded in 2013, Urbanplay connects brands and local creators with audiences through physical spaces. Beyond helping local businesses attract visitors, Urbanplay also seeks to introduce international audiences to Korea's regional culture and identity.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Urbanplay首席执行官洪柱锡认为，每一处空间都有自己的故事。Urbanplay成立于2013年，通过实体空间连接品牌、本地创作者与受众。除了帮助本地企业吸引顾客外，Urbanplay还希望让国际受众了解韩国的地域文化与身份认同。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: This is the third in a series of interviews with the heads of promising startups that are pioneers of their respective fields and seek to go public in the near future. In Korea, cafes are no longer just places to grab a cup of coffee. They are increasingly becoming cultural venues where visitors can discover local brands, browse curated products and exhibitions and sample menus developed in collaboration with local businesses. The shift extends beyond cafes, with retail spaces doubling as venues for exhibitions, performances and pop-up events. For Urbanplay CEO Hong Joo-seok, every space has a story of its own. He believes the value of a physical space lies not simply in its design, but in the experiences it offers and the stories it tells visitors. "It is important to carefully plan what kind of content visitors will experience and what services can keep them connected to a brand even after the experience ends," Hong said in a recent interview with The Korea Times. "We are not a company that simply designs the physical structure of a space. We plan the content inside it and design the user experience," he added. Founded in 2013, Urbanplay connects brands and local creators with audiences through physical spaces. Rather than designing buildings or interiors itself, the company develops the concepts and content for each space and oversees its business planning and operations. It also works with architectural firms and construction companies on detailed designs and construction. Hong likened Urbanplay's role to that of an operating system for a city. He said the company has developed its own Urbanplay OS, drawing on 13 years of accumulated data. "Through this system, we can anticipate changes in the offline environment, recommend content suited to our partners and simulate how spaces can be planned and operated," he said. The company's projects range from neighborhood cultural venues to corporate spaces and large-scale exhibitions. For example, Yeonnam Bangagan, a cafe and curated lifestyle store with locations near Seoul Station and at Dongdaemun Design Plaza, showcases local brands, artists and seasonal products. Yeonnamjang, located in Seoul's Yeonhui-dong neighborhood, focuses on performances, lectures and other cultural events. Its FYI lounge in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam District, combines a cafe with a curated selection of books and stationery aimed at people working in the startup industry. Hong's idea is to give people a reason to visit a place beyond the products it sells. The company applied this approach to the 2026 Seoul Design Week, held from Oct. 14 to 25, by connecting 150 design destinations across five areas through the Seoul Design Road: Dongdaemun, Seongsu, Yeonhui, Seochon and Apgujeong. Rather than simply listing design-related venues across the city, the routes connected places where visitors can encounter products, crafts, studios and exhibitions within distinct neighborhoods, the CEO said. The company has also sought to connect individual creators and businesses with broader neighborhood experiences. Through local projects in Seoul and other cities, including Busan and Gwangju, it brings together shops, artists and cultural programs to give visitors more reasons to explore an area. Urbanplay also works to nurture small businesses, which Hong refers to as "local creators" rather than simply small-business owners. The company helps them develop their own brands and content, sometimes through incubation programs run in partnership with public institutions such as the Seoul Metropolitan Government and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups. "We began using the term 'local creators' around 2015," Hong said. "It refers to entrepreneurs who build their own brands and content and can grow their businesses around their own intellectual property." "Small businesses generally operate on a self-employment model, so scaling up is structurally difficult. But we believe that businesses with strong intellectual property, creativity and compelling stories have the potential to grow into bigger brands." Hong cited Sungsimdang, the Daejeon bakery that has become a tourist attraction in its own right, as an example of a local brand’s power to draw visitors. Beyond helping local businesses attract visitors, Urbanplay also seeks to introduce international audiences to Korea's regional culture and identity. Hong cited Seochon, near Gyeongbokgung Palace, as an example of a neighborhood that offers a glimpse into different layers of Korean culture, where traditional architecture and cultural heritage coexist with contemporary brands. Urbanplay put this vision into practice last October with "Edition Seochon," a five-day local art fair that brought together young artists, shops and brands across the neighborhood. The event turned streets and neighborhood venues into spaces for exhibitions, pop-ups and cultural programs, with the aim of developing Seochon into a globally recognized cultural district. Looking beyond Korea, Hong sees opportunities to bring Korean local brands and creators to overseas markets. He said Urbanplay could serve as a bridge, connecting them with potential partners abroad. "We receive a lot of proposals, particularly from Southeast Asia, where there is growing demand for urban development projects that incorporate Korean culture," Hong said. "Since we have a pool of business owners in food and beverage, lifestyle, design and culture, we will be able to bring various brands together and create exhibition spaces." Urbanplay is also exploring opportunities in Europe, where interest in Korean culture is extending beyond entertainment and popular culture. Hong said the company had held several meetings with potential partners in the region, where Korean wellness, food, crafts and visual arts have attracted attention. "Even in countries such as Switzerland, there is considerable interest in Korean wellness culture. Along with interest in the Buddhist culture, they are interested in Korean food made with healthy ingredients, particularly temple cuisine," Hong said

Times》采访时说：“仔细规划访客将体验哪些内容，以及哪些服务能在体验结束后继续让他们与品牌保持联系，这很重要。我们并非一家只负责设计空间实体结构的公司。我们策划空间内部的内容，并设计用户体验。”Urbanplay成立于2013年，通过实体空间连接品牌、本地创作者与受众。公司不亲自设计建筑或室内空间，而是为每个空间开发概念和内容，并监督其商业规划和运营。公司还与建筑事务所和施工企业合作，完成详细设计和施工。Hong将Urbanplay的角色比作城市操作系统。他说，公司利用13年积累的数据开发了自己的Urbanplay OS。“通过这一系统，我们可以预判线下环境的变化，为合作伙伴推荐适合的内容，并模拟空间如何进行规划和运营。”公司的项目涵盖社区文化空间、企业空间和大型展览。例如，Yeonnam Bangagan既是一家咖啡馆，也是一家策划型生活方式商店，在首尔站附近以及东大门设计广场设有门店，展示本地品牌、艺术家和季节性商品。位于首尔延辉洞社区的Yeonnamjang主要举办演出、讲座及其他文化活动。其位于江南区驿三洞的FYI休息室将咖啡馆与精心策划的书籍和文具相结合，面向在初创企业行业工作的人士。Hong的想法是，除了场所销售的商品之外，还要给人们到访的理由。公司将这一理念应用于2026年首尔设计周。该活动于10月14日至25日举行，通过“首尔设计之路”连接五大区域的150个设计目的地：东大门、城圣、延辉、 서村和狎鸥亭。Hong表示，这些路线并非简单罗列全城与设计有关的场所，而是将访客能够体验产品、手工艺、工作室和展览的地点连接起来，而且每个地点都位于不同社区之中。公司还致力于把个人创作者和商家与更广泛的社区体验联系起来。通过在首尔以及釜山、光州等其他城市开展本地项目，Urbanplay把商店、艺术家和文化活动汇聚在一起，为访客提供更多探索某一区域的理由。Urbanplay还努力扶持小微企业，Hong称这些人为“本地创作者”，而不仅仅是小企业主。公司帮助他们打造自己的品牌和内容，有时还通过与首尔市政府、中小企业与初创企业部等公共机构合作开展的孵化项目来提供支持。Hong说：“我们大约从2015年开始使用‘本地创作者’这一称谓。它指的是打造自己品牌和内容，并能够围绕自有知识产权发展业务的创业者。”“小企业通常采用自雇模式运营，因此在结构上很难扩大规模。但我们认为，拥有强大知识产权、创意和动人故事的企业，有潜力成长为更大的品牌。”Hong以大田面包店Sungsimdang为例，指出它本身已成为旅游景点，说明本地品牌吸引访客的力量。除了帮助本地商家吸引访客外，Urbanplay还希望把国际受众介绍到韩国的地域文化和身份之中。Hong以景福宫附近的西村为例，称这个社区能够让人们窥见韩国文化的不同层面，传统建筑和文化遗产在这里与当代品牌共存。去年10月，Urbanplay通过举办为期五天的本地艺术展“Edition Seochon”落实这一愿景，把年轻艺术家、商店和品牌聚集在整个社区。展览把街道和社区场所变成展览、快闪活动和文化项目的空间，旨在把西村打造为享誉全球的文化街区。放眼韩国以外，Hong认为公司有机会把韩国本地品牌和创作者带入海外市场。他说，Urbanplay可以发挥桥梁作用，把他们与海外潜在合作伙伴连接起来。Hong说：“我们收到了很多提案，尤其是来自东南亚的提案，那里对融入韩国文化的城市开发项目需求正在增长。”“由于我们拥有一批涉及餐饮、生活方式、设计和文化领域的商家，因此能够把各类品牌汇聚起来，打造展览空间。”Urbanplay还在探索欧洲市场的机会。在那里，人们对韩国文化的兴趣正从娱乐和流行文化延伸至其他领域。Hong说，公司已与该地区的若干潜在合作伙伴举行了几次会面，韩国 wellness、美食、手工艺和视觉艺术都引起了人们的关注。“即使在瑞士这样的国家，人们对韩国 wellness 文化也有相当大的兴趣。除了对佛教文化的兴趣，他们也对使用健康食材制作的韩国美食感兴趣，尤其是寺庙料理。”Hong说

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110405.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 전명훈 기자 = 북한이 4일 오전 동해상으로 미사일 여러 발을 발사했다고 합동참모본부가 밝혔다. 이어 "한미는 미사일 발사를 준비 단계부터 면밀히 감시했으며 발사 직후 미사일을 탐지·추적했다"며 "굳건한 한미 연합방위태세 하에 북한의 다양한 동향에 대해 예의주시하면서, 어떠한 도발에도 압도적으로 대응할 수 있는 능력과 태세를 유지하고 있다"고 밝혔다. 통상 북한의 탄도미사일 발사를 실시간 포착해 언론에 즉시 공지하는 합참은 이날 공지에서 '탄도미사일'이 아닌 '미사일'이 발사됐다고 밝혔다. 이날 북한의 미사일 발사는 도널드 트럼프 미 행정부 집권 2년 차의 중간평가 성격을 띠는 미국 중간선거 투표가 진행 중인 당일(현지시간 기준 3일)에 진행됐다. 특히 이날 김여정 노동당 총무부장이 바이낸스 해킹 사태의 배후로 지목된 데 반발하는 담화에서 미국과의 대화를 '선택지'로 언급한 직후에 이뤄졌다. 김 부장은 이날 발표한 담화에서 미국을 향해 "평화수호를 위한 선택지에는 분명 대화가 포함되어 있지만 이는 우리에게 있어서 국가이익과 반드시 동일시되는 것이 아니다"라고 밝혀 북미 대화의 여지를 열어둔 것 아니냐는 관측을 낳았다. 김 부장은 그러나 같은 담화에서 "미국의 적대시정책 실행에서 새로운 기록들이 세워지고 있는 오늘의 현실에서 우리의 반사적 대응에서도 새로운 기록들이 창조되여야 마땅하다"고 위협하며 강경 대응도 예고했었다. 앞서 2일 김정식 노동당 중앙위원회 군수공업부 제1부부장도 담화에서 한미, 한미일 등의 연합·합동 훈련을 비난하고 "나라의 핵전쟁 억제력을 더욱 가속적으로 강화하려는 조선민주주의인민공화국의 국방정책은 추호도 변함없을 것"이라며 고강도 군사 대응 예고했다. 북한은 지난달 29일 600㎜ 초대형 방사포(KN-25) 10여 발을 동시 발사한 데 이어, 같은 달 31일에는 집속탄두(산포전투부)를 탑재한 전술탄도미사일을 시험발사했다. 이달 3일에는 지난 2일 진행한 전략순항미사일 집속탄두 위력평가시험과 표적을 수직으로 때리는 '수직타격비행특성시험' 결과를 공개했다. 북한은 최근 시험발사 소식을 전하면서 최전방 감시소초(GP)나 항공기 격납고, 포병진지 등 한국군 시설을 모사한 표적을 타격하는 장면을 잇달아 노출하며 대남 위협 의도를 노골적으로 드러냈다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/04 12:12 송고 2026년11월04일 12시12분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 윤동진 기자 = 29일 서울역 대합실에 설치된 TV 화면에 북한 미사일 발사 관련 뉴스가 나오고 있다. 합참은 이날 “12시 30분경 북한 원산 일대에서 동해상으로 발사된 단거리 탄도미사일 10여 발을 포착했다"고 발표했다. 2026.10.29 mon@yna.co.kr (서울=연합뉴스) 김도훈 기자 = 합동참모본부가 북한이 동해상으로 미상 발사체를 발사했다고 밝힌 4일 서울역 대합실에 설치된 TV에 관련 뉴스가 나오고 있다. 합참은 발사체의 제원과 사거리 등을 분석 중이며, 해당 발사체가 탄도미사일로 확인될 경우 지난달 31일 이후 나흘 만의 미사일 발사다. 2026.11.4 superdoo82@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110405.title_zh: 朝鲜在中美选举日提及“对话选择”，随后挑衅发射导弹（综合报道）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110405.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者全明勋=韩国联合参谋本部宣布，朝鲜于4日上午向东海发射多枚导弹。联合参谋本部随后表示：“韩美从导弹发射准备阶段起便对其进行严密监视，并在发射后立即探测和追踪导弹。牢固的韩美联合防卫态势下，我们正密切关注朝鲜的各类动向，并保有能够压倒性回应任何挑衅的能力和姿态。”通常，朝鲜发射弹道导弹时，联参都会实时捕获并立即向媒体通报，而联参当天的通报称发射的是“导弹”，而非“弹道导弹”。朝鲜此次发射导弹正值美国中期选举投票日（当地时间3日），这次选举带有评估唐纳德·特朗普政府执政2周年 midway中期成果的性质。尤其是在朝鲜劳动党总务部长金野正因被指认为VINCE hacking事件的幕后黑手而发表抗议谈话，并在谈话中将与美国对话称为一种“选择”之后进行的。金部长在当天发表的谈话中表示：“为维护和平而采取的选择中，显然包括对话，但这对我们而言并不必然等同于国家利益。”这引发了外界观察，认为其是否为北美对话留下了余地。然而，金部长也在同一谈话中警告称：“在美国的敌对政策正在不断创造新纪录的今天，我们的反制回应理应同样创造新的纪录。”此前，朝鲜劳动党中央委员会军工部第一副部长金正植于2日发表谈话，谴责韩美、韩美日等联合及联合训练，并称：“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的国防政策毫无改变，将进一步加速强化国家的核战争威慑能力。”他同时预告将采取强力军事回应。上月29日，朝鲜同时发射了10余枚600毫米超大型火箭炮（KN-25）；同月31日，又试射了一枚搭载集束弹头（杀伤战斗部）的战术弹道导弹。3日，朝鲜公布了2日进行的洲际弹道导弹集束弹头威力评估试验，以及垂直打击目标的“垂直打击飞行特性试验”结果。朝鲜近期在发布试射消息时，连续展示模拟打击韩军最前方监视哨所（GP）、飞机机库和炮兵阵地等韩国军队设施的目标画面，公开表露对韩威胁意图。报道请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、发行及用于AI学习和应用> 2026/11/04 12:12发送 2026年11月4日12时12分发送（首尔=韩联社）记者尹东镇=29日，安装在首尔站大厅的电视屏幕上正在播放有关朝鲜发射导弹的新闻。联合参谋本部当天宣布：“约12时30分，在朝鲜元山一带向东海发射的10余枚短程弹道导弹已被捕获。”2026.10.29 mon@yna.co.kr（首尔=韩联社）记者金道勋=联合参谋本部宣布朝鲜向东海发射导弹后，安装在首尔站大厅的电视于4日正在播放相关新闻。联合参谋本部正在分析发射体的性能和射程等参数，如确认该发射体为弹道导弹，这将是继上月31日之后时隔两天再次发射导弹。2026.11.4 superdoo82@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110408.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金志宪=调查、外交部门正集中力量查明相关细节，其中包括撰写载有李在明总统及随行人员信息的空军一号机乘客名单文件的人员等。外交部4日就泄露文件的撰写人姓名等表示，正在与警方厅等有关机构共同核实事实关系，暂时难以给出具体答复。报道称，该文件载有李总统及168名随行人员的护照号码等个人隐私信息，文件撰写人姓名显示为外交部英文简称“MOFA”。外交部相关人士前一天解释称，这份Excel表格格式文件的格式与外交部作为总统正常出访活动统筹机构汇总空军一号机乘客信息并编制文件时的格式相符。不过，该文件并非盖有印章等标识的正式公文，其性质与正式公文的附件相同，因此无法立即确认由谁撰写；但如果撰写人是MOFA，该文件属于外交部内部文件的可能性将进一步提高。该文件曾于今年6月，即李总统赴比利时等欧洲国家出访前的6月初，被上传至外国恶意代码感染检测网站“VirusTotal”。由此有人提出，该文件可能是在驻比利时使馆等机构向有关机构或对方国政府传递、共享的过程中泄露的。也有报道称，文件撰写人姓名是比利时式姓名“bruno”，这一说法被援引为支持上述可能性的依据。举报请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载·再分发及用于AI学习和应用> 2026/11/04 12:06发稿 2026年11月4日12时06分发稿（布鲁塞尔=韩联社）记者韩相坤=到访比利时的李在明总统和金惠卿夫人9日（当地时间）抵达布鲁塞尔梅尔斯布鲁克空军基地后，走下空军一号机并前往相关地点。2026.6.10 [联合采访提供，禁止转售及存入数据库] xyz@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110408.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 황재하 기자 = 6·3 지방선거의 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사 중인 이태한 선거관리위원회 특별검사팀이 중앙선거관리위원회가 중요 공문서인 투표록을 위·변조한 혐의를 포착하고 강제수사에 착수했다. 특검팀은 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 투표소의 투표록이 중앙선관위 지시로 사후 위·변조된 정황을 파악하고 4일 오전 9시께 중앙선관위와 서울시선관위에 특검보 1명, 검사 4명, 포렌식 수사관 14명, 수사관 25명을 투입해 압수수색을 진행 중이라고 밝혔다. 투표록은 선거 당일 투표소에서 투표가 어떻게 진행됐는지, 투표용지 관리와 교부, 투표 상황 등을 기록하는 공문서다. 투표 당일 투표소에서 선관위 업무를 대행하는 지자체 공무원이 투표관리관 등 자격으로 투표록을 작성하면 이를 개표가 끝난 후 봉인해 당선인 임기 종료 때까지 보존해야 한다. 특검팀은 이번 지방선거에서 용지 부족 사태로 일련번호가 인쇄되지 않은 '무번호 투표용지'가 140여곳의 투표소에 배포돼 실제 사용된 것으로 파악했다. 아울러 특검팀은 무번호 투표용지 사용에 따른 책임 추궁이나 소송이 이어질 것으로 예상되자 중앙선관위가 선거 후 각급 선관위에 투표록 사후 기재를 지시한 뒤 결과를 취합한 것으로 보고 있다. 중앙선관위의 지시를 받은 각급 선관위는 투표록에 무번호 투표용지의 일련번호를 임의로 써 넣거나 '투표용지 부족을 예상하고 선관위에 대책을 요청했다', '무번호 용지를 전달받았다'는 등의 내용을 특이사항 란에 추가했다. 특검팀은 용지 부족으로 무번호 투표용지를 전달받은 전국 투표소 140여곳 가운데 이처럼 위·변조된 투표록이 발견된 곳이 최소 40여곳에 이른다고 설명했다. 위·변조된 투표록은 이후 중앙선관위에 취합됐고 용지 부족 사태가 불거진 후에도 국회 등에 그대로 제출된 것으로 추정된다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/04 12:02 송고 2026년11월04일 12시02분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110408.title_zh: 特别检查组称，投票站因选票不足，在中央选举委员会指示下事后篡改投票记录
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110408.body_zh:
（首尔=韩联社）记者黄在夏=正在调查6·3地方选举选票不足事件等案件的李泰汉选举管理委员会特别检察组，已发现中央选举管理委员会涉嫌篡改重要公文文件——投票记录，并已启动强制侦查。

特别检察组表示，已掌握发生选票不足事件的投票站在中央选举管理委员会指示下事后篡改投票记录的情况，并于4日上午9时左右向中央选举管理委员会和首尔市选举管理委员会投入特别检察官1人、检察官4人、痕迹鉴定调查人员14人和调查人员25人，搜查相关人员的住处并扣押搜查。

投票记录是记录选举当天各投票站如何进行投票、选票管理和发放情况以及投票现场状况的公文文件。选举当天，代理投票站选举管理委员会工作的地方政府公务员应以投票管理负责人等身份填写投票记录，并在开票结束后予以封存，保存至当选人任期届满。

特别检察组表示，在此次地方选举中，因发生选票不足事件，约有140个投票站被发放了未印有序列号的“无编号选票”，并查明这些选票确已使用。

此外，特别检察组预计，针对使用无编号选票的责任追究或诉讼可能会持续进行，因此认为中央选举管理委员会在选举后曾指示各级选举管理委员会事后补记投票记录，并汇总了结果。

收到中央选举管理委员会指示的各级选举管理委员会，擅自在投票记录上填写无编号选票的序列号，或在“异常事项”一栏中添加“预计选票不足，已向选举管理委员会请求对策”“已收到无编号选票”等内容。

特别检察组解释道，在全国因选票不足而收到无编号选票的约140个投票站中，发现投票记录遭此篡改的至少已有40余处。

遭篡改的投票记录随后被汇总至中央选举管理委员会，并推测在选票不足事件发酵后仍原样提交给了国会等机构。

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: Delhi’s pollution levels continued to surge on Wednesday morning, with 21 of the 59 monitoring stations recording air quality in the ‘severe’ category. The Air Quality Index (AQI) stood at 373 at 7:05 am, in the ‘very poor’ category, compared with Tuesday’s 24-hour average of 350. Tuesday’s reading was the worst in 287 days. At 54 of the 59 monitoring stations, PM2.5 was the primary pollutant. Punjabi Bagh recorded the highest AQI at 452, followed by Jahangirpuri (450) and IIT Delhi (446). Five stations were in the ‘poor’ category and the remaining 23 in the very poor category. The Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) classifies an AQI of 0-50 as ‘good’, 51-100 as ‘satisfactory’, 101-200 as ‘moderate’, 201-300 as ‘poor’, 301-400 as ‘very poor’ and 401-500 as ‘severe’. According to the Air Quality Early Warning System (AQEWS), air quality is expected to remain in the very poor category from November 4 to 6. It is likely to fluctuate between the very poor and severe categories over the following six days. The bursting of firecrackers on Diwali could lead to a further deterioration in air quality. NASA satellite data detected 1,561 farm fires in Punjab and Haryana between October 1 and November 3 - 1,406 in Punjab and 155 in Haryana. Of these, 167 were recorded on November 2. During the corresponding period last year, satellites detected 2,068 fires. However, the figures need to be viewed in context, as stubble burning has shifted to later hours over the years. In 2025, 98 per cent of the fire heat recorded by Meteosat was detected after 3 pm, compared with 94 per cent in 2024. The two counts could therefore differ for this reason alone. Both figures are undercounts, as most of the burning now takes place after the satellite passes over the region at around 1:30 pm

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/a.summary_zh: 与会者包括卡诺埃米尔穆罕马杜·萨努西二世；商人兼投资银行家阿特多·彼得赛德；以及证券交易委员会（SEC）前总干事阿伦玛·奥泰。他承认，经济已实现约4.5%的增长，近期政策调整后，一些关键指标有所改善。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/a.body: • Sanusi says GDP growth alone could conceal deteriorating economic conditions •Oteh says domestic capital mobilisation key to long-term development •Adesina: Africa’s youth key to economic transformation if supported •Tijani: knowledge, technology will determine long-term prosperity Prominent Nigerian business and economic leaders yesterday declared that current economic reforms and improving growth figures will amount to little unless they translate into higher household incomes, better living conditions, productive investments, and employment opportunities for millions of citizens. Their perspectives converged on the need for a more inclusive growth model anchored on strong institutions, private sector investment, technological advancement, and human capital development. Speakers included Emir of Kano, Muhammadu Sanusi II; businessman and investment banker, Atedo Peterside; and former Director-General of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Arunma Oteh. Others were former President of African Development Bank (AfDB), Dr. Akinwumi Adesina, as well as Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Dr. Bosun Tijani. They emphasised that the country’s economic recovery must be measured beyond headline Gross Domestic Product (GDP) figures, stressing that persistent poverty, weak investment, inadequate infrastructure, and institutional deficiencies continue to undermine the benefits of reforms. Sanusi, a former Governor of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), cautioned against interpreting improvements in macroeconomic indicators as evidence that the economy was delivering prosperity to ordinary Nigerians. He acknowledged that the economy had recorded growth of about 4.5 per cent and that some key indicators had improved following recent policy adjustments. However, he questioned the quality and inclusiveness of the expansion, stating that GDP growth alone can conceal deteriorating economic conditions among households. Sanusi pointed to the decline in GDP per capita since 2023, influenced by economic growth failing to keep pace with population expansion and the effects of currency depreciation, as an indication that aggregate economic performance did not necessarily translate into improved individual welfare. He maintained that the real measure of economic progress should be whether Nigerians could afford quality education, healthcare, adequate nutrition, and decent housing, while accessing employment and better income opportunities. The former CBN governor also cautioned against excessive dependence on portfolio investments, which he said could be volatile and driven largely by attractive short-term returns rather than long-term confidence in the productive economy. According to him, sustainable economic recovery requires more than subsidy removal and foreign exchange policy adjustments. He said the government must address structural weaknesses that constrained productivity and investment. Sanusi called for greater infrastructure investment, transparency, accountability, and reliable economic data to support policy formulation and implementation. He also warned that perceived imbalances in political appointments, particularly in sensitive national security institutions, could undermine national cohesion, urging the government to demonstrate fairness and inclusiveness in managing the country’s diversity. For his part, Peterside stressed that the country should be targeting annual economic growth of at least 10 per cent, rather than celebrating expansion of about four per cent, given the country’s population, employment requirements, and development deficits. He identified inadequate investment as a major obstacle to achieving the required growth, stating that Nigeria must substantially increase investment as a proportion of GDP to expand productive capacity and create enough jobs. The businessman blamed corruption, political patronage, regulatory harassment, and the absence of a level playing field for weakening investor confidence and discouraging businesses from expanding. He particularly criticised the treatment of small and medium-scale enterprises by some government regulators, alleging that arbitrary demands and bureaucratic harassment are imposing additional costs on businesses already struggling with difficult operating conditions. Peterside also described abuses in public procurement as a major channel through which public resources intended for infrastructure and development were diverted, characterising the practice as “legalised theft”. He warned that inflated contracts and politically connected interests were undermining the effective deployment of public funds. Peterside said Nigeria could not attract the investment required for rapid economic expansion without confronting corruption and state capture. The investment banker stated that economic reforms must distribute their costs and benefits more equitably, warning against a situation where ordinary Nigerians bear the burden of adjustment while politically connected individuals remain insulated. In a separate appearance on ARISE Television’s Prime Time, Peterside expanded on the distributional consequences of the federal government’s economic policies, pointing out that the reforms under President Bola Tinubu are producing sharply different outcomes for wealthy Nigerians and low-income households. He said individuals with substantial investments in the stock market and other financial assets might have benefited from improved investment returns, while low-income workers and vulnerable households were finding it increasingly difficult to afford basic necessities. Peterside estimated that between 130 million and 140 million Nigerians were poor and becoming poorer. He said the government had failed to provide adequate social protection to cushion the effect of far-reaching economic adjustments. He said the perception that the reforms were working largely depended on the economic circumstances of those assessing them. According to him, the wealthy could point to improved investment income and rising asset values as evidence of progress, while millions of low-income earners struggling to afford two meals daily are experiencing a different reality. He also used state-level poverty figures to illustrate the geographical dimensions of the crisis, stating that deprivation is particularly severe in the North-west and North-east, where poverty rates in every state exceed 50 per cent. Peterside said only 12 states and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) had poverty rates below the 50 per cent threshold, in his assessment, with most of the states in that category concentrated in the South-west. He warned that policymakers, who largely operated between Abuja and Lagos, risked overlooking the severity of poverty in other parts of the country, urging the government to look beyond national averages when assessing the effect of its policies. Oteh stated that the challenge of capital mobilisation required a coordinated development strategy involving government, businesses, investors, financial institutions, and citizens, rather than isolated interventions by individual institutions. The convener of the conference and former director-general of SEC said Nigeria must mobilise domestic capital more effectively to finance long-term development. She stressed that the capital market could play a bigger role in expanding investment opportunities and distributing the benefits of economic growth. She advocated wider retail participation in the capital market, stating that ordinary Nigerians should have greater opportunities to invest in productive businesses and participate in wealth creation. Oteh also identified pension funds as an important source of long-term domestic financing. She said properly structured investment frameworks could enable pension assets to support infrastructure and other productive ventures while providing safeguards for contributors. She called for greater decentralisation of economic development and public service delivery, stating that communities and subnational governments should have more capacity to respond to local needs. Citing electricity distribution in Aba, Abia State, she pointed to the potential of decentralised approaches to infrastructure management and service delivery. Oteh also stressed that access to finance, reliable infrastructure, regulatory certainty, and skilled manpower remained essential to creating an environment in which businesses could thrive. She cited international investor interest in the proposed public offering of the Dangote Refinery as an illustration of the capacity of Nigeria’s capital market to attract capital beyond its domestic investment base. Adesina, in his intervention, stressed that Africa’s rapidly expanding youth population could become a major driver of economic transformation if governments invested adequately in their capabilities. He stated that Africa was projected to account for approximately a quarter of the world’s population by 2050, warning that the demographic expansion could become an economic liability if not matched by investment in education, healthcare, nutrition, and skills. According to him, the continent’s real demographic advantage would not lie simply in the number of young people but in their ability to innovate, establish businesses, develop technologies, and contribute to productive economic activities. The former AfDB president urged governments to prioritise technical and digital education, affordable financing, and infrastructure to enable young people to convert their ideas into viable enterprises. He also called for stronger investment in artificial intelligence and digital capabilities, warning against Africa remaining primarily a consumer of technologies developed elsewhere. Tijani said Nigeria’s capacity to apply knowledge and technology to its natural and human resources would be decisive in determining its long-term economic prosperity. He stated that possessing natural resources was insufficient to guarantee wealth, stressing that countries achieve economic advancement by developing the technological and institutional capabilities to maximise the value of their resources. The minister cited Nigeria’s telecommunications liberalisation and the introduction of GSM services in 2001 as evidence of how deliberate government policy, private sector participation, and competition could transform an industry and generate wider economic opportunities. He said artificial intelligence represented another major productivity frontier, but warned that Nigeria must first develop the capacity to absorb and deploy emerging technologies effectively. Tijani identified connectivity, computing and data infrastructure, research, skills development, innovation, and effective institutions as critical foundations for building that capacity. He disclosed that the federal government was pursuing approximately 90,000-kilometre open-access fibre-optic network backed by an estimated $2 billion investment to expand broadband connectivity across the country. He also highlighted plans to strengthen shared computing infrastructure and develop a Nigerian large language model capable of supporting local languages, including Yoruba, Hausa, and Igbo, alongside Nigerian-accented English. The minister said the government’s 3 Million Technical Talent programme was designed to equip Nigerians with the skills required to participate in the global digital economy, while the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy would guide the country’s adoption and development of the technology. He also cited differences in agricultural productivity between Nigeria and countries, such as Brazil and Argentina, to demonstrate the economic costs of inadequate technology adoption.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/a.title_zh: 阿德西纳、萨努西、彼得赛德、奥特赫谈财政政策：经济增长必须改善生活水平
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/a.body_zh:
• 萨努西称，仅靠国内生产总值增长可能掩盖经济状况恶化 • 奥泰称，动员国内资本是实现长期发展的关键 • 阿德西纳：若获得支持，非洲青年将成为经济转型的关键 • 蒂亚尼：知识和技术将决定长期繁荣 尼日利亚知名商界和经济界领袖昨天表示，当前经济改革和不断改善的增长数据，除非能转化为更高的家庭收入、更好的生活条件、有成效的投资，以及为数百万公民创造就业机会，否则意义有限。发言者的观点均指向同一个需求：建立更具包容性的增长模式，并以强健的制度、私营部门投资、技术进步和人力资本发展为基础。发言者包括卡诺酋长穆罕马杜·萨努西二世、商人兼投资银行家阿特多·彼得赛德，以及证券交易委员会（SEC）前总干事阿伦玛·奥泰。其他人还包括非洲开发银行（AfDB）前行长阿金武米·阿德西纳博士，以及通信、创新和数字经济部长博苏恩·蒂亚尼博士。

他们强调，衡量该国经济复苏不能只看国内生产总值（GDP）总体数据；持续的贫困、投资疲弱、基础设施不足和制度缺陷仍在削弱改革成效。尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）前行长萨努西警告，不应将宏观经济指标的改善解读为经济正在给普通尼日利亚人带来繁荣。他承认，近期政策调整后，经济增长约为4.5%，一些关键指标也有所改善。然而，他质疑扩张的质量和包容性，称仅靠GDP增长可能掩盖家庭经济状况恶化。萨努西指出，自2023年以来人均GDP有所下降，原因包括经济增长未能跟上人口扩张以及货币贬值的影响；这表明总体经济表现未必能转化为个人福祉的改善。他坚持认为，衡量经济进步的真实标准，是尼日利亚人能否负担优质教育、医疗保健、充足营养和体面住房，同时获得就业和更好的收入机会。

这位CBN前行长还警告，不应过度依赖证券投资，因为这类投资可能波动较大，主要由诱人的短期回报驱动，而非对实体经济的长期信心。他认为，可持续的经济复苏不仅仅需要取消补贴和调整外汇政策，政府还必须解决制约生产力和投资的结构性弱点。萨努西呼吁加大基础设施投资，提高透明度、问责能力和经济数据可靠性，以支持政策制定和实施。他还警告，如果人们认为政治任命存在失衡，特别是在敏感的国家安全机构中，这可能削弱国家凝聚力，并敦促政府在管理国家多样性时展现公平和包容。

彼得赛德则强调，鉴于该国的人口、就业需求和发展缺口，尼日利亚应以每年至少10%的经济增长为目标，而不是为约4%的扩张欢呼。他把投资不足列为实现所需增长的主要障碍，称尼日利亚必须大幅提高投资占GDP的比重，以扩大生产能力并创造足够的就业岗位。这位商人将腐败、政治庇护、监管骚扰和缺乏公平竞争环境归咎于投资者信心减弱和企业不愿扩张。他尤其批评一些政府监管机构对待中小企业的方式，声称随意提出的要求和官僚式骚扰，正给本就在艰难经营条件下挣扎的企业增加额外成本。

彼得赛德还把公共采购中的滥用描述为基础设施和发展公共资源被挪用的一条主要渠道，并将这种做法称为“合法化的盗窃”。他警告，抬高合同金额和政治利益关联正在削弱公共资金的有效使用。彼得赛德表示，如果不处理腐败和国家被俘获的问题，尼日利亚就无法吸引实现快速经济扩张所需的投资。这位投资银行家指出，经济改革必须更加公平地分配成本和收益，并警告不能出现普通尼日利亚人承担调整负担、政治关系人士却受到隔离的局面。

彼得赛德在ARISE Television《黄金时段》节目中进一步阐述联邦政府经济政策带来的分配后果，指出博拉·蒂努布总统任内的改革，正在富裕的尼日利亚人与低收入家庭之间造成截然不同的结果。他说，在股市和其他金融资产上有大量投资的人，可能因投资回报改善而受益，而低收入劳动者和脆弱家庭却越来越难以负担基本生活用品。彼得赛德估计，有1.3亿至1.4亿尼日利亚人处于贫困状态，并日益贫困。他说，政府未能提供足够的社会保障，以缓冲大范围经济调整造成的影响。他认为，人们之所以认为改革正在奏效，很大程度上取决于评价者自身的经济处境。

据他所说，富人可以拿投资收益增加和资产价格上涨作为进展的证据，而数百万难以负担每日两餐的低收入者所面对的却是另一种现实。他还利用各州贫困数据说明这场危机的地域差异，称西北部和东北部的贫困状况尤其严重，每个州的贫困率都超过50%。彼得赛德表示，根据他的评估，只有12个州和联邦首都辖区（FCT）的贫困率低于50%的门槛，而且这一类中的大多数州集中在西南部。他警告说，政策制定者大多在阿布贾和拉各斯之间工作，可能忽视该国其他地区的严重贫困，敦促政府评估政策影响时不要只看全国平均数。

奥泰表示，资本动员这一挑战需要政府、企业、投资者、金融机构和公民共同参与的协调发展战略，不能依靠个别机构的孤立干预。这次会议召集人、SEC前总干事说，尼日利亚必须更有效地动员国内资本，为长期发展提供融资。她强调，资本市场可以在扩大投资机会和分配经济增长收益方面发挥更大作用。她主张扩大散户对资本市场的参与，称普通尼日利亚人应获得更多机会投资于富有成效的企业并参与财富创造。

奥泰还把养老金基金列为长期国内融资的重要来源。她说，设计合理的投资框架，可以让养老金资产支持基础设施及其他富有成效的事业，同时为缴费者提供保障。她呼吁进一步推进经济发展和公共服务交付的去中心化，称社区和次国家级政府应具备更强能力，以回应本地需求。她以阿巴市（阿比亚州）的电力配送为例，指出分权方式在基础设施管理和公共服务交付方面的潜力。奥泰还强调，融资渠道、可靠基础设施、监管确定性和熟练人才，依然是营造企业繁荣环境的关键。她援引国际投资者对Dangote炼油厂拟议公开上市表现出兴趣，说明尼日利亚资本市场有能力吸引超出国内投资基本盘的资本。

阿德西纳在发言中强调，如果政府充分投资于非洲迅速增长的青年人口，他们就能成为经济转型的重要驱动力。他表示，预计到2050年，非洲将占世界人口的约四分之一，并警告人口扩张如果没有教育、医疗保健、营养和技能投资与之匹配，就可能成为经济负担。他认为，非洲真正的人口优势不在于年轻人数量本身，而在于他们能否创新、创办企业、开发技术并为富有成效的经济活动作出贡献。

这位AfDB前行长敦促各国政府优先发展技术和数字教育，提供可负担的融资并建设基础设施，使年轻人能够把想法转化为可行的企业。他还呼吁加大在人工智能和数字能力方面的投资，警告不要让非洲继续主要充当其他地方开发技术的消费者。

蒂亚尼说，尼日利亚能否把知识和技术应用于其自然资源和人力资源，将是决定其长期经济繁荣的关键。他指出，拥有自然资源并不足以保证财富；各国要实现经济进步，必须发展技术和制度能力，最大限度提高资源价值。这位部长援引尼日利亚电信业自由化以及2001年引入GSM服务的事例，说明有意实施的政府政策、私营部门参与和竞争如何能够改变一个行业并创造更广泛的经济机会。他说，人工智能代表着另一块主要的生产力前沿，但警告尼日利亚必须先形成有效吸收和部署新兴技术的能力。

蒂亚尼把网络连接、计算和数据基础设施、科研、技能开发、创新以及有效制度列为建设这种能力的关键基础。他透露，联邦政府正在推进一张约9万公里的开放接入光纤网络，预计投资20亿美元，以扩大全国宽带连接。他还强调，政府计划加强共享计算基础设施，并开发一款能够支持约鲁巴语、豪萨语、伊博语以及尼日利亚本土英语的尼日利亚大语言模型。部长表示，政府的“300万技术人才”计划旨在使尼日利亚人具备参与全球数字经济所需的技能，而《国家人工智能战略》将指导该国采用和发展这项技术。他还援引尼日利亚与巴西、阿根廷等国家在农业生产率上的差距，说明技术采用不足带来的经济成本。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/a.summary_zh: • 前副总统承诺今天将处理该州的一场集会；人民民主党党主席请愿警察总监。非洲民主大会党（ADC）总统候选人阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔指控国家服务局（DSS）领导层招募打手，意图扰乱该党在索科托州的竞选活动。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/a.body: • Ex-VP vows to address a rally in the state today, PDP states chairmen petition IG The presidential candidate of African Democratic Congress (ADC), Atiku Abubakar, has accused the leadership of the Department of State Services (DSS) of recruiting thugs to disrupt his party’s campaigns in Sokoto State. Atiku also decried violence and political intimidation of ADC members in the state by the state government, as well as the government’s refusal to grant the opposition access to public facilities for rallies and campaigns. He vowed that irrespective of the actions of the security agencies and the state government’s denial of access to public facilities, he would address a rally in Sokoto today. That was as Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) states chairmen petitioned the Inspector General of Police, Tunji Disu, over alleged intimidation and harassment by APC governors. In a similar vein, former governor of Sokoto State and senator for Sokoto South, Aminu Tambuwal, decried alleged political intimidation in the state and vowed to defend democratic rights and freedom of association. Meanwhile, DSS responded to Atiku, saying even though its Director-General has ordered a probe into the allegation of thugs recruitment, in reverence to him, some of its operatives deployed to the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto State, Mannir Daniya, recently evacuated him to safety unhurt when he was attacked on October 31. Addressing a press conference yesterday in Abuja, the former vice president said, “I address you today with a heavy but resolute heart. What is unfolding in Sokoto is not ordinary political competition. “It is a calculated campaign to frustrate the African Democratic Congress, obstruct our campaign, and deny Nigerians the freedom to choose. “Public facilities that should be available to every political party for legitimate campaign activities have been blocked. Logistical support has been withheld. “These are not harmless administrative delays. They are deliberate attempts to deny the ADC a level playing field.” Atiku said, “More disturbing still, the information available to us is that the leadership of the Department of State Services is recruiting people to stage protests in Sokoto. “The objective is to create disorder, give the APC-controlled state government a pretext to impose a curfew, and prevent our campaign take off from holding as scheduled. “We know where some of these protesters are assembled: an office behind Zenith Bank on Koko Road. Trucks are stationed there and dispatched to key points, including the roundabout. “These mobilised protesters are causing gridlock. Commuters are being threatened and, in some cases, beaten. Some of the protesters have moved away from the roundabout to find shade.” Atiku said, “This is not intelligence work. It is political interference dressed in official uniform. Security agencies exist to protect Nigerians and uphold the law, not to recruit protesters or help a political party manufacture a crisis. Blaming the current administration for the breach of peace, Atiku said, “For three and a half years, the Tinubu administration has devoted too much energy to weakening credible opposition and too little to solving the problems facing Nigerians. “It has pursued a politics of absorption and intimidation, while drawing former opposition figures into the APC and narrowing the space for political competition. The aim is to reduce Nigeria to a one-party state in all but name. “The government is afraid of the people’s verdict. It has unleashed a crushing cost of living crisis and now appears determined to frustrate Nigerians’ democratic right to choose a different path. Food, transport, fuel, electricity and other essentials have become unaffordable for millions.” The former vice president stated, “Families are struggling to feed their children, pay school fees, and keep their businesses alive. That is the record this government should be defending before the people, instead of trying to stop a rally.” On his plans for the country if elected president next year, Atiku declared, “I will make life affordable again. We will support local production, strengthen food production, create jobs and reduce the cost of doing business. “We will pursue a targeted production subsidy tied to fuel refined in Nigeria, so that support reaches consumers through measurable relief while also strengthening domestic industry. Atiku said, “The APC has still not recovered from the abysmal failure of its last rally in Kaduna. “It should have taken that as a warning that Nigerians are withdrawing their confidence. Instead, it has chosen intimidation and obstruction. These are the last kicks of a dying horse. The ADC presidential candidate said, “The 2027 general election will be a defining moment in our democratic history. This is more than a contest between parties or candidates. “It is a choice between a government that has shown indifference to people’s suffering and Nigerians who have endured enough and want their votes to count. He stated, “We will not be intimidated into silence or irrelevance. Our campaign will proceed, and I will be in Sokoto tomorrow, God willing, to address the good people of the state. “I call on the people of Sokoto to remain calm and peaceful. Do not allow anyone to provoke you or turn a political gathering into a security crisis.” To the authorities, Atiku said, “I also urge the security agencies to protect commuters, residents and rally participants without favour. The authorities must ensure that our rally can hold peacefully and without interference. “To the voters of Nigeria, remain resolute. Stand your ground. Democratic freedom is not a gift from any government. It is your right. Do not allow anyone to intimidate you or checkmate your will.” Atiku stated, “As the presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress, I give you my word: I will lead this campaign and I will not abandon the field. We will confront every attempt to restrict democratic participation with firmness, organisation and faith in the Nigerian people. “The ADC will stand with officers who refuse to be used against democracy and who remain faithful to the constitution. Those who choose to betray their duty and collude in the suppression of political freedom will be held accountable under the law. “Nigeria belongs to its people, not to any party or temporary occupant of power. We will defend that truth and the people’s right to choose.” Former Governor of Sokoto State and senator for Sokoto South, Aminu Tambuwal, decried alleged political intimidation in the state and vowed to defend democratic rights and freedom of association. Tambuwal stated this when he received the presidential candidate of Social Democratic Party (SDP), Adewole Adebayo, on a courtesy visit in Sokoto on Monday. Tambuwal said he was pleased to receive the delegation, stating that the visit came at a particularly significant period in Sokoto State’s political history. The former governor reaffirmed that Sokoto was founded on the principles of fairness, inclusive governance, and respect for divergent opinions, stressing that the state belongs to all Nigerians. Tambuwal stated, “Sokoto belongs to all Nigerians. It must remain a welcoming environment where people from different political backgrounds can freely come, interact, and promote their ideas, particularly those relating to democracy and good governance.” He expressed concern over what he described as troubling developments in the state. He alleged that the state government had sealed the ADC campaign office and that the party’s governorship candidate, Hon. Manir Muhammad Dan’iya, had been attacked by personnel of government-recognised security outfits. Tambuwal described the incidents as inconsistent with Sokoto’s longstanding reputation for peace, hospitality, and political tolerance, warning that such actions could undermine the state’s democratic credentials. Tambuwal said the opposition would continue to resist any action capable of restricting political freedom or discouraging citizens from participating in the democratic process. The senator commended Adebayo for his courage, patriotism, and commitment to national development, particularly his decision to challenge Tinubu, despite coming from the same geopolitical zone. Adebayo, for his part, said he was in the state to congratulate the Sultan of Sokoto, His Eminence, Alhaji Muhammad Sa’ad Abubakar III, on the 20th anniversary of his ascension to the throne. He described Sokoto as a significant centre of Nigeria’s historical, intellectual, and political heritage. He stated that Sokoto’s importance transcended its identity as the seat of the caliphate, highlighting its enduring contributions to intellectual advancement and national development. Adebayo said, “We are here in Sokoto to register our well wishes to the Sultan of Sokoto on attaining 20 years on the throne. We thought we should be here because Sokoto, as we know, is very integral to the history of Nigeria. We see Sokoto not just as a Caliphate but as a seat of intellect.” Adebayo also called on the Sokoto State government to respect political diversity and guarantee freedom of movement for opposition politicians, stressing that no Nigerian should be denied access to any part of the country because of political affiliation. Meanwhile, the chairman of PDP states chairmen’s forum, Austin Nwachukwu, said at a meeting with the party’s National Working Committee (NWC) at its National Secretariat that APC governors were intimidating and harassing members of the party in their states. Nwachukwu stated, “l just want to use this opportunity to also bring to the notice of our National Working Committee that some states in the country, especially where we have APC governors, are very antagonistic to our candidates and members. “We have painstakingly produced very good candidates for the forthcoming elections and this is not going well with the governors of some states. “For example, last week, the forum leadership was forced to go to Ebonyi State to address a draconian issue that have been brewing there, where intimidation, harassment, arrest, killings have become the order of the day, under the watch of the governor of Ebonyi state, His Excellency, Governor Nwifuru. “We made a presentation, and with me here is a copy of the petition that we’re unfolding to the Inspector General of Police today, and to other relevant security agencies. DSS, last night, responded to former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, saying its operatives deployed to the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto State, Mannir Daniya, recently brought him to safety when he was attacked on October 31. A statement by Deputy Director, Public Relations and Strategic Communications of the service, Favour Dozie, said, “The attention of the DG Department of State Services (DSS) has been drawn to allegation by elder statesman and ADC presidential candidate, Alhaji Atiku Abubakar, that DSS is organising protests in Sokoto State. “For the records, DSS operatives deployed to Sokoto ADC governorship candidate, Mannir Daniya, evacuated him to safety unhurt on 31st October 2026, when attacked in Sokoto. “Two DSS operatives were assaulted during the incident and are still being treated in the hospital. The governorship candidate called personally to appreciate the State Director of Sokoto Command and even requested for reinforcement from the DSS.” DSS added, “Recall also that, on 2nd March 2026, the service arrested Monday Udeme Steven in Rivers State, for threatening to attack Peter Obi, NDC presidential candidate. He was prosecuted by the service in a Rivers Federal High Court, and sentenced to two (2) years imprisonment. DSS stated, “The service also uses this medium to reference a similar allegation by AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore that the service was involved in an attack on him in Ekiti State.

前副总统承诺今天将在索科托州发表集会讲话，PDP各州主席向警察总监察长提交申诉

非洲民主大会（ADC）总统候选人阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔指控国家/state安全局（DSS）领导层招募打手，破坏该党在索科托州的竞选活动。阿蒂库还谴责州政府在该州对ADC成员实施暴力和政治恐吓，并拒绝允许反对派使用公共设施举行集会和竞选活动。他承诺，无论安全机构的行动以及州政府拒绝提供公共设施使用权的决定如何，他今天都将在索科托发表集会讲话。

与此同时，人民民主党（PDP）各州主席就所谓APC州长对党员进行恐吓和骚扰，向警察总监察长通吉·迪苏提交申诉。索科托州前州长、索科托南选区参议员阿米努·坦布瓦尔也谴责了该州所谓的政治恐吓，并承诺捍卫民主权利和结社自由。

DSS回应阿蒂库称，尽管其总监察长已下令调查招募打手的指控，但出于对阿蒂库的敬意，派驻索科托州ADC州长候选人曼尼尔·达尼亚的特勤人员最近在他于10月31日遭袭时，将其安全转移，且未受伤害。昨天在阿布贾举行的新闻发布会上，这位前副总统说：“今天，我怀着沉重而坚定的心与你们讲话。索科托正在发生的事情不是普通的政治竞争。

“这是一场蓄意策划的行动，旨在挫败非洲民主大会，阻碍我们的竞选，并剥夺尼日利亚人民自由选择的权利。

“本应向每个政党开放、供合法竞选活动使用的公共设施遭到封锁，后勤支持也被拒绝提供。

“这不是无害的行政延误，而是蓄意阻挠ADC获得公平竞争环境的企图。”

阿蒂库说：“更令人不安的是，我们掌握的信息显示，国家/state安全局领导层正在招募人员在索科托组织抗议。

“其目的是制造混乱，为APCcontrolled州政府实施宵禁提供借口，并阻止我们的竞选如期展开。

“我们知道这些抗议人员中的部分人员在哪里集结：科科路Zenith Bank后面的一间办公室。车辆停在那里，并被派往包括环岛在内的关键地点。

“这些被动员的抗议者正在造成交通拥堵。通勤者受到威胁，有些还遭到殴打。一些抗议者已经离开环岛去寻找阴凉处。”

阿蒂库说：“这不是情报工作，而是披着官方制服的政治干预。安全机构的职责是保护尼日利亚人民、捍卫法律，而不是招募抗议者或协助某个政党制造危机。在把破坏和平的责任归咎于现任政府时，阿蒂库说：“三年来半，蒂努布政府投入了过多精力削弱可信的反对派，却投入太少精力解决尼日利亚人民面临的问题。

“它推行吸纳和恐吓式政治，同时把昔日反对派人物吸纳进APC，压缩政治竞争空间。其目标是把尼日利亚变成一个除名义外实质上的一党制国家。

“政府害怕人民的裁决。它引发了严重的生活成本危机，如今似乎决心阻挠尼日利亚人民选择另一条道路的民主权利。食品、交通、燃料、电力及其他基本生活必需品已让数百万人无力负担。”

这位前副总统表示：“各个家庭都在艰难地养活孩子、缴纳学费并维持生意。这是政府本应向人民说明并为其辩护的政绩，而不是它试图阻止一场集会。”

谈及如果明年当选总统后的国家计划，阿蒂库宣布：“我会让生活重新变得负担得起。我们将支持本地生产，强化粮食生产，创造就业，并降低经营成本。

“我们将推行与在尼日利亚炼制的燃料挂钩、有针对性的生产补贴，使支持通过可衡量的relief惠及消费者，同时加强国内产业。”

阿蒂库说：“APC至今仍未从其上次在卡杜纳举行集会时的惨败中恢复过来。

“它本应把这视为一个警告，即尼日利亚人民正在撤回对它的信任。相反，它选择了恐吓和阻挠。这是垂死之马的最后几脚踢。

ADC总统候选人说：“2027年大选将成为我们民主历史上的决定性时刻。这不仅仅是政党或候选人之间的竞争。

“这是对一个漠视人民苦难的政府，与已经受够苦難、希望自己的选票能够计入的尼日利亚人民之间的选择。”

他说：“我们不会被恐吓到沉默或变得无关紧要。我们的竞选将继续进行。上帝愿意的话，明天我将在索科托，向该州善良的人们发表讲话。

“我呼吁索科托人民保持冷静与和平。不要让任何人挑衅你们，或把政治集会变成安全危机。”

阿蒂库对当局说：“我也敦促安全机构不偏不倚地保护通勤者、居民和集会参与者。当局必须确保我们的集会能够和平举行，不受干预。

“对尼日利亚选民而言，要保持坚定，站稳立场。民主自由不是任何政府的馈赠，而是你们的权利。不要允许任何人恐吓你们，或压制你们的意志。”

阿蒂库表示：“作为非洲民主大会总统候选人，我向你们保证：我将领导这场竞选，绝不会弃阵。我们将以坚定、组织和对尼日利亚人民的信念，应对每一次限制民主参与的企图。

“ADC将与拒绝被用来反对民主、并忠于宪法的安全人员站在一起。那些选择背弃职责、串通压制政治自由的人，将依法被追究责任。

“尼日利亚属于它的人民，而不属于任何政党或掌权的临时统治者。我们将捍卫这一真理以及人民的选择权。”

索科托州前州长、索科托南选区参议员阿米努·坦布瓦尔谴责了该州所谓的政治恐吓，并承诺捍卫民主权利和结社自由。坦布瓦尔周一在索科托接待社会民主党（SDP）总统候选人阿德沃勒·阿德巴约进行礼节性拜访时表达了上述立场。坦布瓦尔说，他很高兴接待该代表团，并指出此次来访正值索科托州政治历史上一个格外重要的时期。

这位前州长重申，索科托的建立遵循公平、包容治理和尊重不同意见的原则，强调该州属于所有尼日利亚人民。坦布瓦尔表示：“索科托属于所有尼日利亚人民。这里必须继续是一个友好的环境，让来自不同政治背景的人可以自由前来、交流并推广自己的理念，尤其是有关民主和善治的理念。”

他对他所称的该州令人不安的发展表示担忧。他指控州政府查封了ADC竞选办公室，并称该党州长候选人Hon. Manir Muhammad Dan’iya遭到政府认可的安全机构人员袭击。坦布瓦尔称，这些事件与索科托长期以来和平、好客和政治宽容的声誉不符，并警告此类行为可能损害该州的民主形象。

坦布瓦尔说，反对派将继续抵制任何可能限制政治自由或阻止公民参与民主进程的行动。

这位参议员赞扬阿德巴约的勇气、爱国精神以及对国家发展的投入，尤其赞扬他尽管来自同一地缘政治区域，仍决定挑战蒂努布。

阿德巴约表示，他到该州是为了祝贺索科托苏丹、尊贵的Alhaji Muhammad Sa’ad Abubakar III登基20周年。他称索科托是尼日利亚历史、知识和政治遗产的重要中心。他说，索科托的重要性超越了其作为哈里发国中心的身份，体现了它对知识进步和国家发展的持久贡献。

阿德巴约说：“我们来到索科托，向登基20周年的索科托苏丹表达良好祝愿。我们认为应该来到这里，因为正如我们所知，索科托与尼日利亚历史密不可分。我们把索科托不仅视为哈里发国中心，也视为知识中心。”

阿德巴约还呼吁索科托州政府尊重政治多样性，保障反对派政治人物的行动自由，强调不应因政治立场而拒绝任何尼日利亚人进入全国任何地区。

与此同时，PDP各州主席论坛主席奥斯汀·恩瓦丘库在该党全国秘书处与全国工作委员会（NWC）会议上说，APC州长正在各自州内恐吓和骚扰该党成员。恩瓦丘库表示：“我只想利用这个机会向全国工作委员会提请注意，全国一些州，尤其是我们由担任州长的APC人士执政的州，对我们的候选人和成员非常敌视。

“我们为即将举行的选举精心推出了非常优秀的候选人，但一些州的州长却没有为此提供有利环境。

“例如，上周，论坛领导层被迫前往埃博尼州，处理一个在那里酝酿已久的残酷问题。在该州州长Nwifuru阁下任内，恐吓、骚扰、逮捕和杀戮已成为家常便饭。

“我们作了汇报，随身带来了今天要向警察总监察长以及其他相关安全机构提交的请愿书副本。DSS昨晚回应前副总统阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔称，其派驻索科托州ADC州长候选人曼尼尔·达尼亚的特勤人员，最近在达尼亚于10月31日于索科托遭袭时，将其安全转移。

DSS公共关系与战略传播副主任Favour Dozie发表声明说：“国家/state安全局（DSS）总监察长已注意到政治元老、ADC总统候选人Alhaji Atiku Abubakar提出的指控，即DSS正在索科托州组织抗议。

“兹予说明，DSS派驻索科托州ADC州长候选人曼尼尔·达尼亚的特勤人员，于2026年10月31日达尼亚在索科托遭袭时，将其安全转移，且未受伤害。

“两名DSS特勤人员在事件中遭到袭击，目前仍在医院接受治疗。该州长候选人亲自致电，对索科托指挥部州级主任表示感谢，甚至请求DSS增派人手。”

DSS补充说：“还应回顾，2026年3月2日，本局在 Rivers州逮捕Monday Udeme Steven，原因是其威胁袭击NDC总统候选人Peter Obi。本局在Rivers联邦高等法院对其提起诉讼，并判处其两（2）年监禁。”

DSS表示：“本局也借此渠道回应AAC总统候选人Omoyele Sowore提出的类似指控，即本局参与了在Ekiti州对他的袭击。

It maintained that any electoral process that failed to meet the standards of freedom, fairness and transparency would be rejected by Nigerians, who, it said, were determined to exercise their democratic rights. In a statement by its spokesman, Indris Zekeri Jnr, the Peter Obi Media Office, said, governors should recognise that political leadership was a privilege earned through service and not an entitlement to be retained through deceit, intimidation or interference with elections. The statement, titled: “Nigerians Will Choose the Best Product in the Marketplace” accused some governors of becoming increasingly desperate as the 2027 general election approaches. “Instead of presenting their records of service, performance and achievements, they are turning to electoral manipulation and safeguards for rigging,” the statement alleged. It warned that attempts to undermine the democratic process would not permanently suppress the will of the electorate, insisting that Nigerians had become increasingly determined to reject leaders they considered undeserving of another mandate. Part of the statement read: “The 2027 election will be a defining moment for our nation. Nigerians are resolved to reclaim their country through the power of their votes. The media office further argued that political leaders should be judged by their records and capacity to address the country’s challenges rather than their ability to deploy political influence to retain power.
