https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.summary: The position followed deliberations on a motion sponsored by the Senate Chief Whip, Senator Mohammed Tahir Monguno, seeking the renegotiation of the Bilateral Air Service Agreement (BASA) between Nigeria and China to guarantee reciprocal flight rights for indigenous airlines. The debate also featured concerns over alleged illegal mining activities by Chinese nationals in Nigeria, calls for stronger indigenous airlines and demands for strict reciprocity in the country’s aviation relationship with China.
https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.summary_zh: 这一立场是在审议参议院首席党鞭Mohammed Tahir Monguno议员提出的一项动议后形成的。该动议要求重新谈判尼日利亚与中国之间的双边航空服务协议（BASA），以确保本国航空公司享有对等飞行权。辩论还涉及对据称中国公民在尼日利亚从事非法采矿活动的担忧、进一步加强本土航空公司的呼吁，以及要求该国在与中国航空关系中实行严格对等原则。
https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.body: The position followed deliberations on a motion sponsored by the Senate Chief Whip, Senator Mohammed Tahir Monguno, seeking the renegotiation of the Bilateral Air Service Agreement (BASA) between Nigeria and China to guarantee reciprocal flight rights for indigenous airlines. Although several lawmakers supported the revival of a national carrier, the Senate maintained that the proposal would require a separate legislative process before any formal decision could be taken. The debate also featured concerns over alleged illegal mining activities by Chinese nationals in Nigeria, calls for stronger indigenous airlines and demands for strict reciprocity in the country’s aviation relationship with China. Leading the debate, Monguno, who represents Borno North, recalled that Nigeria and China signed the Bilateral Air Service Agreement under former President Muhammadu Buhari to establish direct commercial air links and regulate flight operations between the two countries. He, however, expressed concern that the agreement had not been effectively implemented to guarantee reciprocal benefits for Nigerian airlines. Monguno disclosed that bilateral trade between Nigeria and China reached $18 billion in the first half of 2025, representing a 25 per cent year-on-year increase, while total trade volume stood at $28 billion in 2024. He also revealed that more than 100,000 Nigerians reside in China, while over 500,000 Chinese nationals live in Nigeria, stressing that the growing economic and population ties made direct air connectivity increasingly necessary. According to him, effective implementation of the agreement would transform the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos, and the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja, into major aviation gateways connecting West and Central Africa to East Asia. He identified reduced travel time, improved supply chains, increased airline revenues, foreign exchange retention and expanded opportunities for small and medium-scale enterprises as some of the benefits of direct flights. The Senate Chief Whip further argued that improved air connectivity would support non-oil exports, particularly agricultural products, while strengthening Nigeria’s position in international trade. He called on the Federal Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development, the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority, the Central Bank of Nigeria and the Nigeria Customs Service to collaborate towards effective implementation of the agreement. Seconding the motion, Senator Abdul Ahmed Ningi, representing Bauchi Central, described the proposal as patriotic and beneficial to the country but raised concerns over the activities of Chinese nationals in Nigeria’s solid minerals sector. Ningi alleged that some Chinese mining operations in parts of Bauchi State and other locations might be operating without complying with all relevant legal requirements. He particularly cited mining activities in communities within his constituency bordering Kaduna and Plateau states, expressing concern over the scale of operations, equipment deployed and alleged exportation of raw mineral resources without sufficient local processing. The lawmaker called for stronger government oversight to ensure that Nigeria derives adequate economic benefits from its mineral resources. On the aviation agreement, Ningi lamented that Nigerians travelling to China often had to connect through countries such as Morocco, the United Arab Emirates, Ethiopia and the United Kingdom because of the absence of direct flights by Nigerian airlines. He argued that domestic carriers should receive the necessary government support to operate direct international routes. Ningi specifically identified Air Peace, United Nigeria Airlines, Azman Air and Ibom Air as Nigerian carriers that could be encouraged to expand their operations to China, subject to the necessary regulatory and operational requirements. He insisted that Nigeria should not continue granting Chinese airlines access to its aviation market without securing equivalent opportunities for Nigerian carriers. The senator consequently called for a review of the BASA if China failed to guarantee reciprocal flight rights for Nigerian airlines. Contributing to the debate, Senate President Godswill Akpabio advocated the revival of a national airline, arguing that Nigeria needed a strong indigenous carrier to compete effectively in the international aviation market. He recalled the defunct Nigerian Airways, noting that the country once operated a sizeable fleet of aircraft and maintained international routes. Akpabio expressed concern over the pressure on domestic airlines during peak travel periods, particularly in December when demand for air travel increases significantly. He argued that a national carrier would improve connectivity, retain foreign exchange within the country and reduce the difficulties faced by air travellers. The Senate President urged the Federal Government to reconsider the establishment of a national airline and commended Monguno for bringing the motion before the Senate. He also called on the Senate Committee on Legislative Compliance to work with the Ministries of Aviation and Foreign Affairs to ensure that the resolutions were implemented within the stipulated period. Also contributing, Senator Mustapha Khabeeb, representing Jigawa South-West, supported the call for a national carrier but clarified that the focus should be on reviving Air Nigeria rather than the defunct Nigerian Airways. He argued that a functional national airline would enable Nigeria to operate direct international routes, generate foreign exchange and strengthen its presence in the global aviation industry. Similarly, Senator Mohammed Ogoshi, representing Nasarawa South, supported the additional prayer on strict reciprocity, endorsing Ningi’s proposal that Nigerian airlines should enjoy the same flight privileges granted to Chinese carriers. Following deliberations, the Senate adopted the motion and urged the Federal Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development to renegotiate the commercial terms and operational schedules of the existing Nigeria-China Bilateral Air Service Agreement. It also urged the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs to initiate diplomatic discussions with Chinese authorities on business visa facilitation for Nigerian traders and reciprocal allocation of flight slots to Nigerian airlines. In adopting Ningi’s additional proposal, supported by Senator Onawo, lawmakers urged the Federal Government to enforce strict reciprocity by ensuring that Nigerian airlines enjoy direct flight opportunities to China on the same basis as Chinese carriers operating in Nigeria. The Senate further warned that the agreement should be reviewed if the required reciprocal arrangements could not be secured. To ensure compliance, it mandated its Committees on Aviation and Foreign Affairs to monitor the implementation of the resolutions and report back within four weeks. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.title_zh: 参议院拒绝重振尼日利亚航空公司的动议，要求开通飞往中国的直飞航班
https://leadership.ng/senate-shelves-nig.body_zh: 参议院首席党鞭、参议员穆罕默德·塔希尔·蒙古诺提出的动议经过审议后获得通过。该动议要求重新谈判尼日利亚与中国之间的《双边航空服务协定》（BASA），以确保尼日利亚本土航空公司享有对等飞行权。尽管多名议员支持复兴国家航空公司，但参议院认为，在作出任何正式决定之前，该提案仍需经过单独的立法程序。辩论中还涉及对中国公民在尼日利亚涉嫌非法采矿活动的担忧，以及加强本土航空公司实力、要求尼日利亚与中国的航空关系严格遵循对等原则的诉求。主持辩论的蒙古诺代表博尔诺州北区，他回顾称，尼日利亚与中国在前总统穆罕马德·布哈里任内签署了《双边航空服务协定》，旨在建立直达商业航线并规范两国之间的飞行运营。不过，他对该协定未能得到有效落实、无法为尼日利亚航空公司保证对等利益表示担忧。蒙古诺透露，2025年上半年，尼日利亚与中国的双边贸易额达到180亿美元，同比增长25%，而2024年贸易总额为280亿美元。他还透露，目前有超过10万名尼日利亚人居住在中国，超过50万名中国公民生活在尼日利亚，并强调不断加深的经济和人口联系使直达航空服务显得日益必要。据他所说，有效落实该协定将把拉各斯穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场和阿布贾纳姆迪·阿齐克韦国际机场打造为连接西非和中非与东亚的重要航空门户。他列举了直飞航班带来的多项好处，包括缩短旅行时间、改善供应链、增加航空公司收入、留住外汇以及为中小企业拓宽机会。参议院首席党鞭进一步指出，改善航空连通性将支持非石油出口，尤其是农产品出口，同时增强尼日利亚在国际贸易中的地位。他呼吁联邦航空与航天发展部、尼日利亚民航局、尼日利亚中央银行和尼日利亚海关总署协作，推动该协定得到有效落实。附议该动议的参议员阿卜杜勒·艾哈迈德·宁吉代表包奇州中区，称该提案富有爱国精神且有利于国家，但他对中国公民在尼日利亚固体矿产领域开展的活动表示担忧。宁吉称，巴奇州部分地区及其他地方的一些中国采矿业务可能未遵守所有相关法律要求。他特别提到其选区境内毗邻卡杜纳州和高原州的几个社区存在采矿活动，并对作业规模、投入的设备以及所谓在缺乏充分本地加工的情况下出口原生矿产资源表示担忧。这名议员呼吁加强政府监管，确保尼日利亚能够从矿产资源中获得充分的经济利益。在航空协定方面，宁吉感叹，由于尼日利亚航空公司没有直飞中国的航班，赴华尼日利亚人往往需要在摩洛哥、阿拉伯联合酋长国、埃塞俄比亚和英国等国家转机。他认为，本土航空公司应获得必要的政府支持，以运营直达国际航线。宁吉特别指出，Air Peace、United Nigeria Airlines、Azman Air和Ibom Air等尼日利亚航空公司可以在满足必要监管和运营要求的前提下，获鼓励拓展中国市场。他坚持认为，在未为尼日利亚航空公司争取到同等机会的情况下，尼日利亚不应继续向中国航空公司开放本国航空市场。因此，这位参议员要求，如果中国未能保证尼日利亚航空公司的对等飞行权，就应重新审查BASA。参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿卡皮奥参与辩论时主张复兴国家航空公司，认为尼日利亚需要一家实力雄厚的本土航空公司，才能在国际航空市场有效竞争。他回顾了已停运的尼日利亚航空公司，并指出该国过去曾运营一支规模可观的机队并维持多条国际航线。阿卡皮奥对旅游高峰期国内航空公司承受的压力表示担忧，尤其是每年12月航空出行需求大幅增加之际。他认为，国家航空公司将改善航空连通性、把外汇留在国内，并减轻航空旅客面临的困难。参议院议长敦促联邦政府重新考虑建立国家航空公司，并赞扬蒙古诺将动议提交参议院。他还要求参议院立法合规委员会与航空部、外交部合作，确保有关决议在规定期限内得到落实。参议员穆斯塔法·哈比卜代表吉加瓦州西南区，也参与了讨论。他支持建立国家航空公司的呼吁，但强调重点应放在复兴Air Nigeria，而非已停运的Nigerian Airways。他认为，一家正常运营的国家航空公司将使尼日利亚能够开通直达国际航线、创造外汇，并加强其在全球航空业的存在。同样，代表纳萨拉瓦州南区的参议员穆罕默德·奥戈什支持要求严格对等原则的补充动议，赞同宁吉关于尼日利亚航空公司应享有中国航空公司同等待遇和飞行权利的提议。经过审议，参议院通过该动议，并敦促联邦航空与航天发展部重新谈判现行《尼日利亚—中国双边航空服务协定》的商业条款和运营时刻安排。参议院还敦促联邦外交部启动与中方当局的外交磋商，为尼日利亚商人便利化商务签证，并为尼日利亚航空公司争取对等分配航班时刻。在采纳宁吉提出并获参议员奥纳沃支持的补充建议时，议员们敦促联邦政府实行严格对等原则，确保尼日利亚航空公司能够在中国享有与中国航空公司运营尼日利亚市场时同等条件下的直飞机会。参议院进一步警告，如果无法取得所需的对等安排，就应重新审查该协定。为确保决议得到遵守，参议院责令其航空委员会和外交委员会监督决议落实情况，并在4周内提交报告。我们掌握独家优势。登录LEADERSHIP https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: The Nigerian Ports Authority (NPA) has said the country’s exports increased by more than 25 per cent in the last two years, attributing the growth to Federal Government reforms and improved collaboration with port operators. The Managing Director of NPA, Dr Abubakar Dantsoho, disclosed this while speaking at the ongoing Annual World Ports Conference in London, organised by the International Association of Ports and Harbours (IAPH). He said Nigeria’s population and economic potential gave it an advantage over other countries in West and Central Africa, adding that recent reforms had also improved cargo throughput at the nation’s ports. Dantsoho said the export growth was not limited to oil and gas but extended to manufacturing and agricultural products, including cocoa, cashew and other raw materials. “Statistically, the exports from Nigeria in the last two years has increased by 25 per cent. And then these are exports that are not mainly only oil and gas. In terms of oil and gas, like I mentioned, we are doing fantastically around that, but then also in the other areas of manufacturing and agriculture, you know, raw materials like cocoa, like cashew and all that. Volumes have increased,” he said. He attributed the growth partly to the partnership between the NPA and major terminal operators, particularly APM Terminals. The NPA chief said the authority had put measures in place to sustain the growth, including the establishment of Export Processing Terminals to facilitate the handling and documentation of export cargoes. He disclosed that about four such terminals were operating in Nigeria, with the NPA collaborating with terminal operators, the Nigeria Customs Service and other relevant agencies to ensure that export cargoes were processed locally and met required standards before shipment. Dantsoho said the reforms had also positioned Nigeria to take greater advantage of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), particularly through increased trade with other African countries. He cited Nigeria’s engagement with Morocco, which he described as a growing manufacturing hub for electric and other vehicles, as an example of opportunities for cooperation. The NPA managing director also attributed Nigeria’s improved performance in global port rankings to increased efficiency, technology adoption and collaboration with industry stakeholders. He said two Nigerian ports featured among the top 20 in the latest World Bank global ports ranking. Dantsoho further disclosed that revenue generated from ports across the country had quadrupled, alongside an increase in cargo volumes. He said the authority was monitoring port performance across West and Central Africa through a regional dashboard, adding that the data showed improvements in Nigeria’s port efficiency as well as progress in countries such as Tanzania and Kenya. According to him, the NPA plans to sustain partnerships with major industry players in countries including Morocco and South Africa to improve port operations and regional trade. On infrastructure development, Dantsoho said the Federal Government was planning to invest $1 billion in the expansion and modernisation of Apapa Port as part of its medium- to long-term strategy. He said the project would require substantial private-sector participation, adding that the NPA was working with APM Terminals and other investors to mobilise the required capital. The authority was also pursuing technology partnerships to improve port operations, he said. Dantsoho disclosed that the NPA had partnered with a Singaporean firm to develop a single-window system, while discussions were ongoing with a company from Abu Dhabi to develop a port community system. He said the initiatives were expected to improve coordination among port stakeholders, simplify processes and enhance efficiency. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚出口额两年内增长25%
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh: 尼日利亚港务局（NPA）表示，过去两年该国出口增长超过25%，并将这一增长归因于联邦政府的改革以及与港口运营商合作得到改善。NPA总经理阿布巴卡尔·丹措霍博士在伦敦举行的年度世界港口大会上透露了上述情况。此次大会由国际港口和港湾协会（IAPH）组织。他说，尼日利亚的人口和经济潜力使该国相较于西非和中非其他国家具有优势，近期改革也提高了全国港口的货物吞吐量。丹措霍表示，出口增长不仅限于石油和天然气，还延伸至制造产品和农产品，包括可可、腰果及其他原材料。他说：“从统计上看，过去两年尼日利亚的出口增长了25%。而且这些出口并非主要依靠石油和天然气。在石油和天然气方面，正如我提到的，我们取得了极其显著的成绩，但在制造和农业等其他领域也实现了增长，例如可可、腰果等原材料。货运量已经增加。”他指出，出口增长部分得益于NPA与主要码头运营商，尤其是APM Terminals之间的合作。这名NPA负责人表示，该局已采取措施维持增长势头，包括设立出口加工码头，以便利出口货物的装卸和单证办理。他透露，尼日利亚目前约有4座此类码头正在运营，NPA正与码头运营商、尼日利亚海关总署及其他相关机构合作，确保出口货物在当地完成处理，并在装运前符合规定标准。丹措霍表示，改革还使尼日利亚能够更加充分地利用非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的优势，尤其是通过增加与其他非洲国家的贸易额。他以尼日利亚与摩洛哥的合作为例，称摩洛哥正日益发展成为电动车辆及其他车辆的制造中心，并认为这体现了合作机会。NPA总经理还表示，效率提高、技术应用以及与行业利益相关方加强合作，使尼日利亚在全球港口排名中的表现有所改善。他说，在最新的世界银行全球港口排名中，有2座尼日利亚港口跻身前20名。丹措霍进一步透露，随着货运量增加，全国各港口产生的收入增长了4倍。他说，该局通过一个区域性仪表板监测西非和中非各地的港口表现，数据显示尼日利亚港口效率有所提高，坦桑尼亚和肯尼亚等国家也取得进展。据他介绍，NPA计划与摩洛哥和南非等国家的行业主要企业保持合作，以改善港口运营并促进区域贸易。在基础设施开发方面，丹措霍表示，作为其中长期战略的一部分，联邦政府计划投资10亿美元扩建和现代化改造阿帕帕港。他说，该项目需要私营部门大力参与，NPA正与APM Terminals及其他投资者合作，以筹集所需资本。他表示，该局还在寻求技术合作伙伴关系，以改善港口运营。丹措霍透露，NPA已与一家新加坡公司合作开发单一窗口系统，同时正与阿布扎比的一家公司商谈开发港口社区系统。他说，预计这些举措将改善港口各利益相关方之间的协调，简化流程并提高效率。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.politico.eu/article/greenlan.body: U.S. President Donald Trump called Greenland the greatest gift the United States had ever received in a call to Fox News on Tuesday. “Remember, [Europe] just gave the United States the greatest gift we were ever given. Do you know what it was? Greenland. We just got Greenland, you know that, right?” he said during a broadcast about Tuesday’s midterm elections, which was reshared on X by the U.S. State Department. Someone else on the call quickly clarified that Trump was referring to “a military deal.” Until September, Trump had repeatedly pushed for the U.S. to take control of the large, mineral-rich island, which is a self-governing territory within the Kingdom of Denmark, citing national security reasons. His fixation on the idea, and his repeated refusals to rule out using military force to take the territory — as well as his use of tariffs against allied countries he saw as standing in his way — stretched the NATO alliance close to breaking point . At NATO’s annual summit in July, Trump said the island “should be controlled by the United States, not by Denmark,” provoking warnings from European leaders who maintain the territory is not for sale and that its future should be left to its people. In September, Trump signed a defense agreement with the prime ministers of Greenland and Denmark, ending the stand-off. The deal expands U.S. military access and presence, and effectively grants NATO countries exclusivity on mining, while recognizing Denmark’s sovereignty and Greenlanders’ right to self-determination. American voters head to the polls on Tuesday for the midterm elections. During the call, Trump said he thinks the results will be “better than you think.” Democrats are widely expected to make gains against the president’s Republican party
https://www.politico.eu/article/greenlan.title_zh: 特朗普称欧洲将格陵兰岛赠予美国，是“有史以来最伟大的礼物”
https://www.politico.eu/article/greenlan.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二接受福克斯新闻采访时，称格陵兰是美国收到过的最great礼物。特朗普在一次关于周二中期选举的直播节目中说：“记住，[欧洲]刚刚给了美国一份我们收到过的最伟大的礼物。你知道是什么吗？格陵兰。我们刚刚得到了格陵兰，你知道的，对吧？”美国国务院随后在X上转发了这段内容。通话中的另一位人士迅速澄清，特朗普所说的实际上是“一项军事协议”。直到9月，特朗普一直以国家安全为由，推动美国控制这个矿产丰富的大型岛屿。该岛是丹麦王国内部的自治领地。他对这一构想的执着，以及他一再拒绝排除动用武力夺取该领土的可能性，再加上他对那些他认为妨碍自己的盟国实施关税，使北约联盟一度濒临破裂。在7月举行的北约年度峰会上，特朗普称该岛“应由美国控制，而不是由丹麦控制”，引发欧洲领导人警告。他们坚持认为，该领土不出售，其未来应交由当地居民决定。9月，特朗普与格陵兰和丹麦的总理签署了一项防务协议，结束了对峙。这项协议扩大了美国对该地区的军事准入和驻军存在，并实际上赋予北约国家独家采矿权，同时承认丹麦的主权以及格陵兰人的自决权。美国选民周二前往投票站参加中期选举。通话中，特朗普表示，他认为选举结果将“比你想象的更好”。外界普遍预计，民主党将在这场选举中从总统所属的共和党手中夺回部分席位

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/w.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Weeks before the expiry of the Ganga Water Treaty in December, the Ministry of External Affairs on Tuesday (November 3, 2026) reiterated that India and Bangladesh have a “structured mechanism” to deal with the treaty’s requirements. Addressing the bi-weekly media briefing, MEA official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal reiterated that India has invited Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit New Delhi but that there is neither any “update” on the treaty’s renewal nor on the dates for the trip. Also read | Ganga Water Treaty is ‘flawed’, needs to be updated: Bangladesh river expert “Between India and Bangladesh, we have a Joint Rivers Commission which is the structured mechanism for discussion on all cross-boundary rivers, including the Ganga,” said Mr. Jaiswal, adding that India wishes to have a “positive relationship” with Bangladesh. The bilateral Ganga Water Treaty is set to expire on December 12. The treaty was signed in 1996 between India and Bangladesh when Sheikh Hasina of Awami League became Bangladesh’s Prime Minister for the first time. The three-decade old agreement for river water sharing requires expert-level and political consultations for renewing the pact. It is understood that since the treaty was signed at the level of Prime Ministers (Ms. Hasina and then Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda), a renewal of the agreement would happen at a meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman. However, Mr. Rahman who has visited China, Japan, Malaysia and the United States so far, has not yet responded to the invites from India though he was invited to both bilateral and multilateral events during the BRICS Summit in New Delhi in September. “As far as India-Bangladesh relationship is concerned we want to work towards a positive, forward looking and constructive relation,” said Mr. Jaiswal reiterating India’s invites to Prime Minister Rahman. Diplomatic sources from the Bangladeshi side had informed earlier that they are expecting an automatic short-term renewal of the treaty after the expiry on December 12, though the Indian officials have not indicated at that till now. Mr. Jaiswal also took note of the protests by the readymade garment industry workers in Bangladesh who have been hitting the streets demanding fair wages as the country faces high inflation and electricity crisis. “Yes, we have been following the situation in Bangladesh. There have been developments there and we will continue to follow the developments,” he said in response to a question on the protests by the workers in the garments sector. https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.title: Germany’s Merz warns Europe needs seat at the table as Trump renews Ukraine talks
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.summary: BERLIN — German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Europe must help shape any Ukraine peace agreement as U.S. President Donald Trump renews his push to negotiate a deal with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin.
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.summary_zh: 柏林——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普再次推动与其俄罗斯 counterpart弗拉基米尔·普京协商达成协议之际，德国总理弗里德里希·默茨警告，欧洲必须参与塑造任何乌克兰和平协议。
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.body: BERLIN — German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Europe must help shape any Ukraine peace agreement as U.S. President Donald Trump renews his push to negotiate a deal with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin. “Europe must and wants to play a role in this process,” said Merz alongside Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Berlin Tuesday. “Key elements of a peaceful solution — whether regarding sanctions or the security architecture — can only be resolved with us Europeans. And everyone involved knows that very well.” “The U.S. and Russia — with all due respect to the U.S. — cannot decide whether Ukraine will become a member state of the European Union,” Zelenskyy said. “For that we need the support of other countries, and all of those countries are in Europe.” Merz’s meeting with Zelenskyy in Berlin comes as the Trump administration renews efforts to reach a negotiated end to the full-scale war in Ukraine and before U.S.-brokered talks between Ukraine and Russia are set to resume in Abu Dhabi next week . The meeting in Berlin also comes a day before talks hosted by the European Commission with representatives from the U.S., Ukraine and key European allies on Ukraine’s post-war reconstruction and economic future. Merz also sharply criticized the U.S. decision to invite Russian President Vladimir Putin to December’s G20 summit in Miami, saying the move is shutting Ukraine out of talks about its own fate. “If President Trump were to decide to invite the Russian president, then Ukraine must be the first topic of discussion,” Merz said. “And if Ukraine is discussed, then the president of Ukraine must be seated at the table. In any case, from my perspective, it is completely unacceptable for third countries to discuss Ukraine’s fate without involving Ukraine itself.” European leaders, including Merz, have long feared the U.S. may pursue a Ukraine peace deal on terms that sideline Europe and disadvantage Ukraine
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.title_zh: 特朗普重启乌克兰谈判之际，德国总理默茨警告欧洲需要参与决策
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.body_zh: 柏林——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普再次推动与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京就协议进行谈判之际，德国总理弗里德里希·默茨警告，欧洲必须参与塑造任何乌克兰和平协议。周二，默茨在柏林与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基一同发表讲话时表示：“欧洲必须，也希望在这一进程中发挥重要作用。和平解决方案的关键要素——无论是制裁还是安全架构——只有在我们欧洲人的参与下才能解决。所有相关方都非常清楚这一点。”泽连斯基说：“美国和俄罗斯——充分尊重美国——不能决定乌克兰是否会成为欧盟成员国。为此，我们需要其他国家的支持，而所有这些国家都在欧洲。”此前，特朗普政府正加紧努力，争取通过谈判结束乌克兰全面战争；由美国斡旋的乌克兰与俄罗斯会谈定于下周在阿布扎比恢复。默茨在柏林与泽连斯基会晤之际，欧洲委员会也将在次日主持会谈，邀请美国、乌克兰以及欧洲主要盟友的代表，讨论乌克兰的战后重建与经济未来。默茨还严厉批评美国决定邀请俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京出席12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团峰会，称此举将乌克兰排除在有关自身命运的讨论之外。默茨说：“如果特朗普总统决定邀请俄罗斯总统，那么乌克兰必须成为讨论的首要议题。而且，如果要讨论乌克兰，乌克兰总统就必须坐在谈判桌旁。无论如何，在我看来，第三方国家不邀请乌克兰参与，就讨论乌克兰的命运，是完全不可接受的。”包括默茨在内的欧洲领导人长期以来一直担心，美国可能会推动一项将欧洲边缘化并使乌克兰处于不利地位的乌克兰和平协议……

https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.title: ASUU Backs TSU Strike, Urges Kefas To Implement 2025 Agreement
https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.summary: The ASUU Yola Zone Coordinator, Dani Mamman, made the call on Tuesday during a solidarity visit to the university in Jalingo, where he accused the Taraba State Government of failing to honour its agreement with academic staff.
https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.summary_zh: 尼日利亚教师工会（ASUU）Yola（地区）协调员Dani Mamman于周二提出这一要求。他当时到Jalingo的大学进行声援访问，指责Taraba（州）政府未能履行与教职员工达成的协议。
https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.body: The union said TSU was the only university in the North yet to implement the agreed remuneration framework, despite the conclusion of a government-constituted verification exercise. The ASUU Yola Zone Coordinator, Dani Mamman, made the call on Tuesday during a solidarity visit to the university in Jalingo, where he accused the Taraba State Government of failing to honour its agreement with academic staff. Mamman described the delay as a breach of an established agreement and a disregard for the welfare and legitimate entitlements of lecturers, insisting that the grievances of the TSU branch were legitimate and required urgent government intervention. He expressed concern that while other state governments across the North-East had implemented the 2025 agreement, Taraba State was yet to do so, despite the completion of a verification exercise initiated by the state government. According to him, a fact-finding team constituted by the government had established that the universities visited had fully implemented the agreement. He said the report was reportedly presented to the union on September 24, 2026, following a verification exercise that commenced in August. Mamman, however, expressed disappointment that the government was still undertaking salary computations despite the conclusion of the exercise, describing the development as an unnecessary administrative delay. He also faulted the reported consideration of three implementation options of 95 per cent, 98 per cent and 100 per cent, arguing that the verification and financial assessment processes had already been concluded. The ASUU zonal coordinator insisted that the remuneration framework should be implemented in accordance with the payment template contained in the December 23, 2025 Federal Government-ASUU agreement, which was circulated by the National Salaries, Incomes and Wages Commission on December 30, 2025. He explained that the agreement covered several remuneration components, including Basic CONUASS, Consolidated Academic Tools Allowance, Professorial Allowance, Earned Academic Allowances and responsibility allowances for designated academic and administrative positions. Mamman warned that continued delays could undermine staff retention, institutional competitiveness and the university’s ability to attract qualified academic personnel, with adverse implications for academic standards and institutional stability. He consequently demanded immediate and full implementation of the agreement without further consultations, committees or verification exercises. The union also demanded payment of all accumulated arrears in line with the financial computation submitted by the tripartite committee, strict adherence to the agreed payment template and meaningful engagement with the TSU branch to resolve the ongoing industrial dispute. Mamman said academic staff had demonstrated considerable patience through sustained engagements and constructive dialogue before resorting to industrial action, reaffirming the zonal leadership’s solidarity with the striking lecturers. He maintained that industrial harmony was a collective responsibility and warned that the patience of academic staff should not be taken for granted. The ASUU leader appealed to stakeholders, members of the university community and the general public to prevail on the state government to honour the agreement, clear outstanding entitlements and bring the dispute to an amicable conclusion. The zonal leadership further alleged that TSU remained one of the few universities, if not the only institution among the 19 northern states, yet to implement the agreed remuneration framework. https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.body_zh: 工会表示，尽管政府组建的核查工作已经结束，TSU仍是北方唯一尚未落实双方商定薪酬框架的大学。ASUU约拉地区协调员Dani Mamman于周二前往贾林戈对这所大学进行声援访问时提出这一要求，并指责塔拉巴州政府未履行其与学术人员达成的协议。Mamman称，此举拖延既违反既定协议，也无视讲师的福利和合法权益；他坚持认为，TSU分会提出的诉求合理，需要政府立即干预。他表示担忧，东北部其他州政府均已落实2025年协议，但塔拉巴州尽管完成了州政府启动的核查工作，却仍未予执行。据他称，由政府组建的事实调查小组已经确认，受访大学均已全面落实协议。他说，该报告据称于2026年9月24日提交给工会，此前启动的核查工作于8月开始。然而，Mamman对核查结束后政府仍在计算工资感到失望，称这是没有必要的管理拖延。他还批评了据报正在考虑的95%、98%和100%三种落实方案，认为核查和财务评估程序均已结束。ASUU地区协调员坚持认为，薪酬框架应根据2025年12月23日联邦政府与ASUU协议所载的付款模板执行，该模板由National Salaries, Incomes and Wages Commission于2025年12月30日分发。他解释称，协议涵盖多个薪酬组成部分，包括基本CONUASS、综合学术工具津贴、教授津贴、 Earned Academic Allowances以及指定学术和行政岗位的职责津贴。Mamman警告称，持续拖延可能削弱教职员工的留任率、机构的竞争力以及大学吸引合格学术人才的能力，进而对学术标准和机构稳定造成不利影响。因此，他要求立即全面落实协议，不再进行任何磋商、设立委员会或开展核查。工会还要求，根据三方委员会提交的财务核算结果，支付所有积欠款项；严格遵守商定的付款模板；并与TSU分会展开实质性沟通，以解决持续存在的行业争议。Mamman说，在采取行业行动之前，学术人员通过持续交涉和建设性对话展现了极大的耐心；他再次确认地区领导层声援罢课讲师。他强调，行业和谐是集体责任，并警告称，不应把学术人员的耐心视为理所当然。ASUU负责人呼吁利益相关方、大学社区成员和公众向州政府施压，促使其履行协议、清偿拖欠待遇，并以友好方式结束争议。地区领导层进一步指控称，在北方19个州中，TSU仍是少数尚未落实商定薪酬框架的大学之一，甚至可能是唯一一所这样的院校。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、突发新闻和独家角度将直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时获取全天候更新 →

https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/0.body: U.S. first lady Melania Trump will host representatives from Russia and Ukraine at the White House this week to deliver remarks on a recently concluded ceasefire and humanitarian mission in the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, the White House announced Tuesday. The six-day ceasefire, which ended Sunday, had allowed emergency aid to reach Oleshky and any civilians to leave if they wanted, either to Ukrainian-controlled territory or Russia. “This achievement marks an unprecedented diplomatic initiative by an American First Lady,” the White House said in a statement, adding that Melania Trump will deliver an address on the Oleshky ceasefire at 11 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday. It did not name the Russian and Ukrainian representatives invited to appear during the address. A Ukrainian official told The Kyiv Independent that Russian Human Rights Commissioner Yana Lantratova and her Ukrainian counterpart Dmytro Lubinets will attend the White House event. Lantratova is currently under U.S. sanctions and will need a sanctions waiver from the State Department to enter the country. The announcement follows a report in the French newspaper Le Monde that claimed the humanitarian operation in Oleshky was negotiated over the course of four months by Russia’s GRU and Ukraine’s HUR military intelligence agencies. Sources cited by the newspaper suggested that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to credit the first lady for the ceasefire as a way to placate U.S. President Donald Trump as he seeks a diplomatic breakthrough in peace negotiations. Russia and the U.S. confirmed this week that trilateral talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine will resume in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10 and 11 after having stalled in February due to the conflict in the Middle East. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Korea weighs tax incentives for EVs as Chinese rivals gain ground
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Korea is weighing tax incentives for domestically produced electric vehicles (EVs) as Chinese rivals rapidly gain market share, fueling calls from automakers and lawmakers across party lines for government support to protect local production and jobs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 在中国竞争对手迅速抢占市场份额之际，韩国正考虑为国产电动汽车提供税收优惠。这引发了车企和议员跨党派要求政府提供支持，以保护本土生产和就业。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korea is weighing tax incentives for domestically produced electric vehicles (EVs) as Chinese rivals rapidly gain market share, fueling calls from automakers and lawmakers across party lines for government support to protect local production and jobs. Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il said the government would announce measures to strengthen the EV industry's competitiveness this month, following talks with Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Chung Euisun on Monday. Whether EVs should qualify for domestic production tax credits is expected to be a key focus of parliamentary debate over the government's tax reform plan. Chinese-made passenger EVs accounted for 43.5 percent of new registrations in Korea from January to September, up 8.4 percentage points from a year earlier, according to the Korea Automobile and Mobility Association and the Korea Automobile Importers and Distributors Association. Registrations more than doubled to about 112,400 vehicles from 51,500 year-on-year. Meanwhile, the share of domestically produced passenger EVs fell 6.2 percentage points to 48.7 percent, slipping below the 50 percent threshold for the first time. Chinese automakers are stepping up their push into the Korean market, following BYD's entry last year and Zeekr's local sales launch this year. Xpeng also appointed the first head of its new Korean unit on Tuesday, with former Volvo Car Korea executive Lee Man-sik set to take the post on Dec. 1. Chery Automobile and Great Wall Motor are also reportedly preparing to enter the market next year. The competitive pressure has intensified demands to extend a domestic production tax credit to EVs. The program, a key campaign pledge of President Lee Jae Myung, would provide tax credits based on production volumes to companies that manufacture and sell designated strategic products domestically. EVs were excluded from the government's tax reform proposal announced in August. During parliamentary audits last month, lawmakers from both the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) urged the government to extend the tax credit to domestically produced EVs. "The government stepped in to support our semiconductor industry when it was struggling. I believe we should provide support, including EV tax credits, to industries that are having difficulty competing with other countries and need a similar boost," Rep. Bae June-young of the PPP said during the audit. Rep. Moon Jin-seog of the DPK also criticized the exclusion of EVs from the government's tax reform proposal, saying it appeared to be pushing domestic automakers "to the brink" as they compete with price-competitive Chinese manufacturers. A total of 24 bills proposing to include EVs and other future mobility vehicles in the tax credit program have been introduced in the National Assembly. Seven more were submitted after the government unveiled its tax reform plan in August. The issue is expected to be taken up by the National Assembly's tax subcommittee this month, ahead of a possible floor vote in December. Meeting EV, autonomous-driving and parts industry executives on Monday, Lee signaled government engagement without committing to extending the credit. “Regarding support through electric vehicle production tax credits, the government will actively participate in parliamentary discussions and engage in in-depth discussions on the matter,” he said. He also said the government plans to announce a package of measures to strengthen the EV industry's competitiveness this month, incorporating industry feedback and support for autonomous driving technology and research and development of key components
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 随着中国竞争对手扩大优势，韩国考虑为电动汽车提供税收激励
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 随着中国竞争对手迅速抢占市场份额，韩国正考虑为国内生产的电动汽车提供税收优惠。汽车制造商和跨党派议员纷纷呼吁政府出手支持，以保护本土生产和就业。副首相兼财政部长李明 il表示，政府将在本月公布加强电动汽车行业竞争力的措施；此前，他于周一与现代汽车集团执行董事长郑义善举行了会谈。电动汽车是否应纳入国内生产税收抵免，预计将成为议会围绕政府税收改革方案辩论的重点。据韩国汽车与移动出行协会和韩国汽车进口商及经销商协会的数据，1月至9月，中国制造的乘用电动汽车占韩国新车注册量的43.5%，同比提高8.4个百分点。注册量同比翻了一番以上，达到约112,400辆，而上年同期为51,500辆。与此同时，国内生产的乘用电动汽车占比下降6.2个百分点，降至48.7%，首次跌破50%这一关口。随着比亚迪去年进入韩国市场、极氪今年启动本地销售，中国汽车制造商正加大进军韩国市场的力度。周二，小鹏汽车还任命了新设韩国公司的首任负责人，前沃尔沃汽车韩国公司高管李万锡将于12月1日就任。据报道，奇瑞汽车和长城汽车也在准备于明年进入韩国市场。竞争压力加剧，要求将国内生产税收抵免政策延伸至电动汽车的呼声不断高涨。该计划是总统李在明竞选期间作出的关键承诺，将根据生产量，为在韩国国内制造和销售指定战略产品的企业提供税收抵免。8月公布的政府税收改革提案未将电动汽车纳入其中。在上月举行的议会审计会上，执政的韩国民主党和主要反对党国民力量党议员均敦促政府将税收抵免延伸至国内生产的电动汽车。国民力量党议员裴峻永在审计会上表示：“当我们的半导体行业陷入困境时，政府出手予以支持。我认为，对那些难以与其他国家竞争、需要类似提振的产业，政府也应提供支持，包括电动汽车税收抵免。”韩国民主党议员文镇硕也批评政府税收改革提案将电动汽车排除在外，称这似乎是在国内汽车制造商与具有价格优势的中国制造商竞争时，将它们逼到了‘悬崖边’。国民议会共提出了24项法案，建议将电动汽车及其他未来出行交通工具纳入税收抵免计划。政府8月公布税收改革方案后，又提交了7项相关法案。预计本月，国民议会税务小组委员会将审议这一问题，并可能于12月进行全体表决。周一，李明il与电动汽车、自动驾驶和零部件行业的高管会面，释放出政府将参与相关事务的信号，但没有承诺延长税收抵免政策。他说：“关于通过电动汽车生产税收抵免提供支持，政府将积极参与议会讨论，并就此事展开深入探讨。”他还表示，政府计划于本月公布一揽子加强电动汽车行业竞争力的措施，其中包括吸收行业意见，以及支持自动驾驶技术和关键零部件的研发

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 美国3日是中期选举日，确实是我一生中最关键的 midterm选举，美国选民将对唐纳德·特朗普总统和“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动作出评判。唉，我的编辑可没帮我什么忙，竟把我的月刊专栏发布日期定在韩国时间11月4日。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Nov. 3 in the United States is midterm election day, indeed the most critical midterm election of my lifetime, as U.S. voters will pass judgment on President Donald Trump and the MAGA movement. Alas, my editor did me no favors by setting me a Nov. 4 (Korea time) publication date for my monthly column. That is, here in Seoul, my deadline is during the election, which means I don’t have any results to analyze, yet it is too late for me to pontificate ahead of time on the election’s possible outcomes. Because they are predictable, event anniversaries and events scheduled in advance (like elections) are a columnist’s best friend (if you don’t believe me, look at my column history, in which I would estimate that nearly half concerns anniversaries (9/11, martial law, etc.) or dated events (summits, Olympics, elections). Deprived of my best friend this election season, I’ll have to make do with some prognostication and miscellaneous observations about U.S. politics. To start with predictions — which will make me publicly accountable! — the Democrats will get about 52 percent of the national vote and win between 230 and 235 seats in the House of Representatives. This will give Democratic leadership a comfortable margin for going after the Trump administration for its galactic-scale malfeasance and desecration of the U.S. Constitution. The Senate will be tighter: the Democrats will win a slim majority of 52 seats, in the process flipping North Carolina, Maine, Ohio, Texas and one of Alaska, Kansas or Iowa. The Republican Party will contest the election results, but only half-heartedly due to the obvious nature of the anti-MAGA directional shift in U.S. politics. The big question moving forward will be how Democrats use their congressional powers— notably budgetary, investigative hearings, impeachment — to rein in Trump’s imperial presidency and the grift and graft of MAGA. With a Democratic House of Representatives and/or Senate, Trump’s budgetary prospects will dim, and it will be interesting to see how the Democrats use their fiscal authority to limit funding of Homeland Security, Trump’s Washington vanity construction projects, and the Pentagon in general and the Iran War specifically. As for oversight and investigations, there are so many goons and crackpots deserving of congressional hearings and impeachment that the biggest challenge for Democrats will be choosing their targets and finding enough time in the day to go after them all. Beyond Trump himself, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is high on the list for impeachment, along with Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and Attorney General Todd Blanche. Office of Management and Budget Director Russell Vought is also a solid candidate, since he has repurposed his position to focus on refusing to spend congressionally mandated outlays, thus undercutting the congressional “power of the purse.” Elon Musk may also come under the hammer. This list is just the tip of the iceberg. That said, Democratic leadership may well (mis)calculate that more limited political warfare — focusing only on selected officials — will make them appear less polarizing and thus prepare them better for the 2028 election. And of course even if all the Cabinet officials named above are impeached, none of them will be convicted in the Senate, which requires a supermajority. Nor will they likely face justice for corruption and other crimes — notably abuse of power — they may have committed, since Trump will likely issue mass pardons for his henchmen. I’ve long hated the presidential pardon power, which is a toxic holdover from the era of absolute monarchy. Trump has made it much worse, obviously, basically using it as a vehicle for corruption and abuse of power, but investing any head of state or government — especially in democracies — with the sole power to pardon is a travesty that should be abolished in favor of independent, neutral pardon commissions. Yet another impact of the election will be the coming battle for the future of the two parties. If Republicans are crushed and MAGA is electorally discredited, it is an open question as to what will emerge in its place, as Trump has destroyed the ostensible traditional sources of Republican spirit (liberal economics and trade, honest government, Christian values, etc.). Democrats will have their own ideological confrontation between a traditional mainstream wing and a progressive movement in ascendence. Traditional mainstream Democrats are fearful of playing hardball, breaking congressional decorum and norms, and generally doing anything politically interesting or effective; younger, progressive Democrats see an opportunity in the post-MAGA political wasteland to seize on initiatives (affordability measures, health care, immigration, Israel policy) and a political aesthetic (aggressive, brash) that they believe can found new norms favoring them. Traditional mainstream Democrats should not be underestimated — they have held power in the party for a reason — but the time of progressives may have arrived in the U.S. Trump will be rebuked on Nov. 3, but his superpower is his shamelessness; it is the key to his sociopathy. He will not go gently into that good night, but rather rage and try to tear the U.S. apart. Mason Richey is a professor of international politics at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and president of the Korea International Studies Association
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 美国“蓝色浪潮”来临前夕的杂谈
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 美国11月3日是中期选举日，这确实是我一生中最关键的一次中期选举，因为美国选民将就唐纳德·特朗普总统和MAGA运动作出评判。遗憾的是，我的编辑没有帮我什么忙，把我每月专栏的发布日期定在韩国时间11月4日。也就是说，我在首尔的截稿时间正值选举期间，这意味着我届时没有任何选举结果可供分析，而要提前对选举可能结果大发议论，此刻又为时已晚。由于结果可以预测，事件周年日和预先安排的活动（如选举）最是专栏作家的好友（如果不信，不妨看看我的专栏往期文章；据我估计，其中近一半都涉及周年纪念日，如“9·11”、戒严等，或特定日期的活动，如峰会、奥运会和选举）。这个选举季失去了我的好友，我只好就美国政治作一些预测和杂论。先说预测——这会让我公开承担问责！——民主党将获得约52%的全国普选票，并在众议院赢得230至235个席位。这将使民主党领导层拥有从容优势，可以追究特朗普政府令人无法想象的不法行为及其对美国宪法的亵渎。参议院的竞争将更加胶着：民主党将以52席赢得微弱多数，同时拿下北卡罗来纳州、缅因州、俄亥俄州、得克萨斯州，以及阿拉斯加州、堪萨斯州或爱荷华州中的一个。共和党将对选举结果提出申诉，但由于美国政治中反MAGA的方向性转变十分明显，这种申诉也只会半心半意。接下来最大的问题是，民主党将如何运用其国会权力——尤其是预算权、调查听证和弹劾——来遏制特朗普的帝王式总统职位，以及MAGA的欺诈和贪腐。有了民主党控制的众议院和／或参议院，特朗普在预算方面的前景将黯淡；民主党将如何运用财政权力，限制对国土安全部、特朗普在华盛顿的自负建设以及五角大楼，尤其是伊朗战争的拨款，将值得观察。在监督和调查方面，有太多恶棍和怪人应当接受国会听证和弹劾，因此民主党面临的最大挑战将是选择目标，并找出足够的时间逐一追究。除了特朗普本人之外，国防部长皮特·赫格塞思也位列弹劾候选名单前列，卫生与公众服务部长罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 Jr.和司法部长托德·布兰奇同样在列。管理和预算办公室主任拉塞尔·沃特也是一名稳妥人选，因为他把自己的职位改作专注于拒绝执行国会批准的支出，从而削弱国会“钱袋子权”。埃隆·马斯克也可能受到严惩。这份名单还只是冰山一角。话虽如此，民主党领导层很可能会误判形势，认为只针对少数官员展开有限的政治战，更能让自己显得不那么两极化，从而为2028年选举作更充分准备。当然，即便上述所有内阁官员都遭到弹劾，他们也不会有一人在参议院被定罪，因为参议院定罪需要超级多数。他们也很可能不会因自己可能犯下的腐败和其他罪行——尤其是滥用权力——而受到制裁，因为特朗普很可能会对其爪牙实施大规模赦免。我长期以来一直痛恨总统赦免权，它是绝对君主制时代遗留下来的有毒产物。显然，特朗普把这种权力变得更糟，基本上把它当作腐败和滥用权力的工具；然而，把赦免这一权力仅仅交给任何国家元首或政府首脑——尤其是民主国家——本身就是一种荒谬，应由独立、中立的赦免委员会取代。此次选举的另一个影响，将是围绕两党未来的战斗。如果共和党惨败，MAGA在选举中名誉扫地，那么由什么取代其位置仍是悬而未决的问题，因为特朗普已经摧毁了共和党精神的传统来源（自由经济主义与贸易、诚实政府、基督教价值观等）。民主党内部也将围绕传统主流派与正在崛起的进步运动展开意识形态交锋。传统主流派民主党人担心采取强硬手段、破坏国会礼仪和规范，或做任何在政治上富有趣味或有效性的事情；年轻一代进步派民主党人则看到了后MAGA政治荒原中的机会，主张抓住相关倡议（生活成本措施、医疗保健、移民、以色列政策）以及一种政治风格（咄咄逼人、锋芒毕露），并认为这些可以据以建立有利于他们的新规范。传统主流派民主党人不应被低估——他们掌握党内权力是有原因的——但进步派的时代或许已经在美国到来。特朗普将在11月3日受到斥责，但他的“超能力”是其无耻，而这正是其反社会人格的关键。他不会温顺地走进那个良夜，而会暴怒并试图撕裂美国。梅森·里奇是韩国外国语大学国际政治学教授、韩国国际研究协会会长

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 권숙희 기자 = 장성민 중국 중앙군사위원회 부주석이 3일 안드레이 벨로우소프 러시아 국방장관과 만나 양국이 군사 협력을 강화 의지를 확인했다. 중국 관영 신화통신에 따르면 장 부주석은 이날 베이징 댜오위타이(조어대)에서 벨로우소프 장관과 만나 "시진핑 중국 국가주석과 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령의 전략적 지도 아래 중러 관계가 더욱 적극적인 역할을 수행하고 더욱 빨리 발전하는 새로운 단계에 진입했다"고 말했다. 그는 이어 "중국은 러시아와 함께 양국 정상 간 중요한 합의를 심도 있게 이행하고 전략적 소통을 지속적으로 강화하기를 바란다"며 "각국의 주권과 안보, 발전 이익을 더욱 효과적으로 수호하고 세계와 지역의 평화와 안정을 확고하게 유지해나가기를 바란다"고 밝혔다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）权淑hee记者报道：中共中央军委副主席张成敏3日会见俄罗斯国防部长安德烈·别洛乌索夫，确认两国加强军事合作的意愿。据中国官方的新华社报道，张副主席当天在北京钓鱼台国宾馆会见别洛乌索夫部长，并表示：“在习近平主席和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的战略引领下，中俄关系正进入更加积极发挥作用、加快发展的新阶段。”他接着说：“中方愿同俄方一道，深入落实两国领导人之间的重要共识，持续加强战略沟通，并希望更加有效地维护各国主权、安全和发展利益，坚定不移地维护世界和地区的和平与稳定。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 권숙희 기자 = 장성민 중국 중앙군사위원회 부주석이 3일 안드레이 벨로우소프 러시아 국방장관과 만나 양국이 군사 협력을 강화 의지를 확인했다. 중국 관영 신화통신에 따르면 장 부주석은 이날 베이징 댜오위타이(조어대)에서 벨로우소프 장관과 만나 "시진핑 중국 국가주석과 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령의 전략적 지도 아래 중러 관계가 더욱 적극적인 역할을 수행하고 더욱 빨리 발전하는 새로운 단계에 진입했다"고 말했다. 그는 이어 "중국은 러시아와 함께 양국 정상 간 중요한 합의를 심도 있게 이행하고 전략적 소통을 지속적으로 강화하기를 바란다"며 "각국의 주권과 안보, 발전 이익을 더욱 효과적으로 수호하고 세계와 지역의 평화와 안정을 확고하게 유지해나가기를 바란다"고 밝혔다. 신화통신에 따르면 벨로우소프 장관은 "러시아는 중국과 긴밀한 협력을 지속하고 전략적 협의를 강화하며 상호 지지를 확고히 하기를 바란다"고 말했다. 그는 또 "각 분야의 실질적 협력을 확대해 양국 및 군 관계 발전에서 더 많은 성과를 거두기를 바란다"고 덧붙였다. 이번 회담은 북한의 김성남 조선노동당 국제비서가 평양에서 출발해 베이징에 도착한 것으로 보인다는 교도통신의 보도가 나온 당일 이뤄져 주목된다. 또한 장 부주석이 '중국군 2인자'였던 장유샤 전 중앙군사위원회 부주석의 숙청이 확정된 직후 중국의 대(對)러시아 군사외교 전면에 나선 것으로도 풀이된다. 지난달 29일 폐막한 중국 공산당 중앙위원회 제5차 전체 회의(5중전회)에서는 장유샤 등 군 수뇌부를 포함한 고위직들의 당적 박탈이 공식 추인됐다. 중앙군사위원회의 공석이 채워지지 않는 상황에서 장 부주석은 중국 핵심 권력기구인 중앙정치국 위원으로도 선출돼 그의 정치적 입지가 강화됐다는 평가가 나왔다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/03 20:09 송고 2026년11월03일 20시09분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）权淑姬记者 张成民：中国中央军委副主席于3日会见俄罗斯国防部长安德烈·别洛索夫，确认两国加强军事合作的意向。据中国官媒新华社报道，张副主席当天在北京钓鱼台（国宾馆）会见别洛索夫部长，并表示：“在习近平中国国家主席和弗拉基米尔·普京俄罗斯总统的战略引领下，中俄关系正进入一个新的阶段，将发挥更加积极的作用，迎来更加快速的发展。”他接着说：“希望中国与俄罗斯一道，深入落实两国领导人之间达成的各项重要共识，持续加强战略沟通。”他并表示：“希望更加有效地维护各国主权、安全和发展利益，坚定不移地维护世界和地区的和平与稳定。”据新华社报道，别洛索夫部长表示：“俄罗斯希望继续与中国保持密切合作，加强战略磋商，筑牢相互支持的基础。”他并补充说：“希望扩大各领域的务实合作，在两国关系和军事关系发展方面取得更多成果。”韩国教育通信社报道，朝鲜劳动党国际书记金成男从平壤出发并抵达北京。此次会谈于上述报道发布当天举行，因而受到关注。还有分析认为，在曾任“中国军队第二号人物”的原中央军委副主席张又侠遭查处的决定刚刚确定之际，张副主席全面展开对俄军事外交。上个月29日闭幕的中国共产党中央委员会第五次全体会议（二十届三中全会）正式追认了对张又侠等军方高级将领等党内高级官员的党籍处分。在中央军委出现空缺的情况下，张副主席还当选为中国核心权力机构中央政治局委员，因而有评价认为其政治地位得到加强。稿件通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送，版权归韩联社所有，禁止擅自转载、重新发布以及用于人工智能训练和利用。2026/11/03 20:09发布，2026年11月3日20时09分发布

Unlock these with Subscription One Indian was killed after an attack on a commercial vessel near Limah in Oman, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Tuesday (November 3, 2026). 13 other Indian nationals on board the MSV AL JUSUFI have been rescued after the incident on Monday (November 2, 2026), the Ministry said in a statement. The deceased seafarer was identified as Gandhar Nahim Ajij from Gujarat, according to Union Minister for Ports, Shipping, and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal. Condemning the incident, the MEA called for an immediate de-escalation of tensions and the conclusion of ongoing negotiations for a diplomatic solution in West Asia . The Ministry, in its statement, stated that the Indian Embassy in Oman is “closely monitoring the situation and coordinating with the Omani authorities” for the early repatriation of the rescued Indian nationals and the mortal remains of the deceased. “The targeting of commercial shipping and civilian infrastructure in the region must end, and free and unimpeded navigation and commerce through the international waterways in the region, in keeping with international law, must be restored at the earliest,” it added in a post on X. Earlier in the day, Mr. Sonowal said the vessel was struck by an “unidentified aerial object” and also confirmed that the tanker had 14 Indian seafarers on board when it was attacked. ⚠️ IMPORTANT UPDATE ⚠️ On Nov 2, the Indian MSV AL JUSUFI, carrying 14 Indian seafarers, was struck by an unidentified aerial object while navigating near the coast of Oman. While 13 crew members safely evacuated and were rescued by the Omani Coast Guard, I am deeply saddened to report that one of our seafarers, Gandhar Nahim Ajij from Gujarat, tragically succumbed to his injuries. My heartfelt condolences go out to his family and loved ones during this hour of immense grief. The Ministry and Indian Embassy in Oman are in contact with local authorities to ensure immediate assistance for the 13 survivors and facilitate the swift repatriation of both the surviving crew and mortal remains of our deceased seafarer. “While 13 crew members safely evacuated and were rescued by the Omani Coast Guard, I am deeply saddened to report that one of our seafarers, Gandhar Nahim Ajij from Gujarat, tragically succumbed to his injuries,” he said in a statement on social media. Mr. Sonowal added that his Ministry and Indian Embassy in Oman are in contact with local authorities to ensure immediate assistance for the 13 survivors and facilitate the repatriation of both the surviving crew and mortal remains of the deceased seafarer. India is one of the largest contributors of sailors to merchant shipping worldwide, with more than 3,20,000 active seafarers in 2025, according to the shipping ministry. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body_zh: 订阅可享有多项权益，包括 Premium Stories、Editorials、Opinities 等内容。使用 Subscription 解锁这些内容。印度外交部（MEA）周二（2026年11月3日）表示，一艘商船在阿曼利马附近遭袭后，1名印度人死亡。外交部在声明中说，MSV AL JUSUFI号船上另外13名印度籍国民已于周一（2026年11月2日）这起事件后获救。印度联邦港口、航运和水道部长萨尔班达·索诺瓦尔表示，遇难海员被确认为来自古吉拉特邦的甘达尔·纳希姆·阿吉吉。外交部谴责这起事件，呼吁立即缓和局势，并完成正在进行的谈判，以通过外交途径解决西亚问题。外交部在声明中表示，印度驻阿曼大使馆正“密切监测局势，并与阿曼当局协调”，以便获救印度籍国民尽早返乡，并运回遇难者的遗体。外交部在 X 发布的帖子中补充说：“针对该地区商业航运和民用基础设施的袭击必须停止，必须尽早按照国际法恢复该地区国际水道的自由、无阻碍通航和商业往来。”当天早些时候，索诺瓦尔先生说，该船遭到一个“身份不明的空中物体”袭击，并确认油轮遇袭时船上有14名印度海员。⚠️ 重要更新 ⚠️ 11月2日，载有14名印度海员的印度籍 MSV AL JUSUFI号在阿曼近海航行时遭到身份不明的空中物体袭击。13名船员安全撤离并获阿曼海岸警卫队救援，我深感悲痛地报告，我们的一名海员、来自古吉拉特邦的甘达尔·纳希姆·阿吉吉，不幸因伤势过重去世。在这个悲痛万分之际，我向他的家人和亲友致以衷心的慰问。印度外交部和印度驻阿曼大使馆正与当地当局联系，确保立即协助13名幸存者，并迅速安排尚存船员和遇难海员遗体的遣返。索诺瓦尔先生在一则社交媒体声明中说：“尽管13名船员安全撤离并获阿曼海岸警卫队救援，我深感悲痛地报告，我们的一名海员、来自古吉拉特邦的甘达尔·纳希姆·阿吉吉，不幸因伤势过重去世。”索诺瓦尔先生补充说，其所在部委和印度驻阿曼大使馆正与当地当局联系，确保立即协助13名幸存者，并安排尚存船员和遇难海员遗体的遣返。据航运部数据，印度是向全球商船运输业输送海员最多的国家之一，2025年有超过320,000名在职海员。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性或针对个人的内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章讨论。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录账户后可以在 Vuukle 上查看以前的评论。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: HONG KONG — Investments by some companies from Asian economies in the United States are set to keep climbing amid a global supply-chain shake-up, Citi's international chief said, with spending expected to build in stages. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 香港——花旗国际业务主管表示，在全球供应链重组之际，一些亚洲经济体企业在美国的投资预计将继续攀升，相关支出将分阶段增加。坎图在香港接受路透社采访时说，全球企业正在美国投入大量资金，“流入北美的业务实现两位数增长”。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: HONG KONG — Investments by some companies from Asian economies in the United States are set to keep climbing amid a global supply-chain shake-up, Citi's international chief said, with spending expected to build in stages. "These companies have a lot of capacity to invest. I think that investments from the South Koreans, Taiwanese, and Japanese firms is likely to continue," said Ernesto Torres Cantu, who heads Citi's global business outside of North America, across more than 180 countries and jurisdictions. There is a lot of investment from global companies into the United States, with "double-digit growth in the inbound business into North America", Cantu told Reuters in Hong Kong. Citi and JPMorgan are financing Japanese projects tied to Tokyo's $550 billion U.S. investment pledge, while the White House recently unveiled the initial tranche of Seoul's $350 billion strategic package. Investments in U.S.-bound projects tend to compound over time, Cantu said, comparing a company's capital expenditure to a multi-stage manufacturing ramp-up, from buying land to building a factory and running daily operations. Large multinationals are showing resiliency amid geopolitical shocks, and are "adjusting exceptionally fast", Cantu said. While tariffs remain a factor, he said the Gulf War may be having a bigger impact, which is forcing many companies to rework their trade flows and supply chains. That requires the bank to keep executing payments, trade finance and transaction settlements for clients across changing market environments, he noted. While Citi's overall revenue rose by 8% in the third quarter of this year, its services business, which provides cash management, payments, trade finance as well as liquidity to corporations, financial institutions, and governments outperformed with a 15% increase in revenue. Cantu also expects flows through other cross-border corridors involving Asia to keep rising, with China and India at the centre of two of the most active ones. Trade between Britain and India is "growing significantly" after the tariff cuts, he said. Cantu expects the European Union's free trade agreement with India, which takes effect in 2027, to bring "a lot of business opportunities" too. "We see business expansion from China to the rest of the world continuing to grow," he said, adding that flows from China to the rest of the world have expanded "significantly," by more than 20% a year for the past two years. In China, Citi, which recently won approval to set up a wholly owned securities unit, plans to draw on its large corporate banking client base as it seeks more of the onshore securities business serving both local and international companies, according to Cantu
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 花旗：日本、韩国和台湾企业在美投资将继续增长
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 香港——花旗国际业务主管埃内斯托·托雷斯·坎图表示，在全球供应链重组之际，一些亚洲经济体的企业对美国的投资预计将持续攀升，相关支出将分阶段增加。负责花旗北美以外全球业务（覆盖180多个国家和司法管辖区）的坎图说：“这些企业拥有雄厚的投资能力。我认为，韩国、台湾和日本企业的投资很可能继续增长。”坎图在香港告诉路透社，全球企业在美国有大量投资，“流入北美的业务实现两位数增长”。花旗和摩根大通正在为日本项目提供融资，这些项目与东京承诺的5500亿美元对美投资计划有关；白宫最近公布了首尔3500亿美元战略投资方案的首批项目。坎图说，对美国市场的项目投资往往会随着时间推移产生复合效应。他把企业的资本支出比作多阶段制造业扩产：从购置土地、兴建工厂，到开展日常运营。坎图说，大型跨国公司在地缘政治冲击面前表现出韧性，并且“调整速度极快”。他表示，尽管关税仍是一个影响因素，但海湾战争可能带来的冲击更大，正迫使许多企业重新设计贸易流向和供应链。他指出，这要求银行在不断变化的市场环境中，继续为客户执行支付、贸易融资和交易结算。尽管花旗今年第三季度整体营收增长8%，但其服务业务表现更佳，营收增长15%；该业务为企业、金融机构和政府提供现金管理、支付、贸易融资及流动性服务。坎图还预计，其他涉及亚洲的跨境走廊资金流也将继续增加，其中中国和印度位于两条最活跃走廊的中心。他说，关税削减后，英国与印度之间的贸易“显著增长”。坎图预计，欧盟与印度将于2027年生效的自由贸易协定也将带来“大量商业机会”。他说：“我们看到中国向世界其他地区的业务扩张持续增长。”他补充称，中国向世界其他地区的资金流过去两年“显著增长”，增幅超过每年20%。据坎图介绍，花旗最近获准在中国设立全资证券业务部门，计划利用其庞大的企业银行客户基础，进一步发展面向本地和国际企业的在岸证券业务。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Unification Minister Chung Dong-young on Tuesday called for inter-Korea cooperation to control animal diseases that wild animals could carry across the border. "There is a need for phased cooperation in animal quarantines to control diseases, such as African Swine Fever (ASF), foot-and-mouth disease and bird flu," Chung told a Cabinet meeting chaired by President Lee Jae Myung earlier in the day. "We are preparing for it," Chung added. "It is one of the reasons why inter-Korean ties should improve." His remarks came during a discussion on improving animal quarantines and the risk of undomesticated animals, such as wild boars, crossing the border from the North and spreading diseases in the South. Chung cited North Korea's first ASF outbreak at a farm in Jagang Province in May 2019. According to South Korea's agriculture ministry, 77 pigs died and 22 were culled

https://www.lesahel.org/declaration-de-s.body: À l’occasion de la célébration du centenaire de la Ville de Niamey, l’ONG SANTED a rendu publique, le samedi 31 octobre 2026 à Niamey, une déclaration de soutien au Conseil National pour la Sauvegarde de la Patrie (CNSP). Cette déclaration est suivie de la remise de trophées aux meilleurs acteurs de la refondation. C’est le président de l’ONG SANTED, M. Ayouba Mahamadou, qui a procédé à la lecture de la déclaration. Dans cette déclaration, M. Ayouba Mahamadou a rappelé qu’à travers cette initiative, l’ONG SANTED entend contribuer à la valorisation du système éducatif nigérien, à l’encouragement du mérite scolaire et la formation d’une jeunesse responsable, instruite, tient à exprimé son soutien au Conseil national pour la sauvegarde de la patrie (CNSP) et à la dynamique de refondation engagée au Niger, ainsi qu’à l’alliance de l’AES. « Notre organisation souligne l’importance de la paix, de la cohésion sociale, de la solidarité nationale, de la responsabilité citoyenne et de la participation de toutes les composantes de la société au développement du pays », a-t-il ajouté. Par ailleurs, l’ONG SANTED réaffirme, au Président de la République, Chef de l’Etat, le Général d’Armée Abdourahamane Tiani. Enfin, elle appelle l’ensemble des Nigériens à préserver l’unité nationale, la cohésion sociale, le dialogue et la vigilance citoyenne afin de contribuer à la stabilité et à la paix dans Niger. En marge de cette cérémonie, le président de l’ONG SANTED, M. Ayouba Mahamadou, a décerné des trophées aux meilleurs promoteurs de la refondation. Les récipiendaires sont, entre autres, le ministre de la Santé et de l’Hygiène Publique, Médecin Colonel-major Garba Hakimi, le ministre de l’Urbanisme et de l’Habitat, Colonel-major, Abdoul-Kadri Amadou Daouada, le ministre de la Refondation et de la Promotion des Valeurs Sociales du Niger, M. Abdourahamane Oumarou, L’administrateur délégué de la ville de Niamey, Colonel Boubacar Soumana Garanké, le président de l’Observatoire National de la Communication (ONC) au Niger, M. Ibrahim Manzo Diallo, le directeur général de la Nigérienne des Eaux (NDE), l’Officier de la Police Aboubacar Abdou et le directeur de CAIMA, Dr Issifou Baoua. Pour les meilleures écoles professionnelles, il s’agit de l’IAT, l’IPSP, l’ESPA/MT, Lycée d’Excellence, l’ESSCOM, l’ISP, le CLAB, Issa Beri, le GEGA, l’ESM, l’EDC, l’EPI, l’ESIE, l’ESCEP, l’ENSP, le Collège Mariama, le Prytanée Militaire, l’IPHEC et le Lycée Koira
https://www.lesahel.org/declaration-de-s.title_zh: 支持声明：SANTED非政府组织再次重申拥护CNSP理念
https://www.lesahel.org/declaration-de-s.body_zh: 值此尼亚美市建市100周年庆典之际，非政府组织SANTED于2026年10月31日星期六在尼亚美发表声明，支持保卫祖国全国委员会（CNSP）。声明发布后，活动向推动国家重建工作的优秀人士授予奖杯。非政府组织SANTED主席阿尤巴·马哈马杜宣读了声明。他在声明中表示，SANTED希望通过这一行动，为提升尼日利亚教育制度、鼓励学业 Merit以及培养负责任且受过教育的青年作出贡献，并重申对保卫祖国全国委员会（CNSP）、尼日利亚开展的重建进程以及萨赫勒国家联盟的支持。他补充说：“本组织强调和平、社会凝聚力、民族团结、公民责任以及社会各组成部分参与国家发展的重要性。”此外，非政府组织SANTED再次向共和国总统、国家元首陆军上将阿卜杜拉赫曼·蒂亚尼表示支持。最后，它呼吁全体尼日利亚人维护民族团结、社会凝聚、对话和公民警觉，为尼日利亚的稳定与和平作出贡献。此次典礼期间，非政府组织SANTED主席阿尤巴·马哈马杜向优秀的重建工作推动者授予了奖杯。受奖者包括：卫生与公共卫生部长兼少校医生加尔巴·哈基米；城市规划和住房部长、上校阿卜杜勒-卡德里·阿马杜·达瓦达；尼日利亚重建与 promoting 社会价值观部长阿卜杜拉赫曼·奥马鲁；尼亚美市特别行政官、上校布巴卡尔·苏马纳·加朗凯；尼日利亚国家通讯观察站（ONC）主席易卜拉欣·曼佐·迪亚洛；尼日利亚水务公司（NDE）总经理阿布巴卡尔·阿卜杜；CAIMA主任易西福·巴瓦；以及在职业技术学校中表现优秀的IAT、IPSP、ESPA/MT、Lycée d’Excellence、ESSCOM、ISP、CLAB、Issa Beri、GEGA、ESM、EDC、EPI、ESIE、ESCEP、ENSP、Collège Mariama、Prytanée Militaire、IPHEC和Lycée Koira。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Nine Korean picture books have been selected for the 2026 Korea Picture Book Award, with the government pledging export support to help winning authors reach readers worldwide. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism said Tuesday that nine works were chosen from 506 entries for the fourth annual awards, established in 2023 to promote the development of Korean picture books and expand their presence in overseas markets. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 2 p.m. Tuesday at Ferrum Tower in central Seoul. The two grand prizes went to Jeon Mi-hwa's "To the Fish in the Sea, to the Birds in the Sky, to the Animals in the Forest, and to Humans" in fiction and Kim Ji-won's "Raising Earthworms" in nonfiction. Each grand prize winner will receive 15 million won ($10,350) and the Culture Minister's Award. Baek's work and the book by Kim Bok-hee and Lee Myung-ae will each receive 10 million won, while the other four will each receive 7 million won. Yeo Seo-yoon received the newcomer award for "I Have a Song I Want to Sing for You," along with a 7 million won prize. The nine publishers behind the winning books will also receive 3 million won each. The ministry said winners will receive sample translations, promotional support, reviews and opportunities to showcase their books at major international events, including the Bologna Children's Book Fair. "Picture books are publishing content that combines writing, illustrations and design to deliver emotion and imagination to a wide range of readers, from children to adults," said Choi Seong-hee, the ministry's director general for content industry policy. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 插电式混合动力SUV兼顾舒适性与效率，并采取激进定价。体验BYD韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，首先映入眼帘的是其座舱非凡的静谧性。在“海狮6 DM-i”这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”，即BYD自主研发的插电式混合动力电动汽车（PHEV）技术，为该车提供长续航能力。海狮6 DM-i并非为提供高性能电动汽车（EV）般的爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Plug-in hybrid SUV combines comfort and efficiency with aggressive pricing Starting BYD Korea's Sealion 6 DM-i plug-in hybrid SUV, the first thing that stood out was the exceptional quietness of its cabin. Driving through city streets and along highways, the SUV felt more like a mid-size luxury sedan than a family-oriented SUV. In the name Sealion 6 DM-i, DM-i stands for “Dual Mode-intelligent,” BYD’s proprietary plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) technology, which powers the vehicle's long-range drive. Its cabin remained remarkably quiet at low speeds, when the electric motor does most of the work. Minor vibrations were barely noticeable, while the suspension softened the impact of speed bumps and uneven pavement. The result was a relaxed, composed ride that made long-distance driving less tiring. On a roughly 100-kilometer round trip between Seoul and Paju, Gyeonggi Province, the SUV proved remarkably easy on the driver, with minimal fatigue and impressive fuel efficiency that exceeded expectations. The Sealion 6 DM-i is not built to deliver the explosive acceleration or sharp handling of a performance electric vehicle (EV). Its appeal lies elsewhere: comfortable cruising, low running costs and the freedom to travel long distances without constantly searching for a charging station. BYD Korea claims a combined driving range approaching 1,000 kilometers, making efficiency one of the SUV's strongest selling points. Its 18.3-kilowatt-hour battery provides up to 70 kilometers of all-electric driving, enough to cover many daily commutes without using gasoline. When the battery charge falls below 25 percent, the gasoline engine can generate electricity to sustain operation. That flexibility addresses one of the biggest inconveniences of owning a pure EV. Drivers can charge at home and use electric power for shorter trips, while relying on the hybrid system for longer journeys. The powertrain pairs a 1.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine, producing 130 horsepower and 220 newton-meters of torque, with an electric motor. The SUV accelerates from zero to 100 kilometers per hour in 8.3 seconds — a figure seen as fairly unremarkable — but this is still enough for customers who prioritize smooth, predictable progress over outright speed. Pricing, however, may prove its most disruptive feature. Starting at 37.5 million won ($27,000), the Sealion 6 DM-i undercuts many plug-in hybrid rivals, which typically occupy price brackets above 60 million won. BYD's vertically integrated manufacturing, spanning batteries to finished vehicles, helps explain its ability to offer the SUV at such an aggressive price. Seven airbags and driver-assistance features, including adaptive cruise control, lane-departure prevention and rear cross-traffic alerts, come standard. For buyers seeking the refinement of a quiet sedan, the flexibility of a hybrid and the range for extended road trips, the Sealion 6 DM-i makes a compelling case — particularly at a price that puts plug-in hybrid ownership within reach of a much wider market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 【试驾】比亚迪海狮6 DM-i在静谧性和续航方面表现出色
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 比亚迪韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV以激进定价兼顾舒适性与效率。试驾BYD Korea的Sealion 6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，最先给人留下深刻印象的是其座舱出色的静谧性。行驶在城市街道和高速公路上，这款SUV给人的感觉更像是中型豪华轿车，而非家庭取向的SUV。在Sealion 6 DM-i这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”（Dual Mode-intelligent），这是比亚迪自主研发的插电式混合动力电动车（PHEV）技术，为车辆的长续航行驶提供动力。低速行驶时，大部分工作由电动机完成，车内始终保持非凡安静。轻微振动几乎难以察觉，悬架也缓和了减速带和不平整路面带来的冲击。由此带来的乘坐体验从容沉稳，让长途驾驶不易疲劳。在京畿道首尔与坡州市之间约100公里的往返行程中，这款SUV让驾驶者感到格外轻松，疲劳程度极低，燃油经济性也超出预期。Sealion 6 DM-i并非为追求性能电动车（EV）那种爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。它的吸引力另有其处：舒适的巡航体验、低使用成本，以及无需不断寻找充电站便可长途旅行的自由。BYD Korea声称，该车综合续航里程接近1,000公里，使效率成为这款SUV最突出的卖点之一。其18.3千瓦时电池可支持最长70公里的纯电行驶，足以应对许多日常通勤，全程无需使用汽油。当电池电量降至25 percent以下时，汽油发动机可持续发电以维持车辆运行。这种灵活性解决了拥有纯电动车所面临的最大不便之一。驾驶者可以居家充电，短途出行使用电力，而长途旅行则依靠混合动力系统。这套动力系统将最大输出130马力、220牛·米扭矩的1.5升涡轮增压汽油发动机与电动机结合。该SUV从零加速至每小时100公里需8.3秒——这一成绩只能算中规中矩——但对于更看重平顺、可预期加速表现而非极致速度的消费者而言，仍然足够。不过，定价可能成为其最具颠覆性的特点。Sealion 6 DM-i起售价为3,750万韩元（$27,000），低于许多插电式混合动力竞品，后者的售价通常处于6,000万韩元以上的区间。比亚迪从电池到整车的垂直一体化生产模式，有助于解释该SUV为何能够以如此激进的价格推出。7个安全气囊以及一系列驾驶辅助功能均为标配，包括自适应巡航控制、车道偏离防系统和车后方交叉交通警报。对于希望拥有安静轿车般的精致感、混合动力车的灵活性以及长途自驾续航能力的消费者而言，Sealion 6 DM-i具有很强的说服力，尤其是其价格让插电式混合动力汽车进入了更广泛的市场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's consumer prices rose 2.8 percent in October from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, as agricultural product prices continued to decline despite energy costs remaining elevated. According to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics, consumer price growth eased to 2.8 percent in October from 2.9 percent in September and 3.1 percent in August. The data ministry said petroleum products' prices advanced 14.9 percent year-on-year in October, contributing 0.56 percentage point to the month's year-on-year inflation rate. It was the sharpest growth since 15.5 percent posted in July. In detail, diesel prices jumped 19.7 percent year-on-year in October, while gasoline prices increased a sharp 11.6 percent. The report showed that prices of industrial products overall rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in October due to higher global energy prices, with those of mobile phones and computers climbing 10.8 percent and 26.2 percent, respectively. Prices of imported automobiles, on the other hand, fell 3.9 percent over the same period. In addition, prices of agricultural, livestock and fishery products fell 1.7 percent over the same period, the findings showed, lowering the overall inflation rate by 0.14 percentage point. It marked the third consecutive month of an year-on-year decline. Prices of apples, napa cabbages and cucumbers fell 13.4 percent, 44.3 percent and 39.5 percent, respectively. Those of domestically produced beef, however, rose 9.1 percent. The service sector's prices moved up 2.7 percent, led by higher insurance premiums and overseas package tour prices, which increased 13.4 percent and 11.5 percent, respectively. Dining-out prices climbed 2.9 percent year-on-year in October, marking the highest increase since February, when they also increased 2.9 percent, and contributing 0.42 percentage point to the overall inflation rate. Prices of electricity, gas and water went up 0.4 percent over the same period. Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, stood at 2.8 percent year-on-year in October
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 10月消费者价格上涨2.8%，连续第二个月维持在2%区间
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国消费者价格10月同比上涨2.8%，数据周二显示，尽管能源成本仍处高位，但农产品价格继续下降。韩国数据统计部数据显示，消费者价格涨幅从9月的2.9%和8月的3.1%放缓至10月的2.8%。数据部表示，10月石油产品价格同比上涨14.9%，对当月同比通胀率贡献0.56个百分点。这是7月录得15.5%以来的最大涨幅。分项来看，10月柴油价格同比飙升19.7%，汽油价格也大幅上涨11.6%。报告显示，受全球能源价格上涨影响，10月工业品价格整体同比上涨4.4%，其中手机和计算机价格分别上涨10.8%和26.2%。另一方面，进口汽车价格同期下降3.9%。此外，结果显示，农产品、畜产品和渔业产品价格同期下降1.7%，使总体通胀率降低0.14个百分点。这标志着同比价格连续第三个月下降。苹果、大白菜和黄瓜价格分别下跌13.4%、44.3%和39.5%。不过，韩国国产牛肉价格上涨9.1%。服务部门价格上涨2.7%，主要受保险费和海外套餐旅游价格上涨推动，两者分别上涨13.4%和11.5%。10月外出就餐价格同比上涨2.9%，创下2月以来的最大涨幅，当时涨幅同样为2.9%，并对总体通胀率贡献0.42个百分点。电力、燃气和水价同期上涨0.4%。剔除波动较大的食品和能源价格的核心通胀率10月同比维持在2.8%

Unlock these with Subscription Days after Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu visited Pakistan for a bilateral visit that yielded many agreements, the former Foreign Minister of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, accused him of moving in an “anti- India ” direction. Also read | Defence pacts with India being amended, says Maldives Mr. Shahid, who is running for the leadership of the opposition Maldivian Democratic Party (MDP) ahead of the Presidential elections in 2028, alleged that Mr. Muizzu, who has had a cordial relationship with New Delhi for most of his tenure, would revive the “India Out” campaign of 2023. “The President [Mr. Muizzu] is trying to make India the issue again, because for him, he hasn’t been able to perform. He hasn’t been able to provide any development or deliver on any of the promises, and therefore, come next election again, he will try to create some narrative on hate,” Mr. Shahid, who was Foreign Minister during the tenure of the previous President Ibrahim Solih (2018-2023) and won a term as the President of the UN General Assembly with India’s support in 2021, told The Hindu in an interview here. The Maldives government spokesperson did not reply to a request for a response to Mr. Shahid’s comments. Mr. Shahid called for more transparency about 20 MoUs signed between the Maldives and Pakistan when President Muizzu went on a three-day visit to Islamabad from October 20 to 22, the first such visit by a Maldives President since 2015. After talks between Mr. Muizzu and Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, the two sides announced agreements in a number of areas, including defence and maritime security, combating illicit trafficking and narcotics, information technology, cybersecurity and AI. They agreed to start direct flights between Male and Islamabad. In particular, Mr. Muizzu’s meeting with Pakistan’s Field Marshal and Army chief General Asim Munir had raised eyebrows in Delhi. Mr. Muizzu also called for the revival of SAARC, on hold since 2016 when India pulled out of the summit in Islamabad over cross-border terrorism. “We do not want Maldives to be drawn into disputes within our neighbours,” said Mr. Shahid, demanding that the Muizzu government make a statement in Parliament about the nature of the agreements signed with Pakistan. “We must aim for expanding our relationship with everyone who has goodwill to the Maldives, but it should not come at the cost of our own friends, our established relationships,” he added. When asked about Mr. Muizzu’s Pakistan visit on Friday, Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that the government kept a “close watch” on such developments and would “take whatever appropriate steps may be necessary”. In response to the comments on SAARC, Mr. Jaiswal said that it was “one country”, indicating Pakistan, that had “stalled” the functioning of SAARC, and India was keen to strengthen regional cooperation. Mr. Shahid’s comments to The Hindu indicate that ties with India may once again become an issue in the Maldivian elections. Mr. Solih lost the elections in 2023 due to the “India Out” campaign of the People’s National Congress (PNC), led by Mr. Muizzu, against what he alleged was undue Indian influence in the island chain, especially accusing the Solih government of allowing India to build military bases in infrastructure projects that India had constructed. Mr. Muizzu had also demanded that Indian Air Force personnel stationed at three locations in the Maldives, including Gan Island and Hanimadhoo Atoll, who operated aircraft that India had provided to the Maldives, be removed. While the beginning of Mr. Muizzu’s tenure saw tensions with the Modi government, and he chose to travel to Turkiye, the UAE, and China before visiting India, relations improved after India agreed to withdraw military personnel and replace them with civilian personnel instead. In June 2024, a month after the final batch of 89 Indian personnel had been withdrawn, Mr. Muizzu visited India to attend Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s swearing-in ceremony, and then returned in October 2024 for a bilateral visit, when India offered the Maldives several economic support measures, including a currency swap agreement to help Maldives avoid a debt failure. Mr. Shahid, who is standing for the primary elections in the MDP next year, is expected to face some tough competition from his other former colleagues in the cabinet as well, including former Economic Minister Fayyaz Ismail, who has the backing of the current MDP chief and former Maldivian President Mohamed Nasheed. Mr. Shahid and Mr. Solih were rivals of Mr. Nasheed during the previous government, but the opposition has come together within the MDP in order to fight against the ruling PNC. The run-up to the 2028 elections has heated up after the PNC confirmed Mr. Muizzu for the 2028 ticket, and the MDP held its party congress, endorsing the “Big Change” ticket for constitutional reform proposed by Mr. Ismail. Mr. Shahid is in India to attend the Words Beyond Borders International Literature Festival and is expected to affirm a campaign more friendly to India. When asked whether he would back an “India-first” campaign like Mr. Solih did, Mr. Shahid said his outreach would always be “first to India” on foreign policy, but not on domestic issues, which were sovereign. “India has always been our first responder. India has always been a generous partner in development. India is our immediate neighbour, who has been consistent in its relationship with the Maldives. So, our history proves the relationship right,” he said, referring to close ties between India and the Maldives since 1965, when the Maldives won its independence from British rule. 支持伊斯梅尔提出的宪法改革方案及“大变革”竞选主张。沙希德先生目前身在印度，参加Words Beyond https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body: In Sokoto, the state government ordered the indefinite closure of the ADC campaign office less than 48 hours before the party’s presidential campaign flag-off scheduled for November 4. The Commissioner for Lands and Housing, Barrister Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho, announced the sealing during an official visit to the premises on Monday, November 2, 2026, according to an update posted by Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu. The development is the latest in a face-off between the ADC and the Sokoto State Government that has dominated the state’s political space over the past week. The dispute began when the ADC notified the state government of its decision to hold its presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto, the seat of the Caliphate. The event was initially scheduled for October 31. In its response, the state government expressed disagreement with the proposed event, a position the ADC described as troubling and a threat to political pluralism. The party subsequently rescheduled the flag-off to Wednesday, November 4. At a press conference at the party’s headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, November 1, the Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign and state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, alleged a pattern of attacks and intimidation against the party and its supporters. Goronyo said ADC women supporters were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march on Wednesday, October 28, with their phones allegedly snatched, clothes torn and vehicles vandalised. He also alleged that the party’s state campaign office was attacked the same day, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed. He added that the party’s billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. According to him, the ADC governorship candidate was attacked on Friday, October 30, while gunshots were fired at the airport as party leaders arrived. Goronyo further alleged that hotels which had confirmed reservations for ADC delegates cancelled their bookings under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. He linked the alleged attacks to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. He identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected with the incidents. The ADC chairman also alleged that personnel of the Sokoto Community Guard Corps and Sokoto Marshals had been directed to prevent the party’s supporters from entering the state ahead of the flag-off. The closure of the campaign office marked another escalation in the dispute. The facility, a green-and-orange building in Sokoto metropolis, houses the party’s state campaign council. As of press time, the state government had not issued an official explanation for the sealing. However, sources in the Ministry of Lands said it might be connected to alleged violations involving land title and building permits. Despite the closure, the ADC has vowed to proceed with its November 4 presidential campaign flag-off. “No threat, intimidation or unlawful obstruction will deprive us of our constitutional right to organise political activities,” Goronyo said. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the Federal Government to investigate the alleged attacks and provide protection for the party’s candidates and supporters. In neighbouring Zamfara State, pandemonium broke out on Monday during the APC primary for the Zamfara North Senatorial District in Kaura Namoda, as the local government chairman, Hon. Mannir Haidara, narrowly escaped an attack by angry youths. LEADERSHIP gathered that the incident occurred at the primary election venue while Haidara was addressing delegates and urging them to vote for the incumbent senator representing the district, Senator Sahabi Ya’u Kaura. The youths, reportedly supporters of his challenger, Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura, rejected the appeal and insisted on backing their preferred candidate. Eyewitnesses said the situation degenerated as the youths shouted at the council chairman and attempted to attack him over alleged bias and imposition. https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body_zh: 在索科托，州政府下令无限期关闭人民民主大会党（ADC）竞选办公室，而距离该党原定于11月4日举行的总统竞选启动仪式已不足48小时。据Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu发布的消息，土地与住房事务专员Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho律师于2026年11月2日星期一正式视察该处场所期间宣布查封办公室。这是过去一周主导该州政治局势的ADC与索科托州政府对峙事件中的最新进展。争端始于ADC通知州政府，其决定在哈里发国教发源地索科托举行总统竞选启动仪式。该活动最初定于10月31日举行。州政府回应称不同意举办这项活动，ADC则称这一立场令人不安，并威胁政治多元。随后，该党将启动仪式改至11月4日星期三。11月1日星期日，在位于索科托的党总部举行的新闻发布会上，ADC州长竞选主任兼州主席Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo指控该党及其支持者持续遭到袭击和恐吓。Goronyo称，10月28日星期三，ADC女性支持者在一场和平声援游行中遭到袭击，据称她们的手机被抢、衣服被撕毁，车辆也遭到破坏。他还称，同一天，该党州竞选办公室遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被抢，3辆摩托车被毁。他补充说，该党在各地的广告牌、海报和其他竞选 materials均被毁。据他介绍，10月30日星期五，ADC州长候选人遭到袭击；该党领导人抵达机场时，现场还响起了枪声。Goronyo进一步指控，已确认接待ADC代表入住的酒店在州政府施压下取消了预订，而政府所属酒店则声称已客满。他将这些所谓的袭击与据称由州政府释放的两名政治打手有关，并指出其中一人为Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些事件有关。ADC主席还称，索科托社区卫队和索科托法警人员已奉命阻止该党支持者在启动仪式前进入该州。竞选办公室关闭标志着争端进一步升级。该设施是一栋位于索科托市区、涂有绿色和橙色的大楼，内设该党州竞选委员会。截至发稿时，州政府尚未就查封一事发布正式解释。不过，土地部消息人士称，此事可能与土地所有权和建筑许可方面的违规行为有关。尽管办公室已被关闭，ADC仍誓言继续举行11月4日的总统竞选启动仪式。Goronyo说：“任何威胁、恐吓或非法阻碍，都不能剥夺我们组织政治活动的宪法权利。”他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和联邦政府调查这些所谓的袭击，并为该党候选人和支持者提供保护。在邻近的赞法拉州，星期一在考拉纳莫达举行的全非人民大会党（APC）赞法拉北区参议员初选中发生混乱。当时，地方政府主席Hon. Mannir Haidara在向代表发表讲话、敦促他们投票支持代表该区的现任参议员Sahabi Ya’u Kaura时，险些遭到愤怒青年的袭击。据《LEADERSHIP》获得的报道，事发时Haidara正在初选投票点讲话。报道称，这些青年是其所挑战的参议员Tijjani Yahaya Kaura的支持者。他们拒绝了Haidara的呼吁，坚持支持自己属意的候选人。目击者称，局势不断恶化，这些青年对地方政府主席大喊大叫，并因所谓偏袒和强行施压而试图袭击他。现场的警察和其他安全人员介入，将Haidara从人群中救出。此次初选是Sahabi Ya’u与Tijjani Yahaya Kaura争夺APC代表赞法拉北区的党内候选人资格。该区包括考拉纳莫达、比尔宁马加吉、欣卡菲和祖尔米4个地方政府。截至本报道提交时，现场局势已恢复平静，但安全人员仍大量驻守。由于Haidara的电话已关机，未能联系其本人置评。掌握第一手动态，实时获取突发新闻和独家报道，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，享全天候更新 →
