https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 数据显示，韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创1153亿美元的历史纪录，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。韩国贸易、工业和资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的强劲需求，以及主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea's exports jumped 93.7 percent to a record $115.3 billion in October from a year earlier, driven largely by a sharp increase in semiconductor shipments, data showed Sunday. Strong global demand for semiconductors, coupled with continued investments by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, boosted overall exports, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said in a press release. Imports rose 36 percent from a year earlier to $72.78 billion, resulting in a trade surplus of $42.5 billion. Cumulative exports for the January-October period exceeded $900 billion for the first time, with the ministry projecting that the country's annual exports could reach $1 trillion as early as November if the current trend continues. By sector, semiconductor exports, a key pillar of Asia's fourth-largest economy, skyrocketed 259 percent from a year earlier to $56.4 billion in October, the release said. Exports of petroleum products jumped 80 percent to $6.92 billion, while those of petrochemical products rose 27.5 percent to $4 billion. Cosmetics exports shot up 57.5 percent to $1.44 billion on rising demand in China, the United States and the European Union. Automobile exports gained 18.1 percent to $6.55 billion, driven by increased overseas demand for gasoline hybrid models. By destination, exports to China soared 133.6 percent to $26.98 billion, driven by strong shipments of semiconductors and wireless communications equipment. Exports to China topped $20 billion for the fifth consecutive month. Shipments to the United States surged 185.8 percent to $24.9 billion, supported by robust demand for semiconductors, computers and electrical equipment used in AI infrastructure. The monthly report also showed exports to Southeast Asian countries rose 128 percent to $21.33 billion, while those to the European Union increased 56.4 percent to $8.1 billion, with both gains driven by strong shipments of chips and automobiles. "The global trade environment remains uncertain, with many small and medium-sized enterprises facing difficulties amid rising protectionism in major economies, shifts in global supply chains and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East," Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan said. To address these challenges, the government will step up trade cooperation with major export partners and work to remove barriers to exports to ease the burden on businesses, he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 芯片销售强劲，韩国10月出口额达到1153亿美元
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创纪录的1153亿美元，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。数据显示，韩国工业贸易资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的旺盛需求，加上主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。进口额同比增长36%，达到727.8亿美元，实现贸易顺差425亿美元。1月至10月累计出口额首次突破900亿美元；该部预计，如果当前趋势持续，韩国全年出口额最早可于11月达到1万亿美元。新闻稿称，作为亚洲第四大经济体的支柱行业，半导体出口额10月同比飙升259%，达到564亿美元。石油产品出口额增长80%，达到69.2亿美元；石化产品出口额增长27.5%，达到40亿美元。受中国、美国和欧盟需求上升推动，化妆品出口额猛增57.5%，达到14.4亿美元。混合动力汽车海外需求增加，推动汽车出口额增长18.1%，达到65.5亿美元。按目的地划分，受半导体和无线通信设备出货量强劲推动，对华出口额飙升133.6%，达到269.8亿美元，对华出口额连续第5个月超过200亿美元。得益于半导体、计算机以及人工智能基础设施所用电气设备的旺盛需求，对美出货额激增185.8%，达到249亿美元。月报还显示，对东南亚国家出口额增长128%，达到213.3亿美元；对欧盟出口额增长56.4%，达到81亿美元，两项增长均得益于芯片和汽车出货量强劲。产业部长金正官表示：“全球贸易环境仍不确定，主要经济体保护主义抬头、全球供应链调整以及中东地缘政治紧张，使许多中小企业面临困难。”他说，为应对这些挑战，政府将加强与主要出口伙伴的贸易合作，并努力消除出口壁垒，以减轻企业负担。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title: Nigeria woos Russian investors, seeks local currency trade settlement at Moscow summit
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.summary: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye, made the call while delivering Nigeria’s statement at the Third Russia-Africa Summit at the Grand Kremlin Palace, where he also advocated stronger trade and financial arrangements, including independent local currency settlement mechanisms between both countries.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.summary_zh: 外交部国务部长、大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 在克里姆林宫举行的第三届俄罗斯—非洲峰会期间发表尼日利亚声明时进行了这次通话。他还在会上主张加强两国之间的贸易和金融安排，包括建立独立的地方货币结算机制。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: Layer 1 The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye Nigeria has called for a shift in its relations with Russia from political commitments to practical economic cooperation, urging Russian investors to explore opportunities in the country’s energy, solid minerals, agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals and digital sectors. The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye, made the call while delivering Nigeria’s statement at the Third Russia-Africa Summit at the Grand Kremlin Palace, where he also advocated stronger trade and financial arrangements, including independent local currency settlement mechanisms between both countries. Enikanolaiye, who led Nigeria’s delegation to the summit, said the future of Africa- Russia relations must be measured by tangible economic outcomes, stressing the need to translate longstanding diplomatic ties into investments, technology transfer and development partnerships. He said Nigeria was particularly interested in strengthening cross-border payment arrangements with Russia through mutually agreed systems, alongside improved banking channels and financial infrastructure to facilitate trade and investment. The minister, who conveyed President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s greetings to Russian President Vladimir Putin and the African Union Chairman, President Evariste Ndayishimiye of Burundi, said the private sector must play a greater role in driving the partnership. He urged Russia to collaborate with African countries on commercially viable infrastructure projects covering railways, ports, energy, telecommunications, transport and logistics, noting that such investments would strengthen regional connectivity and support the objectives of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). On the digital economy, Enikanolaiye warned against Africa becoming merely a consumer of imported technology, calling for expanded cooperation in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, software development, digital infrastructure and joint research. He said such partnerships should prioritise technology transfer, capacity building and the development of indigenous technological capabilities across the continent. The minister also identified agriculture and food security as critical areas for cooperation, urging Russia to support African countries in expanding domestic food production, fertiliser availability, irrigation, mechanisation, agricultural research, storage and agro-processing. According to him, recent disruptions to global supply chains have exposed the vulnerability of food systems, making it imperative for African countries to strengthen domestic production and retain more value from their agricultural resources. On security, Enikanolaiye reaffirmed Nigeria’s commitment to peace and stability in Africa, identifying terrorism, violent extremism, transnational organised crime, arms trafficking, piracy and cybercrime as threats requiring coordinated regional and international responses. He, however, stressed that such partnerships must be anchored on African ownership and African-led solutions, with external cooperation strengthening existing regional mechanisms, including the African Union and ECOWAS. The minister further reiterated Nigeria’s commitment to sovereign equality, territorial integrity, non-interference and the peaceful settlement of disputes, while calling for reforms of the United Nations Security Council and international financial architecture to guarantee Africa’s rightful representation. On the outcome of the summit, Enikanolaiye said Nigeria supported the adoption of a focused Africa-Russia Action Plan for 2027–2029, with clear priorities, financing arrangements and monitoring mechanisms to ensure that agreements translated into measurable results. He specifically invited Russian businesses to take advantage of Nigeria’s position as Africa’s largest market and a strategic gateway to West Africa and the AfCFTA, highlighting opportunities in energy, including renewable and nuclear technology, solid minerals, agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, defence and digital services. The minister also said the summit had reinforced the longstanding friendly relations between Nigeria and Russia, recalling Moscow’s historic support for Nigeria’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity dating back to the Soviet era. Speaking at the plenary session, Putin described Russia and Africa as natural allies in building a just multipolar world order, reaffirming his country’s commitment to sovereign equality, expanded diplomatic engagement, security cooperation and greater African representation in global institutions. Similarly, Ndayishimiye stressed that Africa would not exchange one form of subordination for another, insisting that the continent’s international partnerships must respect its independence and development priorities. He said the 2027–2029 Action Plan would provide an opportunity to address infrastructure deficits through technology transfer and skills development, while moving Africa from dependence on external assistance towards greater economic independence. The AU chairman also identified water security as a major priority of the continental body’s 2026 agenda. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚在莫斯科峰会吸引俄罗斯投资者，并寻求以当地货币结算贸易
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh:
第一层：尼日利亚外交国务部长兼大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 呼吁尼日利亚与俄罗斯的关系从政治承诺转向务实经济合作，并敦促俄罗斯投资者探索该国能源、固体矿产、农业、制造业、制药和数字经济领域的机会。

尼日利亚外交国务部长兼大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 在克里姆林宫举行的第三届俄罗斯—非洲峰会上宣读尼日利亚声明时提出这一主张。他还主张加强贸易和金融安排，包括在两国之间建立独立使用本币的结算机制。

率领尼日利亚代表团出席会议的 Enikanolaiye 表示，非洲与俄罗斯关系的未来必须以切实的经济成果为衡量标准，并强调需要把长期的外交关系转化为投资、技术转让和发展伙伴关系。

他说，尼日利亚尤其希望通过双方商定的机制，加强与俄罗斯之间的跨境支付安排，同时改善银行渠道和金融基础设施，以促进贸易和投资。

这位部长转达了总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu 对俄罗斯总统 Vladimir普京和非洲联盟主席、burundi总统 Evariste Ndayishimiye 的问候，并表示私营部门必须在推动伙伴关系方面发挥更大作用。

他敦促俄罗斯与非洲国家合作开展具有商业可行性的基础设施项目，涵盖铁路、港口、能源、电信、运输和物流，并指出，此类投资将加强区域互联互通，支持非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的目标。

在数字经济方面，Enikanolaiye 警告称，非洲不能仅仅成为进口技术的消费方，并呼吁扩大人工智能、网络安全、软件开发、数字基础设施和联合研究等领域的合作。

他说，此类伙伴关系应优先推动技术转让、能力建设以及非洲大陆本土技术能力的发展。

这位部长还将农业和粮食安全列为合作的关键领域，敦促俄罗斯支持非洲国家扩大国内粮食生产、提高化肥供应能力、发展灌溉、推进农业机械化，并加强农业研究、储存和农产品加工。

据他介绍，近期全球供应链中断暴露了粮食系统的脆弱性，因此非洲国家必须加强国内生产，并从农业资源中保留更多价值。

在安全问题上，Enikanolaiye 重申尼日利亚致力于维护非洲的和平与稳定，并指出恐怖主义、暴力极端主义、跨国有组织犯罪、军火贩运、海盗行为和网络犯罪都是威胁，需要区域和国际社会采取协调应对措施。

不过，他强调，此类伙伴关系必须以非洲自主权和非洲主导的解决方案为基础，外部合作应当加强包括非洲联盟和西非国家经济共同体在内的现有区域机制。

这位部长还重申尼日利亚致力于实现主权平等、维护领土完整、奉行不干涉原则以及和平解决争端，同时呼吁改革联合国安全委员会和国际金融架构，确保非洲获得应有的代表权。

谈及峰会成果，Enikanolaiye 表示，尼日利亚支持通过一项重点明确的《非洲—俄罗斯2027—2029年行动计划》，并明确优先事项、融资安排和监测机制，以确保各项协议转化为可衡量的成果。

他特别邀请俄罗斯企业利用尼日利亚作为非洲最大市场以及通往西非和非洲大陆自由贸易区战略门户的区位优势，并强调能源（包括可再生能源和核技术）、固体矿产、农业、制造业、制药、国防和数字服务等领域蕴含的机会。

这位部长还表示，本次峰会加强了尼日利亚与俄罗斯之间长期存在的友好关系，并回顾了莫斯科自苏联时期以来对尼日利亚统一、主权和领土完整的历史支持。

普京在全会上发言，将俄罗斯和非洲描述为建设公正多极世界秩序的天然盟友，重申俄罗斯致力于实现主权平等、扩大外交接触、加强安全合作以及推动非洲在全球机构中获得更多代表权。

同样，Ndayishimiye 强调，非洲不会以另一种从属形式取代现有的从属关系，并坚持非洲大陆的国际伙伴关系必须尊重其独立性和发展优先事项。

他说，《2027—2029年行动计划》将提供通过技术转让和技能开发来弥补基础设施缺口的机会，同时推动非洲从依赖外部援助转向实现更大程度的经济独立。

这位非盟主席还将水安全列为该大陆机构2026年议程的一项主要优先事项。

上述内容载于这位部长的媒体与公共传播特助 Richard Elesho 周日发布的一份声明。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bett.body: Layer 1 Former Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction, Dr Betta Edu, has set a target of 1.5 million votes from Cross River for President Bola Tinubu, come 2027 general elections. Edu, Co-Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC) Women Mobilisation Directorate, made the declaration on Sunday in Calabar, during an empowerment programme that benefited about 500 market women, petty traders and artisans. She said the initiative organised at the instance of the First Lady, Oluremi Tinubu, was designed to improve women’s economic livelihood, and strengthen grassroots mobilisation. She said the beneficiaries received N50,000 each, alongside business and household equipment, including deep freezers, blenders, and toasters. According to her, the intervention targets petty traders whose businesses are constrained by inadequate capital. “Some of them are selling trays that have just N5,000 worth of things on them, while some of them have trays with just N10,000 worth of items on them. “So we are giving these sets of petty traders N50,000 each so that they can expand that their business, build on it, so things can get better for them and their children,” she said. Edu urged residents of the state to support Tinubu, Gov. Bassey Otu and other APC candidates as the party was banking on grassroots women’s mobilisation to strengthen its electoral fortunes in the state. She expressed confidence that the state would deliver more than 1.5 million votes for the ruling party, adding that the directorate was establishing support structures for women across the country. She disclosed that the empowerment programme would be extended to other parts of Cross River, with Abi Local Government Area scheduled to benefit in November or December, while the northern senatorial district would be reached in January. The former minister also highlighted some Federal Government interventions, including the student loan scheme and free maternal healthcare, as measures aimed at improving the welfare of Nigerians. As part of the mobilisation activities, she led members of the directorate on a visit to the General Hospital, Calabar, where they interacted with patients, pregnant women and children receiving treatment and offered financial and emotional support. She said the hospital outreach was undertaken at the instance of the First Lady ahead of the APC rally scheduled to hold in Calabar on Monday. Edu also cited subsidised dialysis services and free maternal healthcare as interventions aimed at improving healthcare access and reducing maternal mortality. One of the beneficiaries, Esther Bassey, a widow from Odukpani Local Government Area, expressed appreciation for the support, saying previous empowerment programmes had helped her cater for her three children. Bassey pledged her support for the APC in 2027, saying she and her family would vote for the party Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bett.title_zh: 贝塔·埃杜争取克诺河州500名女性支持，为蒂努布设定150万张选票目标
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bett.body_zh: 第一层：前人道事务与减贫部长贝塔·埃杜博士表示，在2027年大选前，她已为总统博拉·蒂努布设定目标，希望从十字河流州争取150万张选票。埃杜是全进步大会党（APC）妇女动员委员会联席主席。星期日，她在卡拉巴尔举行的一项赋权活动上宣布了这一目标。该活动惠及约500名市场妇女、小商贩和手工艺人。她说，这项由第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布发起组织的举措旨在改善妇女的经济生计，并加强基层动员。她说，每名受益者获得了50,000奈拉，以及商用和家用设备，包括深冷冻柜、搅拌机和烤面包机。据她介绍，这项援助面向因资本不足而经营受限的小商贩。“有些人出售的托盘上只有价值5,000奈拉的商品，而另一些人的托盘上也只有价值10,000奈拉的商品。因此，我们向这些小商贩每人提供50,000奈拉，让她们能够扩大经营、继续发展，从而改善自己和孩子的处境。”埃杜呼吁该州居民支持蒂努布、州长巴塞·奥图以及APC的其他候选人，因为该党指望通过动员基层妇女来增强自身在该州的选举优势。她相信，该州将为执政党投出超过150万张选票，并补充说，该委员会正在全国范围内为妇女建立支持网络。她透露，这项赋权活动将延伸至十字河流州其他地区。阿比地方政府辖区计划于11月或12月受益，而北部参议员选区将在1月得到覆盖。这名前部长还介绍了联邦政府的若干干预措施，包括学生贷款计划和免费孕产妇医疗保健，旨在改善尼日利亚国民的福祉。作为动员活动的一部分，她带领委员会成员探访卡拉巴尔综合医院，与正在接受治疗的患者、孕妇和儿童交流，并提供经济及情感支持。她说，此次医院外展活动是在第一夫人推动下开展的，先于定于星期一在卡拉巴尔举行的APC集会。埃杜还提到补贴透析服务和免费孕产妇医疗保健，认为这些措施旨在改善医疗服务可及性并降低孕产妇死亡率。受益者之一、来自奥杜帕尼地方政府辖区的寡妇埃丝特·巴塞对这项支持表示感谢，并表示此前的赋权计划帮助她养育三个孩子。巴塞承诺在2027年支持APC，称她和家人将投票给该党。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 卡塔萨州政府将扬卡拉地区法斯卡里地方政府辖区发生的暴力事件归因于对一场穆卢德游行活动的争议，并否认有报道将该事件与州长迪科·拉达的竞选集会联系起来。他说，这起事件与法斯卡里举行的蒂努布—迪科竞选集会毫无关系。州长参观了该地区领主的宫殿，并视察了地方政府秘书处和议事厅的翻修工程，随后出席了竞选集会。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: The Katsina State Government has attributed violence in Yankara, Faskari Local Government Area, to a disagreement over a Maulud procession, denying reports linking the incident to Governor Dikko Radda’s campaign rally. Two vehicles were reportedly burnt and several people injured during the disturbance. In a statement on Saturday, the governor’s Chief Press Secretary, Ibrahim Kaula Mohammed, said participants in the religious procession disagreed with security personnel over designated routes, causing confusion along a public street. He said the incident had no connection with the Tinubu-Dikko campaign rally in Faskari. LEADERSHIP newspaper reported that suspected hoodlums burnt two vehicles, including one belonging to the Musa Adamu Network (MAN), a political association. Several people were reportedly injured, while shops were damaged. Nura Yandaki, chairman of the association’s caucus, told the newspaper that he was travelling with 11 other members to the governor’s rally when the disturbance occurred. He said trouble began around a Maulud procession before suspected hoodlums attacked passing vehicles. Mr Yandaki said members of his delegation escaped unharmed, but their vehicle was destroyed. An unnamed local government official also told LEADERSHIP that two vehicles were burnt and several people injured while residents and political supporters awaited the governor’s arrival. The government’s statement did not address the reported attacks on vehicles carrying people travelling to the rally. Mr Mohammed said Governor Radda passed safely through Yankara on his way to Faskari. The governor visited the district head’s palace and inspected renovation works at the local government secretariat and council chambers before attending the campaign rally. The government called on security agencies to investigate the violence and establish what happened. It also urged media organisations and social media users to verify information before publication and appealed to residents to remain calm and avoid spreading unverified reports

https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.summary: The party alleged a sustained pattern of attacks on its members, including gunshots at the airport, assault on women supporters and vandalisation of its campaign office. https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.summary_zh: 该党指控其成员持续遭到袭击，包括机场枪击、针对女性支持者的殴打以及竞选办公室遭破坏。戈罗尼奥表示，ADC已正式通知索科托州政府，决定为在索科托启动总统竞选举行旗式启动仪式，原定于10月31日举行，但政府回复表示不同意。
https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.body: The party alleged a sustained pattern of attacks on its members, including gunshots at the airport, assault on women supporters and vandalisation of its campaign office. Addressing a press conference at the party headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, the state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, said the party would remain peaceful and law-abiding but would not surrender its constitutional right to organise political activities. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the state government to investigate the attacks, including the assault on its governorship candidate on October 30. “We demand protection for our candidate and supporters, accountability for those responsible, and an end to any use of state-backed security outfits to restrict lawful political activity,” he said. Goronyo said the ADC had formally notified the state government of its decision to flag off its presidential campaign in Sokoto, initially slated for October 31, but the government replied expressing disagreement. “The government replied by stating its disagreement with the flag-off. That reply raises serious concern about the government’s commitment to political pluralism, freedom of association and the right of opposition parties to hold lawful political activities,” he said. He alleged that the attacks were not isolated but a sustained pattern, which he linked to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. The party identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected to the attacks. “On Wednesday, October 28, 2026, our women were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march. Participants were injured, their mobile phones were snatched, their clothing was torn, and their vehicles and other property were vandalised,” he said. He said on the same day, the ADC state campaign office was attacked, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed, while billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. Goronyo further alleged that hotels booked for the flag-off cancelled reservations under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. “Government-owned hotels reportedly stopped accepting guests on the claim that their rooms were fully booked. We have received reports that hotel operators were threatened with consequences, including the demolition of their properties, if they refused to comply. “We are seeking written confirmation of these reports. If established, they would represent a serious abuse of public authority,” he said. “Who authorised their release, under what legal process, and what safeguards were put in place? Release from prison must never be treated as a licence to intimidate citizens, and political connections must not place anyone beyond accountability,” he asked. Goronyo said the party’s governorship candidate, Manir Muhammad Dan’iya (Walin Sokoto), was attacked at the Sultan Abubakar III International Airport, Sokoto, on Friday, by personnel of the Sokoto Marshals and Sokoto Community Guards. He said his vehicles were smashed and gunshots were fired, while two DSS personnel attached to the candidate were reportedly detained. “The authorities must establish who authorised the operation, what instructions were issued, who discharged firearms and under what authority, and why DSS officers assigned to a political candidate were detained by state security personnel. “Responsibility must not stop at the personnel at the scene: anyone who authorised, directed, sponsored or facilitated unlawful conduct must also be investigated,” he said. He said the party had also received reports that personnel of the two state-owned security outfits had been instructed to prevent ADC supporters from entering Sokoto ahead of the flag-off. “We consider this allegation extremely serious. If confirmed, the instruction would violate the constitutional rights of citizens to freedom of movement, peaceful assembly and political association. “No governor, political party or security commander has the authority to restrict citizens from entering a state because of their political affiliation,” he said. He said residents were entitled to question the state’s security priorities when communities still face banditry and kidnapping. “The ADC is a peaceful political party committed to democratic principles, political tolerance, constitutional freedoms and the rule of law. Our commitment to peace must never be mistaken for weakness or surrender of our constitutional rights. “We will not be intimidated, silenced or forced out of the democratic space through violence, threats or politically motivated harassment,” he declared. He called for a thorough investigation into the gunshots, destruction of vehicles, detention of DSS personnel, alleged involvement of Aliyu K.C. and his associates, threat to hotel operators and denial of venue, as well as protection for ADC candidates, leaders and supporters. He also urged all state-owned security outfits to remain politically neutral and not be deployed for partisan activities. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.title_zh: 索科托2027：人民民主大会党就竞选活动升旗挑战政府
https://leadership.ng/sokoto-2027-adc-da.body_zh: 该党指控其成员持续遭到袭击，包括有人在机场开枪、殴打女性支持者以及破坏其竞选办公室。该党州主席兼Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo周日在索科托党总部举行的新闻发布会上表示，该党将继续保持和平并遵守法律，但不会放弃组织政治活动的宪法权利。他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和州政府调查这些袭击，包括10月30日对其州长候选人的殴打。他说：“我们要求保护我们的候选人和支持者，追究肇事者的责任，并制止任何利用国家支持的安全机构限制合法政治活动的行为。”Goronyo表示，ADC已正式通知州政府，决定在索科托启动其总统竞选活动，原定于10月31日举行，但政府回复称不同意举行该活动。他说：“政府回复表示不同意启动竞选活动。这一回复引发了对政府是否致力于政治多元、结社自由以及反对党举行合法政治活动权利的严重关切。”他称，这些袭击并非孤立事件，而是一种持续模式，并将矛头指向据称由州政府从监狱释放的两名与政治暴力有关的人员。该党确认Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些袭击有关。Goronyo说：“2026年10月28日星期三，我们的女性支持者在一次和平声援游行中遭到袭击。参加者受伤，手机被抢，衣服被撕破，车辆及其他财产遭到破坏。”他说，同一天，ADC州竞选办公室也遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被洗劫，3辆摩托车被毁，同时全州范围内的广告牌、海报及其他竞选材料也遭到破坏。Goronyo进一步指控，为竞选启动活动预订的酒店在州政府施压下取消预订，而政府所属酒店则声称房间已被订满。他说：“据报道，政府所属酒店以房间已满为由停止接待客人。我们收到报告称，如果酒店经营者拒绝配合，就可能遭到包括拆除其在内的各种后果。我们正在寻求这些报告的书面确认。如果情况属实，将构成对公共权力的严重滥用。”他质问道：“是谁授权释放他们，采用了什么法律程序，又采取了哪些保障措施？服刑人员获释绝不能被视为恐吓公民的许可证，政治关系也绝不能让任何人免于问责。”Goronyo表示，该党州长候选人Manir Muhammad Dan’iya（Walin Sokoto）周五在索科托Sultan Abubakar III国际机场遭到Sokoto Marshals和Sokoto Community Guards人员袭击。他说，候选人的车辆被砸，枪声响起，而据报道，随行候选人的2名DSS人员被拘留。他说：“当局必须查明是谁授权此次行动，下达了哪些指示，谁在何种权限下开枪，以及为何负责政治候选人的DSS人员会被州安全人员拘留。责任调查不能止于现场人员：任何授权、指示、资助或协助违法行为的个人也必须接受调查。”他还说，该党收到报告称，两支州属安全机构的人员已接到指示，要阻止ADC支持者在竞选启动活动前进入索科托。他说：“我们认为这一指控极其严重。如果得到证实，该指示将侵犯公民自由迁徙、和平集会和政治结社的宪法权利。没有任何州长、政党或安全指挥官有权仅因公民的政治立场而限制他们进入一个州。”他表示，在各社区仍面临武装劫匪和绑架活动的情况下，州居民有权质疑州政府的安全优先事项。他说：“ADC是一个坚持民主原则、政治包容、宪法自由和法治的和平政党。我们对和平的承诺绝不能被误认为软弱，也不能被视为放弃宪法权利。我们不会因暴力、威胁或出于政治动机的骚扰而受到恐吓、噤声或被迫退出民主空间。”他呼吁对枪击、车辆被毁、DSS人员被拘留、Aliyu K.C.及其同伙涉嫌参与袭击、威胁酒店经营者以及拒绝提供场地等事件展开全面调查，并保护ADC候选人、领导人和支持者。他还敦促所有州属安全机构保持政治中立，不得被用于党派活动。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕消息和独家角度，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: U.S. President Donald Trump has said the United States would talk to North Korea if it is found to be behind the theft of more than $6 billion from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. Trump made the remarks at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Palm Beach, Florida, on Saturday after the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said North Korea was responsible for the theft of virtual assets from Binance on or about Oct. 29. "I'm not concerned. We're learning about it," he said. "We don't know if it's North Korea, but if it is, we'll talk to North Korea about it." In a cyber alert, the FBI identified the North Korean cyber operation as "TraderTraitor," a name previously associated with cryptocurrency thefts carried out by North Korean hackers. The agency said it had observed the hackers converting stolen assets primarily into Ethereum, a major cryptocurrency, in cooperation with the U.S. Secret Service and the Internal Revenue Service's Criminal Investigation division. The FBI warned that the hackers were expected to further launder the stolen assets through decentralized finance platforms and cryptocurrency exchange services that allow users to quickly swap one digital asset for another. The three U.S. agencies urged cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain operators, analytics firms and other virtual asset service providers to block transactions involving digital wallet addresses used by the North Korean hackers to launder the stolen funds. The FBI's announcement follows an assessment by U.S. blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs, which earlier attributed the estimated $6.36 billion Binance theft to TraderTraitor. Trump's remarks come amid persistent speculation over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. Trump and Kim met three times during Trump's first presidential term. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday that Trump remains open to talks with Kim if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, though no meeting has been scheduled
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 特朗普称，如果朝鲜与Binance黑客攻击有关，美国将与其谈判
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，如果查明超过60亿美元的加密货币被盗案与朝鲜有关，美国将同朝鲜对话。全球最大加密货币交易所Binance被盗一案发生后，特朗普于周六在佛罗里达州棕榈滩的海湖庄园发表上述言论。此前，美国联邦调查局（FBI）称，朝鲜应对大约10月29日Binance虚拟资产被盗案负责。他说：“我并不担心。我们正在了解情况。我们还不知道是不是朝鲜干的，但如果是，我们会就此事同朝鲜对话。”FBI在一份网络安全警报中将朝鲜的这项网络行动称为“TraderTraitor”，此前这一名称曾与朝鲜黑客实施的加密货币盗窃活动相关联。该机构称，在美国特勤局和美国国内税务局刑事调查部门的合作下，它发现黑客主要将窃取的资产转换为以太坊这一主要加密货币。FBI警告称，预计这些黑客还会通过去中心化金融平台和加密货币交易服务进一步洗钱，这些服务允许用户快速将一种数字资产兑换为另一种数字资产。上述三个美国机构敦促加密货币交易所、区块链运营商、分析公司及其他虚拟资产服务提供商，阻断涉及朝鲜黑客所用数字钱包地址的交易，以阻止被盗资金遭到洗钱。FBI宣布此事之前，美国区块链情报公司TRM Labs已经评估认定，估计价值63.6亿美元的Binance盗窃案系TraderTraitor所为。特朗普发表上述言论之际，外界持续猜测特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩是否有可能重启外交接触。特朗普首次担任总统期间曾与金正恩会面三次。美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥周六表示，如果平壤愿意讨论令华盛顿及其盟友关切的问题，特朗普仍愿与金正恩会谈，不过目前尚未安排任何会面

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump remains open to talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, but no meeting has been scheduled, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday. Rubio made the remarks during a press conference following a Group of 20 (G20) foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta. "I think the president's perspective is, if North Korea and Kim Jong-un is prepared to talk with the United States about issues that are of concern to us and of concern to our allies, like South Korea, he would be open to doing it," Rubio said. "Nothing has been scheduled. I do not have anything to announce in regards to that today," he added. His remarks came amid persistent speculations over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Trump and Kim, who held three meetings during Trump's first presidential term. The comments also followed trilateral talks among Rubio and his South Korean and Japanese counterparts in Atlanta on Friday, during which the three top diplomats reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea. "The president doesn't view talks, doesn't view meeting with someone as a concession." Rubio said. "I know in traditional foreign policy, meeting with someone or inviting someone to something is viewed as a concession that somehow legitimizes them." Asked of recent U.S. visa refusal or delay cases involving South Korean legislators, Rubio said the two countries will "work through" the issue on a bilateral basis. Unlock these with Subscription The government on Saturday (October 31, 2026) slashed the export duty on petrol to nil while hiking the levy on export of diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by ₹3 per litre and 50 paise per litre respectively for the next 15-day period. There was no change in the existing excise duty rates for petrol and diesel for domestic consumption. Diesel exports would now draw a levy of ₹11.5 for every litre against ₹8.5 per litre it drew in the previous fortnight. ATF would be subject to an export levy of ₹11 for every litre against ₹10.5 for every litre as mandated for the previous fortnight. The revised levy on diesel assumes significance as India spiked its exports of the liquid vehicular fuel amid a global supply crunch, particularly in Europe. According to data from real-time analytics provider Kpler, India’s diesel exports stood at 700 kilo barrels per day in October, the highest since September 2025. The government has been conducting a fortnightly review of export levies since March 27, in the backdrop of the conflict in West Asia. These are done based on the average international benchmark prices of crude oil, petrol, diesel and ATF observed since the previous review. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun met separately with his German and Polish counterparts on the sidelines of a Group of 20 (G20) meeting in Atlanta to discuss ways to enhance bilateral cooperation, his office said Saturday. Cho met with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul on Friday (U.S. time), expressing hope for deeper ties with the European nation in a wide range of areas, including defense, the economy and cutting-edge industries, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In response, Wadephul thanked Seoul's foreign ministry for successfully preparing for German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's recent visit to Korea and expressed hope for expanded cooperation in bilateral trade and investment. Cho also met with his Polish counterpart, Radoslaw Sikorski, and called for continued discussions on cooperation in areas such as defense and batteries as a follow-up to Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk's visit to Korea in April, the ministry said. Sikorski also requested Korea's attention and support for Warsaw's efforts to join the G20, with Cho proposing continued consultations on the matter

https://leadership.ng/fg-tasks-nigerians.body: The Executive Vice Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the National Agency for Science and Engineering Infrastructure (NASENI), Mr Khalil Suleiman Halilu, made the call during the distribution of solar home systems, clean cooking stoves and household support packs to 330 residents of Ondo State in Akure. Halilu said the initiative was designed to translate research and development into practical products that could improve living conditions and provide economic opportunities for Nigerians. He explained that the solar home systems would provide lighting for households, enable children to study at night and support small businesses, while the clean cooking stoves would offer more efficient cooking alternatives and reduce exposure to smoke when properly used. According to him, wider adoption of locally developed products would encourage domestic manufacturing and strengthen Nigeria’s capacity to develop solutions to its own challenges. He said “This is to promote locally produced items which brings about employment and also to have something good for our communities. He said the NASENI Sustainable Empowerment Programme had reached more than 10 states across the six geopolitical zones, with 330 men and women benefiting from the intervention in Ondo State. The NASENI chief executive added that the programme was intended to take technological innovations beyond research facilities and make them accessible to households and businesses. Also speaking, the Minister of Youth Development, Ayodele Olawande, said beneficiaries would receive additional financial support to enable them to establish or strengthen micro-businesses. Olawande said the intervention was not a political strategy but an effort to take technology-based solutions and economic opportunities to grassroots communities. In his remarks, gov. Yusuf commended Abejide for extending his empowerment programme beyond his constituency, urging other federal lawmakers to support Nigerians irrespective of their ethnic or religious backgrounds. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.summary_zh: 正是在这一背景下，美国众议院开始审议一项新法案，旨在规范预付租金并保护租户免受其所称非法租赁行为的侵害。违反拟议中的12个月上限而支付租金的租户，可向拟设立的首联邦首都地区租金监管与租户保护管理局申请退款。该法案规范可一次性要求支付的租金数额，但不规定房东实际可收取的租金金额。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.body: For many residents of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), securing a roof over their heads can mean raising hundreds of thousands, and sometimes millions, of naira at once. Beyond the annual rent itself, prospective tenants often have to contend with agency, agreement and caution fees, while existing tenants face rent increases that can force them to move to less expensive and sometimes more distant communities. It is against this backdrop that the House of Representatives has begun consideration of a new bill seeking to regulate advance rent payments and protect tenants from what it describes as unlawful rental practices. The Federal Capital Territory Advance Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Bill, 2026 (HB.2839), jointly sponsored by Paul Nnamchi (APC, Enugu) and Ahmed Doro (PDP, Katsina), passed first reading on Thursday, 22 October. But the proposal is not simply another attempt to tell landlords how much rent to collect. A closer look at the 17-page bill obtained by PREMIUM TIMES shows that it seeks to create an entire regulatory framework for tenancy in the FCT, covering advance payments, written agreements, agents, complaints, refunds, eviction practices, penalties and dispute resolution. The central provision is contained in Section 4 of the bill. Section 4(1) of the bill provides that a landlord, estate agent or property manager “shall not demand, receive or compel a tenant to pay more than twelve months’ rent in advance” as a condition for granting, renewing or continuing a tenancy. This simply prohibits the demanding, receiving or compelling of a tenant to pay more than one year’s rent in advance as a condition for obtaining, renewing or continuing a tenancy. That means the bill does not ban advance rent or make monthly rent compulsory. Instead, it establishes 12 months as the maximum amount that can be compulsorily demanded upfront. A landlord would still be able to collect one year’s rent in advance if that is the agreed arrangement. But demanding two or three years as a condition for granting or renewing a tenancy would become an offence if the bill becomes law. The bill also attempts to prevent landlords and agents from simply finding another way around the restriction. It specifically lists intermediaries, unexplained premiums, compulsory service charges, artificial renewal or re-grant of a tenancy, separate agreements and other arrangements designed to extract more than 12 months’ rent in advance as prohibited means of evasion. The proposed restriction has an exception. Section 4(4) states that a tenant may voluntarily pay more than 12 months’ rent in advance if “the tenant initiates the offer” and the payment is not imposed by the landlord and the tenant must not have been subjected to coercion, discrimination, threats or retaliation. The agreement must be recorded in writing, and the person receiving the payment bears the burden of proving compliance. This could become one of the contentious provisions during the legislative process. While the bill attempts to distinguish voluntary payments from compulsory demands, proving that a tenant genuinely volunteered to pay several years’ rent could be difficult where the landlord controls access to the property. The proposed law also seeks to formalise the relationship between landlords and tenants. Section 5 requires landlords or their authorised agents to provide written tenancy agreements stating the rent, payment schedule, duration of the tenancy, refundable deposits, fees and other charges, and the rights and obligations of both parties. Landlords and agents would also be required to disclose the nature, amount and legal basis of compulsory fees before a tenancy agreement is concluded and issue receipts or verifiable electronic acknowledgements for payments. The bill also prohibits retaliation against tenants who refuse to make unlawful payments or who complain about violations. A landlord or agent would not be allowed to threaten or unlawfully evict such a tenant, impose a punitive charge, withdraw a lawful benefit or otherwise retaliate against the tenant. The bill introduces a remedy that could significantly change the balance between tenants and landlords. Section 7 introduces a mechanism for recovering unlawfully collected rent. A tenant who has paid rent in violation of the proposed 12-month limit could apply to the proposed FCT Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Authority for a refund. Where the proposed authority determines that a payment contravened the law, it may order the recipient to refund the unlawful amount within 30 days. The bill also allows an aggrieved party to appeal an order of the authority to the FCT High Court. “7(1) A tenant who has paid rent in contravention of section 4 may apply to the Authority for a refund order. (2) Where the Authority determines that a payment was received in contravention of section 4, it may order the recipient to refund the unlawful amount within thirty days after service of the order.” Under Section 8, the bill proposes the establishment of the Federal Capital Territory Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Authority. The authority would receive and investigate complaints, monitor landlords, estate agents and property managers, issue compliance notices, facilitate mediation, order refunds and refer suspected criminal offences to relevant law-enforcement or prosecuting authorities. It would also establish complaint offices and electronic reporting channels throughout the FCT, including satellite towns, and publish periodic reports on rental practices and enforcement outcomes. Its governing board would include representatives of the FCT Administration, the federal ministry responsible for housing, the federal ministry responsible for justice, tenants, landlords or property owners and estate surveyors and valuers. The president will appoint the chairperson and members of the board, subject to Senate confirmation. The president will also appoint the director-general, subject to Senate confirmation. A person convicted of knowingly demanding or receiving unlawful advance rent would face a fine of between ₦500,000 and ₦5 million. A corporate body could face a fine of between ₦5 million and ₦20 million. The court could also order refunds, compensation for proven losses and payment of lawful costs. Failure to comply with a compliance notice issued by the proposed authority would also constitute an offence punishable by a fine of up to ₦1 million. Estate agents and property managers are expressly covered. Where an offence is committed through an intermediary, anyone who knowingly authorised, participated in or facilitated the offence could also be liable. The bill is not solely about the amount of money tenants pay. It also targets the methods some landlords may use to recover possession. It prohibits violence or threats, disconnecting essential services, removing or damaging a tenant’s property, changing locks without lawful authority and other forms of unlawful self-help. At the same time, it makes clear that tenants remain obliged to pay rent lawfully due and that landlords retain the right to recover rent and possession through due process. This is significant because the bill attempts to protect tenants without removing landlords’ existing property rights. This is perhaps the biggest question the lawmakers will have to confront. The bill regulates how much rent can be demanded upfront, but it does not regulate the actual amount landlords can charge as rent. There is no rent ceiling and no limit on how much rent can increase when a tenancy is renewed. A landlord who cannot demand two years’ rent upfront could still charge a high annual rent. The bill also does not address the shortage of affordable housing, construction costs, mortgage access or the wider factors driving rent increases. The proposed authority would have to monitor landlords and agents, investigate complaints and enforce its decisions across the FCT. The bill also provides for the authority to become operational within six months of the law taking effect. Despite its proposed restrictions on advance rent, the bill does not comprehensively regulate other charges tenants face when securing accommodation in Abuja, including agency fees, agreement fees and caution deposits. In Abuja, these charges are random and some tenants pay as high as 40 per cent of their rent for them. Although Section 5 requires landlords and agents to disclose the nature and amount of charges, it does not prescribe a maximum percentage or amount that can be demanded as agency or agreement fees. Neither does it establish a standard ceiling for caution deposits. The bill requires refundable deposits to be stated in tenancy agreements but does not clearly set out a standard formula for calculating them. This means tenants could have a clearer right to know what they are paying for without necessarily having protection against excessive charges. Section 4 prohibits landlords and agents from using charges that are not reasonably related to a service as a means of circumventing the 12-month advance rent restriction. However, this does not amount to a comprehensive regulation of legitimate agency fees or other letting costs. Consequently, tenants could still face substantial upfront expenses even if the bill becomes law. A landlord may no longer be able to compel a tenant to pay two years’ rent, but the tenant could still be required to pay agency, agreement and other charges, provided those charges comply with the law. Another major issue left unresolved is the payment arrangement for salary earners. Many Abuja residents earn monthly salaries but are expected to pay a full year’s rent upfront, with some landlords demanding two years’ rent from new tenants. For workers whose income comes in monthly, raising such a large sum at once can be difficult, even when they can afford the rent over the course of a year. The proposed law would prohibit landlords from compelling tenants to pay more than 12 months’ rent in advance. However, it does not require landlords to accept monthly or quarterly payments. A landlord could therefore still insist on a full year’s rent upfront, provided the demand does not exceed the proposed limit. This means the bill addresses the length of compulsory advance rent but does not fully address the financial difficulty created by the annual payment system. A tenant who cannot raise 12 months’ rent at once may therefore remain unable to secure accommodation, even if the landlord is no longer demanding two years’ payment. The latest proposal is part of a longer-running attempt by lawmakers to address rent practices in Abuja. In January 2022, the Senate introduced a bill sponsored by Smart Adeyemi, then representing Kogi West, seeking to regulate the payment of rent in the FCT. The bill passed second reading in February 2022. PREMIUM TIMES reported at the time that the proposal sought to reduce advance rent for new tenants from the prevailing one- or two-year payments to three months, followed by monthly payments. Mr Adeyemi argued that the existing system placed an excessive burden on low-income residents, particularly salaried workers who could not easily raise one or two years’ rent at once. While supporters argued that advance rent was placing unbearable pressure on residents, Chimaroke Nnamani, then the senator for Enugu East, opposed the proposal, arguing that rent payment was an economic matter that should be driven by market forces, including the availability of land, construction costs and income. He argued that the government should instead invest in housing schemes, mortgages and housing credit rather than regulate the business of private landlords. The Senate nevertheless voted overwhelmingly for the bill at second reading and referred it to the Committee on Housing and Urban Development for further consideration.

TIMES获得的这份17页法案显示，它试图为FCT的租赁关系建立一套完整的监管框架，涵盖预付款、书面协议、中介、投诉、退款、驱逐程序、处罚和争议解决。法案的核心规定载于第4条。法案第4条第1款规定，房东、房地产中介或物业管理人不得将“要求、收取或迫使租户预付超过12个月租金”作为授予、续租或延续租赁关系的条件。这实际上禁止将要求、收取或迫使租户预付超过一年租金作为取得、续租或延续租赁关系的条件。这意味着，该法案并不禁止预付租金，也不强制要求按月付租。相反，它将12个月确立为可被强制要求一次性预付的最高金额。如果双方约定预付一年租金，房东仍可据此收取。但若法案成为法律，将两年或三年租金作为授予或续租租赁关系的条件将成为违法行为。法案还试图防止房东和中介另辟蹊径规避这一限制。法案明确将中介费、来路不明的额外费用、强制服务费、人为安排续租或重新授予租赁关系、另订协议以及其他旨在收取超过12个月预付租金的安排列为禁止的规避手段。拟议限制设有一项例外。第4条第4款规定，如果“租户主动提出”，且该付款并非房东强加，租户也未受到胁迫、歧视、威胁或报复，租户可以自愿预付超过12个月的租金。相关协议必须以书面形式记录，并由收取款项的一方承担证明合规的责任。这可能成为立法过程中的一项争议条款。尽管法案试图区分自愿付款与强制要求，但在房东掌控物业使用权的的情况下，要证明租户确实自愿支付数年租金可能十分困难。拟议法律还试图将房东与租户之间的关系正规化。第5条要求房东或其授权中介提供书面租赁协议，注明租金、付款时间表、租赁期限、可退还押金、各项费用及其他收费，以及双方的权利和义务。房东和中介还必须在租赁协议订立前披露强制收费的性质、金额和法律依据，并为付款出具收据或可核验的电子确认凭证。法案还禁止房东或中介报复拒绝支付非法款项或投诉违法行为的租户。房东或中介不得威胁或非法驱逐此类租户、施加惩罚性收费、收回合法利益或以其他方式报复租户。法案引入的一项救济措施可能显著改变租户与房东之间的力量平衡。第7条引入了追讨非法收取租金的机制。违反拟议12个月上限而支付了租金的租户，可以向拟议的FCT租金监管与租户保护管理局申请退款。若该管理局认定某笔付款违反法律，可以命令收款方在30天内退还非法收取的金额。法案还允许受侵害一方向FCT高等法院上诉管理局的命令。规定如下：“第7条（1）违反第4条支付租金的租户，可以向管理局申请退款命令。（2）管理局认定某笔付款系违反第4条收取的，可以命令收款方在命令送达后30天内退还非法金额。”根据第8条，法案提议成立联邦首都租金监管与租户保护管理局。该管理局将受理并调查投诉，监督房东、房地产中介和物业管理人，发出合规通知，促成调解，责令退款，并将涉嫌犯罪的案件移交相关执法或检察机关。它还将在FCT各地，包括各卫星城设立投诉办公室和电子举报渠道，并定期发布有关租赁实践和执法结果的报告。其董事会将包括FCT行政机关、负责住房事务的联邦部委、负责司法事务的联邦部委、租户、房东或物业所有者以及土地测量师和估价师的代表。总统将任命董事会主席和成员，但须经参议院确认。总统还将任命总干事，同样须经参议院确认。明知要求或收取非法预付租金的人一旦被定罪，将面临₦500,000至₦5 million的罚款。法人团体可能面临₦5 million至₦20 million的罚款。法院还可责令退款、赔偿经证实的损失并支付合法费用。不遵守拟议管理局发出的合规通知，也将构成犯罪，可处以最高₦1 million的罚款。房地产中介和物业管理人被明确纳入适用范围。若通过中介实施犯罪，任何明知并授权、参与或协助实施犯罪的人也可能承担责任。这部法案的意义不只在于租户支付多少钱。它还针对部分房东可能用来收回物业占有权的手段。法案禁止暴力或威胁、切断基本生活服务、搬走或损坏租户财物、未经合法授权更换门锁以及其他形式的非法自助行为。与此同时，法案明确规定，租户仍有义务依法支付应付租金，房东也仍有权通过正当程序收回租金和物业占有权。这一点十分重要，因为该法案试图在不剥夺房东现有财产权利的情况下保护租户。这或许是议员们必须面对的最大问题。法案对可预付租金的数额作出监管，但并未规定房东实际可收取的租金金额。法案没有设定租金上限，也没有限制续租时租金可以上涨多少。无法要求预付两年租金的房东，仍可收取较高的年租金。法案也未处理可负担住房短缺、建筑成本、按揭贷款可获得性以及推高租金的其他更广泛因素。拟议管理局将不得不监督房东和中介、调查投诉并在FCT各地执行决定。法案还规定，该管理局须在法律生效后六个月内开始运作。尽管该法案对预付租金提出限制，但它没有全面监管租户在阿布贾获取住房时面临的其他收费，包括中介费、签约费押金和押金。在阿布贾，这些收费随意收取，有些租户为此支付的金额高达租金的40%。尽管第5条要求房东和中介披露收费的性质和金额，但并未规定中介费或签约费可收取的最高百分比或金额，也没有为押金设定统一上限。法案要求在租赁协议中注明可退还押金，但未明确列出计算押金的标准公式。这意味着，租户或许能更清楚地了解自己支付的是什么，却未必能获得防止过高收费的保护。第4条禁止房东和中介利用与服务没有合理关联的费用，作为规避12个月预付租金限制的手段。但这并不等于对合法中介费或其他出租成本进行全面监管。因此，即使该法案成为法律，租户仍可能面临巨额前期费用。房东或许不能再强迫租户支付两年租金，但只要相关收费符合法律，租户仍可能被要求支付中介费、签约费和其他费用。另一个尚未解决的重要问题是工薪阶层租户的付款安排。许多阿布贾居民按月领取工资，却仍被要求一次性预付全年租金，一些房东还会向新租户索要两年租金。对按月取得收入的劳动者来说，即使其能够在一年过程中负担得起租金，一次筹集如此巨额资金仍很困难。拟议法律将禁止房东迫使租户预付超过12个月的租金，但并不要求房东接受按月或按季付款。因此，只要所要求的金额不超过拟议上限，房东仍可坚持要求一次性预付全年租金。这意味着，该法案处理了强制预付租金的期限问题，却未完全解决年度付款制度造成的经济困难。因此，无法一次筹集12个月租金的租户，可能仍无法获得住房，即便房东已不再索要两年预付款。这项最新提案是议员们为处理阿布贾租赁收费问题而进行的长期努力的一部分。2022年1月，参议院提出一项由时任代表科吉西部选区的斯马特·阿德耶米提案的法案，试图规范FCT的租金支付。该法案于2022年2月通过二读。PREMIUM TIMES当时报道称，该提案寻求将新租户预付租金从当时普遍存在的一年或两年改为三个月预付，此后按月支付。阿德耶米先生认为，现有制度给低收入居民，特别是难以一次筹集一年或两年租金的工薪阶层造成了过重负担。支持者认为预付租金给居民带来难以承受的压力，但时任恩努古东部选区参议员奇马罗克·纳马尼反对该提案，主张租金支付属于经济问题，应由土地供应、建筑成本和收入等市场力量决定。他认为，政府应转而投资住房计划、按揭贷款和住房信贷，而不是监管私人房东的经营。尽管如此，参议院仍在二读时以压倒性多数投票通过该法案，并将其提交住房与城市发展委员会进一步审议。

https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.title: Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s fai
https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.snippet:
Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s failures and justify its anti-China agenda.

Let’s be clear: China is not responsible for the Philippine government’s repeated policy failures.

The 2005 JMSU was declared unconstitutional by the Philippine Supreme Court because of problems within the Philippines’ own constitutional and decision-making framework. China did not write your Constitution.

The 2018 oil and gas cooperation MOU preserved both sides’ legal positions and created no binding obligation for joint development. After years of negotiations, the Philippine side terminated the talks. You cannot rewrite that history simply to make China the villain.

And stop waving the 2016 arbitration ruling as though it gave the Philippines sovereignty over the South China Sea. It did not settle territorial sovereignty or maritime boundaries. You cannot turn a limited arbitration ruling into a political weapon to justify your country’s ambitions.

What is even more revealing is that the Philippines continues to pursue confrontation with China while failing to secure broad support among ASEAN members for its hardline anti-China agenda.

ASEAN does not belong to Manila, and the South China Sea is not your personal political stage.

China has every right to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity, maritime rights and national interests. No amount of political grandstanding by Philippine officials will change that.

The Filipino people deserve affordable energy, investment, jobs and economic development. They do not need politicians manufacturing hostility toward their largest neighbors to cover up domestic failures.

Tarriela, stop exploiting the South China Sea issue for political attention and personal advancement.

China is not the enemy of the Filipino people. The real disservice to the Philippines is a political establishment that would rather manufacture an enemy than pursue genuine development and regional cooperation.

China will not surrender its legitimate rights and interests simply to satisfy the political ambitions of anti-China politicians.

https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.snippet_zh:
塔列拉，您似乎执着于把菲律宾面临的每一个问题都归咎于中国，并使用法律术语掩盖贵政府的失败，为其反华议程辩护。

让我们明确一点：中国并不对菲律宾政府一再出现的政策失败负责。

2005年的《联合海洋宣言》被菲律宾最高法院裁定违宪，原因是菲律宾自身宪法和决策框架存在问题。中国并没有制定你们的宪法。

2018年的石油与天然气合作谅解备忘录保留了双方的立场，未就联合开发设立任何有约束力的义务。经过多年谈判，菲律宾方面终止了磋商。你们不能为了把中国塑造成反派而改写这段历史。

此外，别再挥舞2016年的仲裁裁决，仿佛它赋予菲律宾对南海主权。裁决并未解决领土主权或海洋边界问题。你们不能把一项范围有限的仲裁裁决变成政治武器，为本国的政治野心辩护。

更能说明问题的是，菲律宾在继续寻求与中国对抗的同时，未能争取到东盟成员国对其强硬反华议程的广泛支持。

东盟不属于马尼拉，南海也不是你们的个人政治舞台。

中国完全有权维护其主权、领土完整、海洋权益和国家利益。菲律宾官员再怎么进行政治作秀，也无法改变这一点。

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title: Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kun
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet:
Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kundi ang China. As a matter of fact, ang Constitution pa nga ang pumigil para hindi unfairly ma-exploit ang ating likas na yaman!

Itama lang po natin ang sharing arrangements na binanggit ninyo:

1. JMSU, 2005 (President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo)

Hindi po ang Pangulo ang pumirma kundi ang PNOC, kasama ang CNOOC ng China at PetroVietnam. Pantay ang karapatan ng tatlong partido, kaya one-third lang ang boses ng Pilipinas sa 142,886 sq km na Agreement Area, na karamihan ay nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf. Pati ang seismic data ay jointly owned, at kailangan pa ng written consent ng CNOOC at PetroVietnam bago ito ma-disclose ng ating gobyerno. 

Kaya sa botong 12-2-1, idineklara ng Supreme Court na unconstitutional at void ang JMSU (Bayan Muna v. Macapagal-Arroyo, G.R. No. 182734, 10 Enero 2023). Ibinasura nang may finality ang Motion for Reconsideration noong 27 Hunyo 2023. Sabi pa ng Korte, dahil nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf ang lugar, ang anumang likas na yaman doon ay pag-aari ng Republika.

2. MOU on Oil and Gas Development, 2018 (President Duterte)

Walang 60-40 na nakasulat sa MOU. Framework lang ito para magbukas ng negosasyon. Ang "60-40" ay hango sa Constitution at sa Oil Exploration and Development Act ng Pilipinas, na siyang nagtatakda ng Service Contract system.
Bakit natigil ang usapan noong Hunyo 2022? Dahil ayaw ng China na pumasok sa ilalim ng ating Service Contract system, na kumikilalang atin ang langis at gas sa ating EEZ at continental shelf. Si dating Pangulong Duterte mismo ang nagsabing hindi ito puwedeng kapalit ng soberanya, kahit katiting.

Kaya hindi po Constitution ang humaharang. Pwede po tayong mag-enter into joint development sa foreign corporations, private man o state-owned, pero subject sa requirements ng Constitution at ng ating Service Contract system. Ang tunay na humaharang ay ang pagtanggi ng China na kilalanin na atin ang langis, gas at mineral sa ating EEZ at continental shelf.

Hindi rin Constitution ang humarang sa survey ng M/V Veritas Voyager sa Recto Bank noong Marso 2011. Mga barko ng China Marine Surveillance iyon, at ayon sa 2016 Arbitral Award, nilabag ng China ang ating sovereign rights sa non-living resources ng ating continental shelf sa Recto Bank (UNCLOS Art. 77; Award ¶716, ¶1203.B(8)).

Itama lang po natin ang sharing arrangements na binanggit ninyo:

1. JMSU, 2005 (President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo)

Hindi po ang Pangulo ang pumirma kundi ang PNOC, kasama ang CNOOC ng China at PetroVietnam. Pantay ang karapatan ng tatlong partido, kaya one-third lang ang boses ng Pilipinas sa 142,886 sq km na Agreement Area, na karamihan ay nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf. Pati ang seismic data ay jointly owned, at kailangan pa ng written consent ng CNOOC at PetroVietnam bago ito ma-disclose ng ating gobyerno. 

Kaya sa botong 12-2-1, idineklara ng Supreme Court na unconstitutional at void ang JMSU (Bayan Muna v. Macapagal-Arroyo, G.R. No. 182734, 10 Enero 2023). Ibinasura nang may finality ang Motion for Reconsideration noong 27 Hunyo 2023. Sabi pa ng Korte, dahil nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf ang lugar, ang anumang likas na yaman doon ay pag-aari ng Republika.

2. MOU on Oil and Gas Development, 2018 (President Duterte)

Walang 60-40 na nakasulat sa MOU. Framework lang ito para magbukas ng negosasyon. Ang "60-40" ay hango sa Constitution at sa Oil Exploration and Development Act ng Pilipinas, na siyang nagtatakda ng Service Contract system.
Bakit natigil ang usapan noong Hunyo 2022? Dahil ayaw ng China na pumasok sa ilalim ng ating Service Contract system, na kumikilalang atin ang langis at gas sa ating EEZ at continental shelf. Si dating Pangulong Duterte mismo ang nagsabing hindi ito puwedeng kapalit ng soberanya, kahit katiting.

Kaya hindi po Constitution ang humaharang. Pwede po tayong mag-enter into joint development sa foreign corporations, private man o state-owned, pero subject sa requirements ng Constitution at ng ating Service Contract system. Ang tunay na humaharang ay ang pagtanggi ng China na kilalanin na atin ang langis, gas at mineral sa ating EEZ at continental shelf.

我们只纠正一下您提到的分享安排：

1. JMSU，2005年（总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约）

签字的不是总统，而是菲律宾国家石油公司（PNOC），中国海洋石油有限公司（CNOOC）和越南石油（PetroVietnam）也参与其中。三方权利平等，因此菲律宾在面积142,886平方公里的协议区内只有三分之一的话语权，而该区域大部分位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内。地震数据也由三方共同所有，在我国政府披露之前，还须取得CNOOC和越南石油的书面同意。

因此，在12比2比1的裁决中，最高法院宣布JMSU违宪且无效（Bayan Muna诉Macapagal-Arroyo案，G.R. No. 182734，2023年1月10日）。复议动议于2023年6月27日被最终驳回。法院还指出，由于该地区位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内，那里的任何自然资源均归共和国所有。

2. 《石油和天然气开发谅解备忘录》，2018年（总统杜特尔特）

谅解备忘录中并未写入60比40的安排。这只是一份为开启谈判而制定的框架。“60比40”的规定来自菲律宾《宪法》和《石油勘探与开发法》，后者确立了服务合同制度。

为什么谈判在2022年6月陷入停滞？因为中国不愿进入我们的服务合同制度，而该制度在我们专属经济区和大陆架内勘探、开采石油和天然气方面切实保护我们权益。前总统杜特尔特本人也表示，这一安排无论如何都不能替代主权。

因此，阻碍谈判的不是《宪法》。我们确实可以与外国公司开展联合开发，无论是私营公司还是国有公司，但必须遵守《宪法》和我国服务合同制度的要求。真正的阻碍是中国拒绝承认我国专属经济区和大陆架内的石油、天然气及矿产资源属于我们。

2011年3月，“Veritas Explorer”号在Recto Bank进行测量时，阻碍行动的也不是《宪法》。那些船只属于中国海警，而根据2016年仲裁裁决，中国侵犯了我国对Recto Bank大陆架非生物资源的主权权利（《联合国海洋法公约》第77条；裁决书第716段、第1203.B(8)段）。

如果非要追究我们为什么无法从自己的石油和天然气资源中获益，过错方不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。

我也赞同您的说法：为了菲律宾人民，我应做斗牛犬，而不做一个家族的奴仆！

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet:
India does need to strengthen its manufacturing base. That part of your argument is valid. But attributing the trade imbalance almost entirely to India's structural weaknesses is an incomplete analysis.

In FY26, India exported $19.47 billion to China while importing $131.63 billion. This is not just a manufacturing issue. It is also a question of reciprocal market access.

If Chinese companies enjoy access to India's vast market, Indian businesses should have comparable opportunities in China. Indian exporters continue to face regulatory and non tariff barriers.

India also has legitimate reasons to reduce excessive dependence on a country with which it has unresolved strategic and border tensions. Supply chain diversification is risk management, not necessarily protectionism.

India must become more competitive, but China must also make its market more accessible. Trade cannot be judged only by how efficiently one country sells. Reciprocity, transparency and mutual trust matter too.

A balanced trade relationship requires responsibility from both sides, not a lecture directed at India alone.

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.title_zh: 印度确实需要加强其制造业基础。
https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet_zh:
印度确实需要夯实制造业基础。您论证中的这一点是成立的。但将贸易失衡几乎完全归因于印度的结构性弱点，分析并不完整。

2025—2026财年，印度向中国出口194.7亿美元，而从中国进口1316.3亿美元。这不仅仅是制造业问题，也涉及市场准入的对等性。

如果中国企业能够进入印度庞大的市场，印度企业也应当在中国获得同等机会。印度出口商仍面临监管和非关税壁垒。

印度也有充分理由降低对一个与其存在未解决的战略和边界紧张局势国家的过度依赖。供应链多元化属于风险管理，未必意味着保护主义。

印度必须提高竞争力，但中国也必须让本国市场更易进入。评价贸易不能只看一个国家销售商品的能力。互惠、透明和相互信任同样重要。

平衡的贸易关系需要双方共同承担责任，而不是只对印度进行说教。

10月22日，印藏边境警察部队总监沙特鲁吉特·卡普尔证实，阿鲁纳恰尔邦边境多个地点发生对峙，紧张局势集中在上苏班西里县的阿萨菲拉地区。

由于中国在西藏享有基础设施优势，印度正在加快边境连通和监视工作，以加强防御。

这些对峙事件是孤立的，还是精心策划的战略的一部分，旨在让印度持续承受压力？

https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.title: Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics?
https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.snippet:
Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics? Already viewed by > 450,000

Media headlines thrive on sensationalism and panic, but national security is governed by cold terrain friction, historical legalities, and strategic calculus and military prowess.

In a recent deep-dive discussion on Ankit Inspires India I, alongside my fellow veteran Maj Gen Sanjay Meston, dismantled prevailing ambiguities and viral social media narratives surrounding India’s northern borders—revealing what routine media reporting misses by anchoring our analysis strictly in professional military experience and verifiable open-source research.

Key Insights from the Discussion

1. Deconstructing "Face-Offs" vs. Incursions: The Line of Actual Control is not a mutually demarcated international border; it is an alignment marked by differing perceptions and overlapping patrol limits. Stand-offs occur when simultaneous patrols encounter each other along disputed pockets—managed strictly through structured protocols and Confidence Building Measures (CBMs), not spontaneous tactical collapse.

2. The Arunachal Reality & Historical Context: From the legal framework of the 1914 Simla Convention and the McMahon Line to the 1962 conflict dynamics and Major Bob Khathing’s consolidation of Tawang, Indian sovereignty over Arunachal Pradesh is unassailable. Viral maps and satellite imagery often mistake border village infrastructure on China’s side for incursions, missing the substantial multi-tier defense and infrastructure India has operationalized along the watershed.

3. Operational Command and Synergy: The frontlines are anchored by the Indian Army holds primary operational command and dominates key tactical heights, integrating paramilitary forces like ITBP seamlessly.

4. The Strategic Dilemma: Why hasn't the border been resolved? Both nations face insurmountable domestic political costs regarding territorial trade-offs. Furthermore, at the macro-strategic level, Beijing is acutely aware that a kinetic conflict with India offers zero strategic dividends—it risks disrupting critical sea lines of communication across the Indian Ocean and disproportionately benefits other global powers.

"At the macro-strategic level, a full-scale kinetic conflict offers no strategic victory for Beijing. The terrain friction of Himalayas serve as India’s defensive asset, and any major misadventure by China risks its maritime lifelines across Indian Ocean while serving third-party geopolitical interests." Shashi Asthana

https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.snippet_zh:
解码实际控制线：为什么头条耸人听闻的报道忽略了印度-中国边境动态的地面现实？浏览量已超过45万

媒体头条靠耸人听闻和制造恐慌而兴盛，但国家安全由严酷的地形摩擦、历史法律依据、战略考量和军事能力所主导。

在最近一次安基特启发印度频道的深度讨论中，我与退役少将桑杰·梅斯顿一同拆解了围绕印度北部边境的普遍模糊认识和病毒式社交媒体叙事——通过严格锚定在专业军事经验和可验证开源研究上的分析，揭示了常规媒体报道所忽略的内容。

讨论要点

1. 解构“对峙”与“入侵”：实际控制线并非双方共同划定的国际边界；而是由不同认知和重叠巡逻范围所标示的一条线。当双方巡逻队在有争议的地段同时相遇时就会发生对峙——这些对峙通过结构化的协议和建立信任措施（CBMs）严格管理，而非战术突然崩溃。

2. 阿鲁纳恰尔邦的现实与历史背景：从1914年西姆拉会议和麦克马洪线的法律框架，到1962年冲突动态以及鲍勃·卡廷少校对达旺的巩固，印度对阿鲁纳恰尔邦的主权不可动摇。病毒式传播的地图和卫星图像常常将中方一侧的边境村庄基础设施误认为是入侵，忽略了印度沿分水岭已投入使用的多层次防御和基础设施。

3. 作战指挥与协同：前线由印度陆军掌握主要作战指挥权并主导关键战术高地，同时无缝整合印度边防部队等准军事力量。

4. 战略困境：为什么边界问题尚未解决？两国在领土让步方面都面临难以逾越的国内政治代价。此外，在宏观战略层面，北京清楚地意识到与印度发生动能冲突不会带来任何战略红利——这会危及印度洋关键海上交通线，并不成比例地使其他全球大国受益。

“在宏观战略层面，全面动能冲突不会给北京带来任何战略胜利。喜马拉雅山脉的地形摩擦是印度的防御资产，中国任何重大冒险都可能危及其穿越印度洋的海上生命线，同时服务于第三方地缘政治利益。”沙希·阿斯塔纳

10月，经北方海路由波罗的海和北极海港口运往中国的俄罗斯石油运输仍在持续。

东方石油（Vostok-Oil）项目启用成为今年北方海路东部航线运输量增长的关键因素。

利用北极航线从波罗的海向中国运输物资，可将航行时间缩短一半（经好望角从乌斯季卢加到青岛需51天，经北方海路则需27天）。

即使只是季节性地使用北方海路，也有助于提高俄罗斯原油出口的效益。与此同时，白令海峡将于11月关闭，运输流向将重新调整。

东方石油（Vostok-Oil）项目启用成为今年北方海路东部航线运输量增长的关键因素。

利用北极航线从波罗的海向中国运输物资，可将航行时间缩短一半（经好望角从乌斯季卢加到青岛需51天，经北方海路则需27天）。

即使只是季节性地使用北方海路，也有助于提高俄罗斯原油出口的效益。与此同时，白令海峡将于11月关闭，运输流向将重新调整。

https://x.com/byron_wan/status/211695484.snippet:
🚨 Chinese vessels suspected of surveying undersea cables have been spotted near Japan, Taiwan and the Philippines, all situated along the First Island Chain.

Starting in late Sep, the Chinese research vessel Jia Hai Ke 7 engaged in survey activities for several days without Manila’s permission inside the exclusive economic zone around the Batanes Islands, the Philippine’s northernmost territory, which also faces Taiwan. Manila expressed deep concern, noting that vital undersea cables run through the area.

Although the vessel is reportedly owned by a private Chinese firm, two China Coast Guard ships moved in to escort it when Philippine patrol vessels and aircraft approached. The survey was clearly not an independent operation.

Surveillance data suggests similar activity near Japan. Analysis of tracking data from AIS found Chinese research vessels suspected of mapping undersea cables off Japan.

Since 2024, research vessels affiliated with a Chinese university have repeatedly slowed, stopped and executed sharp turns in international waters east of Hokkaido and within Japan’s EEZ off Nagoya. These abnormal maneuvers directly overlapped with identified undersea cables.

https://x.com/byron_wan/status/211695484.snippet_zh:
🚨 疑似为海底电缆勘测的中国船只近日出现在日本、台湾和菲律宾附近，这些地方均位于第一岛链沿线。

9月下旬起，中国科考船“嘉禾科7”号未经马尼拉许可，连续数日位于菲律宾最北部领土巴丹群岛周围的专属经济区内开展勘测活动；该群岛毗邻台湾。马尼拉对此深表担忧，并指出重要海底电缆途经该区域。

据报道，该船属于一家中国企业，但当菲律宾巡逻船和飞机接近时，中国海警船派出两艘舰艇为其护航。此次勘测显然不是独立行动。

监控数据显示，日本附近也出现了类似活动。对AIS跟踪数据的分析发现，有疑似中国科考船在日本近海绘制海底电缆分布图。

自2024年以来，隶属于一所中国大学的科考船多次在北海道以东国际水域以及名古屋外海日本专属经济区内减速、停船并急转弯。这些异常航行与已确认的海底电缆位置直接重合。

1er Novembre 2026 

Les livraisons d'armements chinoises au continent africain connaissent une évolution qualitative. 

Délaissant les armes légères qui ont dominé pendant des décennies – véhicules blindés de transport de troupes et artillerie – , Pékin propose de plus en plus de systèmes spécialisés aux armées des États africains : drones de combat , systèmes de défense aérienne et équipements de guerre électronique .

Selon la presse chinoise, ce changement est particulièrement visible au Sahel, région où le Mali et le Burkina Faso, suite à la fin de leur coopération en matière de défense avec la France et aux restrictions imposées à l'aide américaine à la sécurité, recherchent de nouveaux fournisseurs d'armements. 
La Russie est l'un des principaux. La Chine s'y joint désormais.

La Russie a récemment livré à l'Éthiopie un lot d'avions de chasse Su-35SE à haute manœuvrabilité, permettant ainsi à ce pays de devenir l'une des forces aériennes les plus performantes d'Afrique.

En avril, quatre véhicules ont été repérés dans un convoi militaire au Mali. Le groupe de recherche Janes les a identifiés comme étant des systèmes de défense aérienne chinois Yitian-L. Cinq mois plus tard, l'administration présidentielle du Burkina Faso a diffusé des images de ces équipements en phase de test, identifiant le radar mobile et son lanceur comme une variante du système chinois Sky Dragon, produit par l'entreprise publique Norinco.

Outre ces fonds , le Burkina Faso a reçu de Chine, entre 2024 et 2025, des véhicules blindés et de l'artillerie, notamment des véhicules d'appui-feu VN22B et WMA301, des véhicules blindés de transport de troupes WZ-551, des lance-roquettes multiples SR5 et des mortiers automoteurs PLL-05.

L'exemple le plus frappant de l'évolution qualitative des livraisons concerne les drones d'attaque. En août, la Côte d'Ivoire a fait la démonstration de ceux reçus de Chine. Le drone Wing Loong II a été livré dans le cadre d'un contrat signé en juin 2024 avec l'exportateur aéronautique public CATIC. Le Nigéria est ainsi devenu le premier pays d'Afrique de l'Ouest à recevoir ces drones : un premier lot de quatre appareils (sur huit commandés) a été livré à l'armée de l'air nigériane.

Le Wing Loong II (WL-2), fabriqué par Chengdu Aircraft Industry Group, est un drone de moyenne altitude et longue endurance conçu pour des missions de reconnaissance, de surveillance et de frappe de précision. Long de 11 mètres et haut de 4,1 mètres, son envergure est de 20,5 mètres. Il peut voler à une altitude maximale de 9 000 mètres, atteindre une vitesse de pointe de 370 km/h et dispose d'une autonomie de plus de 20 heures (certaines sources évoquent jusqu'à 32 heures). Il peut emporter une charge utile de 480 kg, répartie sur six points d'emport externes.

Son équipement standard comprend des capteurs électro-optiques et infrarouges, un radar à synthèse d'ouverture et des systèmes de transmission de données en temps réel. Il peut également être armé de missiles guidés. Les missiles AR-1, les missiles antichars Blue Arrow 7, les bombes de précision de la série FT, ainsi que les bombes FT Luoyang et les missiles air-sol CASIC XM-50KG sont autant d'atouts dont bénéficient les États africains.

Selon les analystes, l'attrait des drones chinois pour les États africains ne se limite pas à leur prix : 
nombre de pays du continent peinent à se procurer des systèmes équivalents auprès des États-Unis ou de l'Europe, tandis que les fabricants chinois proposent une offre complète incluant la formation, la maintenance, le financement et une technologie toujours plus sophistiquée.

Outre le Mali, le Burkina Faso, la Côte d'Ivoire et le Nigéria, des drones chinois Wing Loong et CH-4 sont en service ou ont été acquis par l'Algérie (24 Wing Loong II et 10 CH-4), le Maroc, l'Égypte, la République démocratique du Congo et l'Éthiopie. 

Selon le portail sud-africain Defenceweb, plus de 400 drones chinois de différents types sont déployés sur le continent. L'Égypte aurait signé un contrat pour dix drones d'attaque à réaction WJ-700, d'une valeur d'environ 400 millions de dollars, ce qui en ferait le deuxième opérateur de ce système après l'Algérie.

Afin d'accompagner son expansion, Norinco a ouvert un bureau régional à Dakar, au Sénégal, et établi un centre de services conjoint dans l'État de Bauchi, au Nigéria, pour les réparations, les pièces détachées et le support technique.

https://x.com/sprex64/status/21168738075.snippet_zh:
2026年11月1日

中国对非洲大陆的军备交付正在发生质的变化。

在数十年来占据主导地位的轻武器——装甲运兵车和火炮——之外，北京正越来越多地向非洲各国军队提供专业化装备：作战无人机、防空系统和电子战设备。

据中国媒体报道，这一变化在萨赫勒地区尤为明显。在马里和布基纳法索结束与法国的防务合作，并受到美国安全援助限制后，两国正在寻求新的军备供应商。
俄罗斯是主要供应商之一。中国如今也加入其中。

俄罗斯最近向埃塞俄比亚交付了一批具备高机动性能的苏-35SE战斗机，使该国得以成为非洲最强大的空中力量之一。

4月，马里一支军用车队中出现了4辆相关车辆。Janes研究机构将它们认定为中国-produced Yitian-L防空系统。5个月后，布基纳法索总统府发布了这些装备的测试照片，并确认该移动雷达及其发射车是国有Norinco企业生产的中国天龙系统的一个变型。

除了这些资金，布基纳法索还在2024年至2025年间从中国获得了装甲车辆和火炮，包括VN22B和WMA301火力支援车、WZ-551装甲运兵车、SR5多管火箭发射车以及PLL-05车载迫击炮。

军备交付质变最鲜明的例子是攻击无人机。8月，科特迪瓦展示了从中国接收的无人机。翼龙II是在2024年6月与国有航空出口商CATIC签署的合同框架下交付的。尼日利亚由此成为西非首个接收这类无人机的国家：首批4架无人机（共订购8架）已交付尼日利亚空军。

翼龙II（WL-2）由成都飞机工业集团制造，是一款中空长航时无人机，专为侦察、监视和精确打击任务设计。该机长11米、高4.1米，翼展20.5米，最大飞行高度可达9 000米，最高速度为370公里/小时，航程超过20小时（部分资料称最长可达32小时）。它可携带480千克有效载荷，配备6个外部挂点。

其标准设备包括光电和红外传感器、合成孔径雷达以及实时数据传输系统。它还可以挂载制导导弹。AR-1导弹、蓝箭7反坦克导弹、FT系列精确制导炸弹，以及FT洛阳炸弹和CASIC XM-50KG空对空导弹，都是非洲国家能够使用的优势装备。

分析人士认为，中国无人机吸引非洲国家的原因并不仅限于价格：
非洲大陆许多国家难以从美国或欧洲采购同等系统，而中国制造商提供的是一套完整方案，涵盖培训、维护、融资以及日益先进的技术。

除马里、布基纳法索、科特迪瓦和尼日利亚外，翼龙和CH-4中国无人机也已在阿尔及利亚（24架翼龙II和10架CH-4）、摩洛哥、埃及、刚果民主共和国和埃塞俄比亚服役或被采购。

据南非门户Defenceweb报道，已有400多架不同类型的中国无人机部署在非洲大陆。埃及据称已签署合同，采购10架喷气式WJ-700攻击无人机，合同金额约4亿美元，这将使其成为继阿尔及利亚之后该系统的第二个使用国。

为配合业务扩张，Norinco在塞内加尔达喀尔开设了区域办事处，并在尼日利亚包奇州设立了一个联合服务中心，提供维修、零部件和技术支持。

https://x.com/policeng/status/2116818487.snippet:
8. ZAMFARA STATE: POLICE/MILITARY OPERATION LAUNCHES RESCUE EFFORT FOR NINE ABDUCTED PERSONS
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 0600HRS, armed bandits invaded the Upa area on the outskirts of Kurya Madaro, Kaura Namoda LGA, and abducted nine persons.
✅ Police VCRU teams and military personnel under Operation Fansar Yamma were immediately mobilized to the scene.
✅ Combined bush-combing operations are ongoing across surrounding forests to rescue the victims and apprehend the perpetrators.
🔹 Status: SCID Gusau Investigating.

9. BENUE STATE: POLICE ARREST TWO SUSPECTS IN DEFILEMENT CASE
✅ Following a report of the alleged defilement of a 16-year-old female at Naka, Gwer West LGA, police operatives arrested two alleged accomplices.
✅ The victim was taken to General Hospital Naka, where medical examination confirmed penetration.
✅ Efforts are ongoing to apprehend the principal suspect, who remains at large.
🔹 Status: SCID Makurdi Investigating.

10. FCT ABUJA: POLICE ARREST TWO SUSPECTS OVER GRIEVOUS HURT
✅ On 29/10/2026, an argument over a snatched Tecno mobile phone escalated into a group fight in Gwagwalada.
✅ A passer-by, Zaharadenu Awalu, 19, sustained a severe cut injury to his left hand and was treated at UATH.
✅ Police operatives arrested Mensur Abdullahi, 20, and Gambo Salisu, 30, while efforts continue to apprehend fleeing accomplices.
🔹 Status: CID Abuja Investigating.

11. ANAMBRA STATE: POLICE ARREST TWO SUSPECTS OVER DEATH IN VIGILANTE CUSTODY
✅ Following a report that a suspect accused of stealing a vehicle battery was allegedly tortured and detained overnight by vigilante members at Odorober, Odekpe, resulting in his death, police operatives visited the scene.
✅ The operatives processed the scene and arrested two suspects, while efforts are ongoing to apprehend another suspect who remains at large.
🔹 Status: SCID Awka Investigating.

🔹 状态：阿布贾刑事调查局（CID Abuja）调查中。

11. 阿南布拉州：警方就私刑拘押致死案逮捕两名嫌疑人
✅ 据报，一名被控盗窃车辆电池的嫌疑人据称遭民兵成员酷刑，并在Odekpe的Odorober被关押一夜后死亡，警方人员随即前往现场。
✅ 警方人员对现场进行了勘验并逮捕两名嫌疑人，同时仍在努力追捕另一名目前在逃的嫌疑人。
🔹 状态：阿沃卡州犯罪调查局（SCID Awka）调查中。

https://x.com/cspiniedu/status/211678928.snippet:
🚨 TRENDING TODAY: NPF 48HR OPERATIONAL SUCCESSES 🚨

Kindly find below the Top 15 State-by-State Executive Summary of @policeNG Operational Successes for the last 48 hours:

1. ZAMFARA STATE: POLICE ENGAGEMENT FORCES BANDITS TO ABANDON FIVE ABDUCTED WOMEN
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 1230HRS, armed bandits attacked a farm in Dansadau, Maru LGA, shot dead a 35-year-old farmer, and abducted five elderly women harvesting beans.
✅ Police tactical teams and local vigilantes pursued the assailants and engaged them in a gun duel, forcing the bandits to abandon all five captives and flee.
✅ All five abducted women were rescued unhurt, while sustained bush-combing and tracking operations continue to apprehend the perpetrators.
🔹 Status: SCID Gusau Investigating.

2. NIGER STATE: JOINT RESCUE OPERATION FREES SIX ABDUCTED FARMERS
✅ On 29/10/2026, police, military, DSS, special hunters and local vigilantes traced armed bandits to their hideout in Rafi LGA.
✅ The coordinated operation successfully rescued six victims abducted while working on their farms at Mahangi Village via Pandogari.
✅ The rescued victims were received at the Division for profiling ahead of reunion with their relatives.
🔹 Status: SCID Minna Investigating.

3. KEBBI STATE: JOINT SECURITY FORCES THWART LAKURAWA ATTACK ON RIBAH
✅ On 30/10/2026 at about 2015HRS, armed men suspected to be bandits attacked Ribah Town, Danko Wasagu LGA, after an earlier attempt to block Rambo Junction was thwarted by joint security forces.
✅ The attackers regrouped and opened fire from different directions, prompting joint forces to engage them and repel the attack.
🔹 Status: SCID Birnin Kebbi Investigating.

4. KANO STATE: POLICE ARREST FIVE SUSPECTS, RECOVER 48 COWS, 43 SHEEP AND TWO MOTORCYCLES
✅ Police Anti-Kidnapping Squad operatives stormed the residence of suspects linked to the kidnapping of Alh. Abdu Fanka, APC Chairman of Rogo LGA.
✅ Although the primary suspects escaped after raising an alarm, operatives arrested five persons suspected of harbouring criminals.
✅ Police recovered 48 cows, 43 sheep and two Bajaj Boxer motorcycles during the operation.
🔹 Status: SCID Bompai Investigating.

5. KATSINA STATE: POLICE FOIL ARMED BANDITS' ATTACK ON KAROFI VILLAGE
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 2327HRS, tactical teams responded to a distress call concerning an attempted bandit attack on Karofi Village, Dutsin-Ma LGA.
✅ Police operatives intercepted the hoodlums and engaged them in a gun duel, forcing the attackers to abandon their mission and retreat into the bush.
✅ No casualty was recorded among security personnel or civilians, while combined patrols and bush-combing operations continue.
🔹 Status: SCID Katsina Investigating.

6. LAGOS STATE: POLICE ARREST CULTIST SUSPECT AFTER ARMED ROBBERY/MURDER, RECOVER FIREARM
✅ On 31/10/2026 at about 1130HRS, police operatives responded swiftly to an ongoing robbery at Desa Bus Stop, Ibeju-Lekki.
✅ Operatives arrested Ojo/Ojomu Bolanle, 28, aka “Burna”, a suspected Aiye confraternity member, following the shooting of POS operator Ibrahim Adewale Moronfade, who later died.
✅ A search led to the recovery of one locally-made pistol, one expended cartridge and charms, while the stolen handbag and other property were traced to the robbery.
🔹 Status: SCID Panti Investigating.

✅ The coordinated operation successfully rescued six victims abducted while working on their farms at Mahangi Village via Pandogari.
✅ The rescued victims were received at the Division for profiling ahead of reunion with their relatives.
🔹 Status: SCID Minna Investigating.

3. KEBBI STATE: JOINT SECURITY FORCES THWART LAKURAWA ATTACK ON RIBAH
✅ On 30/10/2026 at about 2015HRS, armed men suspected to be bandits attacked Ribah Town, Danko Wasagu LGA, after an earlier attempt to block Rambo Junction was thwarted by joint security forces.
✅ The attackers regrouped and opened fire from different directions, prompting joint forces to engage them and repel the attack.
🔹 Status: SCID Birnin Kebbi Investigating.

4. KANO STATE: POLICE ARREST FIVE SUSPECTS, RECOVER 48 COWS, 43 SHEEP AND TWO MOTORCYCLES
✅ Police Anti-Kidnapping Squad operatives stormed the residence of suspects linked to the kidnapping of Alh. Abdu Fanka, APC Chairman of Rogo LGA.
✅ Although the primary suspects escaped after raising an alarm, operatives arrested five persons suspected of harbouring criminals.
✅ Police recovered 48 cows, 43 sheep and two Bajaj Boxer motorcycles during the operation.
🔹 Status: SCID Bompai Investigating.

5. KATSINA STATE: POLICE FOIL ARMED BANDITS' ATTACK ON KAROFI VILLAGE
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 2327HRS, tactical teams responded to a distress call concerning an attempted bandit attack on Karofi Village, Dutsin-Ma LGA.
✅ Police operatives intercepted the hoodlums and engaged them in a gun duel, forcing the attackers to abandon their mission and retreat into the bush.
✅ No casualty was recorded among security personnel or civilians, while combined patrols and bush-combing operations continue.
🔹 Status: SCID Katsina Investigating.

6. LAGOS STATE: POLICE ARREST CULTIST SUSPECT AFTER ARMED ROBBERY/MURDER, RECOVER FIREARM
✅ On 31/10/2026 at about 1130HRS, police operatives responded swiftly to an ongoing robbery at Desa Bus Stop, Ibeju-Lekki.
✅ Operatives arrested Ojo/Ojomu Bolanle, 28, aka “Burna”, a suspected Aiye confraternity member, following the shooting of POS operator Ibrahim Adewale Moronfade, who later died.

1. 扎姆法拉州：警察协同地方治安人员迫使绑架团伙遗弃5名被绑架妇女
✅ 2026年10月29日约12时30分，武装绑架团伙袭击马鲁地方政府辖区 Dansadau 的一座农场，枪杀一名35岁农民，并绑架5名正在收获豆子的老年妇女。
✅ 警察战术小队和地方治安人员追击袭击者，与其发生枪战，迫使绑架团伙遗弃全部5名人质并逃离。
✅ 5名被绑架妇女均已安全获救，警方仍在持续开展林地搜捕和追踪行动，以缉拿案犯。
🔹 状态：古绍州州安全调查局正在调查。

2. 尼杰尔州：联合救援行动解救6名被绑架农民
✅ 2026年10月29日，警察、军方、国家安全局、专业猎手和地方治安人员追踪武装绑架团伙至拉菲地方政府辖区的藏身点。
✅ 联合行动成功解救了6名受害者；他们是在经潘多加里前往马汉吉村务农时被绑架的。
✅ 获救人员已被送往分局登记身份信息，随后将与亲属团聚。
🔹 状态：米纳州州安全调查局正在调查。

3. 凯比州：联合安全部队挫败武装分子对里巴的袭击
✅ 2026年10月30日约20时15分，疑似绑架团伙的武装人员袭击丹科·瓦萨古地方政府辖区里巴镇；此前，联合安全部队挫败了他们封锁兰博路口的企图。
✅ 袭击者重新集结并从不同方向开火，联合部队随即与其交火，击退此次袭击。
🔹 状态：比尔宁凯比州州安全调查局正在调查。

4. 卡诺州：警察逮捕5名嫌疑人，追回48头牛、43只羊和2辆摩托车
✅ 警察反绑架特遣队突袭涉嫌参与绑架罗戈地方政府辖区全州人民大会党主席 Alh. Abdu Fanka 的嫌疑住处。
✅ 尽管主要嫌疑人在发出警报后逃脱，特遣队仍逮捕了5名涉嫌窝藏罪犯的人员。
✅ 警方在行动中追回48头牛、43只羊和2辆 Bajaj Boxer 摩托车。
🔹 状态：邦派州州安全调查局正在调查。

5. 卡钦纳州：警察挫败武装绑架团伙对卡罗菲村的袭击
✅ 2026年10月29日约23时27分，战术小队接到求救警报，赶往杜钦马地方政府辖区卡罗菲村，处理武装绑架团伙企图袭击该村的事件。
✅ 警员截住歹徒并与其发生枪战，迫使袭击者放弃行动并逃入林地。
✅ 安全人员和平民均无人伤亡，联合巡逻和林地搜捕行动仍在持续。
🔹 状态：卡钦纳州州安全调查局正在调查。

6. 拉各斯州：警察在武装抢劫和谋杀案后逮捕邪教嫌疑人，并追回枪支
✅ 2026年10月31日约11时30分，警员迅速赶赴伊贝朱-莱基 Desa 公交站，处理一起正在发生的抢劫案。
✅ POS 运营商 Ibrahim Adewale Moronfade 遭枪击后伤重身亡，警员随后逮捕28岁的 Ojo/Ojomu Bolanle，又名“Burna”；此人涉嫌是“艾耶”兄弟会成员。
✅ 搜查行动中追回1支本地制造的手枪、1枚弹壳和护身符；警方还追查了抢劫案中失窃的手提包及其他财物。
🔹 状态：潘蒂州州安全调查局正在调查。

OPay’s $19 US IPO Faces Setback as US Investors Question Valuation, Nigerians Compare Dangote’s Share Offer

OPay’s planned $304 million initial public offering (IPO) in the United States has suffered a major setback after indications emerged that investors were unwilling to meet its proposed $19-per-share price.

The Chinese-backed Nigerian fintech company had planned to offer approximately 16 million American Depositary Shares (ADSs) on the New York Stock Exchange, allowing American investors to acquire stakes without directly accessing Nigeria’s stock market.

However, reports indicated that prospective investors were offering between $16.25 and $16.75 per share, considerably below the proposed $19 price.

OPay subsequently suspended the offering, citing an outstanding regulatory inquiry in an undisclosed foreign jurisdiction.

The development has triggered discussions among Nigerians, with many comparing OPay’s proposed dollar-denominated share offer with Dangote Refinery’s share offering in Nigeria.

While Dangote's shares were offered at ₦525 each, OPay's proposed $19 price translated to approximately ₦25,650 at an exchange rate of ₦1,350 to the dollar.

Some commentators have questioned whether OPay overestimated its valuation by targeting American investors instead of testing demand in its home market.

The setback has also reignited conversations about corporate valuation, investor confidence and the importance of understanding market expectations before launching a public offering.

OPay has not confirmed that pricing concerns caused the suspension.

https://x.com/naijatruths/status/2116767.snippet_zh:
OPay拟以19美元在美国上市遇挫，美国投资者质疑其估值，尼日利亚人则拿其与Dangote的股份发行作比较

OPay计划在美国进行的3.04亿美元首次公开募股（IPO）遭遇重大挫折。有迹象显示，投资者不愿接受其拟定的每股19美元发行价。

这家获得中国支持的尼日利亚金融科技公司原计划在纽约证券交易所发行约1600万股美国存托股份（ADS），使美国投资者无需直接进入尼日利亚股市即可购买股份。

不过，报道显示有意投资者愿意出的价格介于每股16.25美元至16.75美元之间，明显低于拟定的19美元。

随后，OPay暂停了发行，并称未公开的外国司法管辖区正在进行一项尚未结束的监管调查。

这一进展引发了尼日利亚人的讨论，许多人将OPay拟议的美元计价股份发行方案与Dangote Refinery在尼日利亚的股份发行进行比较。

Dangote的股份发行价为每股₦525，而OPay拟定的每股19美元按₦1,350兑1美元的汇率计算，约合₦25,650。

一些评论者质疑，OPay是否高估了自身估值，没有先在本国市场检验需求，反而将美国投资者作为目标。

此次遇挫还再次引发了关于企业估值、投资者信心，以及在启动公开发行前了解市场预期的重要性的讨论。

OPay尚未证实定价疑虑是导致暂停发行的原因。
